Senior Marketing Manager (m/w/d) in VZ
jobs.description:
Wir sind AXS, ein globaler Ticketinganbieter für Veranstaltungsorte, Sportclubs und Events. AXS verantwortet u.a. das Ticketing für AEG Presents, dem führenden Veranstalter von Tourneen, Festivals und Konzerte weltweit. Fans der größten Künstler wie Taylor Swift, Ed Sheeran, Kylie Minogue, Katy Perry und BLACKPINK vertrauen auf AXS, um Zugang zu Konzerten oder einzigartigen Erlebnissen wie dem Coachella Festival oder dem Hyde Park Festival zu erhalten. AXS ist eine Gesellschaft des weltweit agierenden und unabhängigen Entertainment Konzerns Anschutz Entertainment Group, Inc. (AEG), die zugleich Betreiber zahlreicher Venues sind, in Deutschland zählen die Uber Arena und Uber Eats Music Hall in Berlin sowie der Barclays Arena in Hamburg dazu.

Als Senior Marketing Manager für Deutschland verantwortest du den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung unserer Marketingaktivitäten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung sowie den europäischen und globalen Marketingteams entwickelst und steuerst du wirkungsvolle Marketingstrategien, die den Ticketverkauf steigern, die Markenbekanntheit stärken und das Wachstum von AXS in Deutschland vorantreiben.

Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit operativer Umsetzungsstärke, bringst ein ausgeprägtes digitales und kommerzielles Verständnis mit und entwickelst starke Partnerschaften mit unseren Venues und Veranstaltungspartnern. Dabei übersetzt du die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes in konkrete Maßnahmen und gestaltest aktiv die Weiterentwicklung einer internationalen Marke im Live-Entertainment.

Aufgaben

Marketingstrategie, Aufbau & Teamführung

  • Du entwickelst und steuerst die Marketingstrategie für AXS Germany und setzt diese in messbare Maßnahmen und Kampagnen um.

  • Du baust effiziente Marketingprozesse, Strukturen und Reporting-Routinen auf und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter.

  • Du definierst klare Ziele und Prioritäten und sorgst für eine erfolgreiche Umsetzung der Marketingaktivitäten.

  • Du führst und entwickelst das lokale Marketingteam, förderst individuelle Stärken und unterstützt die fachliche Weiterentwicklung.

Venue Partnerships & Client Management

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere Venue-Partner in Deutschland und pflegst vertrauensvolle, langfristige Beziehungen.

  • Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern Marketingpläne und stimmst Kampagnen, Budgets und Maßnahmen auf den jeweiligen Veranstaltungskalender ab.

  • Du führst regelmäßige Abstimmungen mit unseren Partnern durch, präsentierst Ergebnisse und leitest konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen ab.

  • Du unterstützt die Geschäftsführung bei Präsentationen, Pitches und der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.

  • Du koordinierst B2B-Marketingaktivitäten und stellst relevante Markt-, Zielgruppen- und Brancheninformationen bereit.

Performance Marketing, CRM & Affiliate Marketing

  • Du analysierst die Ticketverkaufsentwicklung unserer Veranstaltungen, identifizierst Potenziale und entwickelst Maßnahmen zur Steigerung des Ticketabsatzes.

  • Du planst, steuerst und optimierst Performance-Marketing-Kampagnen über relevante digitale Kanäle, insbesondere Google, Meta und weitere Plattformen.

  • Du verantwortest die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Kampagnen hinsichtlich Zielgruppen, Creatives, Conversion, Tracking und Budgeteinsatz.

  • Du koordinierst CRM- und E-Mail-Marketing-Maßnahmen mit unseren zentralen Teams und entwickelst zielgerichtete Kampagnen zur Kundenbindung und Umsatzsteigerung.

  • Du entwickelst Maßnahmen zur Gewinnung neuer Nutzer:innen und zum Ausbau unserer Datenbank, App-Nutzung und eigenen Marketingkanäle.

  • Du baust Affiliate-Partnerschaften auf, entwickelst bestehende Kooperationen weiter und optimierst deren Performance.

Brand Building, Social Media & Fan Growth

  • Du stärkst die Markenbekanntheit und Positionierung von AXS auf dem deutschen Markt und entwickelst Maßnahmen zur nachhaltigen Fan- und Kundengewinnung.

  • Du verantwortest unsere Social-Media-Aktivitäten auf Plattformen wie Instagram, Facebook, TikTok und YouTube einschließlich Content-Planung, Community Management und Performance-Auswertung.

  • Du entwickelst kreative Marketingkampagnen, Gewinnspiele und Kooperationen, um Reichweite, Engagement und Markenbekanntheit zu steigern.

  • Du identifizierst Potenziale für PR-Aktivitäten, Markenpartnerschaften sowie Kooperationen mit Communities, Content Creators und Influencer:innen.

  • Du beobachtest Markttrends, Wettbewerber und erfolgreiche Marketingansätze und leitest daraus neue Ideen für AXS Germany ab.

Content Marketing & SEO

  • Du entwickelst und optimierst zielgruppenrelevante Inhalte für unsere digitalen Plattformen, insbesondere für Veranstaltungs-, Künstler:innen- und Venue-Seiten.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren zentralen Content- und SEO-Teams zusammen, um Sichtbarkeit, Reichweite und organischen Traffic im deutschen Markt zu verbessern.

Reporting, Analytics & Tracking

  • Du erstellst regelmäßige Performance-Reports und Dashboards für interne Stakeholder sowie unsere Venue-Partner und leitest daraus konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Du nutzt Daten und Analysen, um Marketingentscheidungen fundiert zu treffen und den Erfolg unserer Maßnahmen messbar zu machen.

  • Du unterstützt gemeinsam mit unseren Analytics-Teams die Weiterentwicklung von Tracking, Datenqualität und technischen Optimierungen, beispielsweise im Bereich Server-Side-Tagging und Cookie-Management.

European & Global Marketing Collaboration

  • Du arbeitest eng mit unseren europäischen und globalen Marketingteams zusammen, teilst Best Practices und überträgst erfolgreiche Ansätze auf den deutschen Markt.

  • Du vertrittst die Anforderungen des deutschen Marktes gegenüber den zentralen Teams und unterstützt die Weiterentwicklung gemeinsamer Marketinginitiativen.

Qualifikation

  • Du verfügst über mindestens 8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im digitalen Marketing und bringst fundierte Expertise im Performance Marketing sowie nachweisbare Erfolge im Markenaufbau und in der Steigerung von Reichweite und Umsatz mit.

  • Du hast ein gutes Verständnis für die Live-Entertainment-, Veranstaltungs- oder Ticketingbranche oder vergleichbare Konsumgütermärkte.

  • Du verfügst über nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Optimierung von Conversion und Ticketverkäufen durch Paid Media, CRM, Partnerschaften und datenbasierte Marketingmaßnahmen.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Agenturen und kanalübergreifenden Marketingkampagnen, insbesondere über Google, Meta und TikTok. Kenntnisse in YouTube Marketing sind von Vorteil.

  • Du bist sicher im Umgang mit Marketingkennzahlen, Performance-Reportings, Analysen und datenbasierten Optimierungsprozessen.

  • Du überzeugst durch ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten und hast Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kund:innen, Geschäftspartnern und Führungskräften auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen.

  • Du verbindest strategisches Denken mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität und hast idealerweise bereits Teams geführt oder jüngere Kolleg:innen fachlich weiterentwickelt.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, eigenverantwortlich und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Projekten und engen Deadlines den Überblick.

  • Du bist neugierig auf digitale Entwicklungen, neue Plattformen und Trends und bringst eine ausgeprägte Test-and-Learn-Mentalität mit.

  • Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und sehr gut auf Englisch – schriftlich wie mündlich – und bist erfahren in der Lokalisierung von Marketingmaterialien für unterschiedliche Märkte

  • Du arbeitest zielorientiert, schätzt die Zusammenarbeit in einem agilen Team und bringst kreative Ansätze für den Ticketvertrieb ein.

Benefits

  • Erlebe Live-Emotionen hautnah: Gänsehautmomente mit den populärsten Bands und Künstler unserer Zeit – in einem einzigartigen Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitanstellung mit transparenter Kommunikation in einem wachsenden Unternehmen sowie attraktiven Benefits.

  • Ein starkes Team, das auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitet, durch Hilfsbereitschaft überzeugt und eine offene Come-as-you-are-Kultur lebt – Vielfalt und Wertschätzung sind bei uns selbstverständlich.

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs – für echten Teamspirit und kurze Wege.

  • Nachhaltige Benefits wie E-Bike-Leasing und ÖPNV-Zuschuss zur Verbesserung deines ökologischen Fußabdrucks.

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und kontinuierliches Feedback fördern Zusammenhalt und persönliche Weiterentwicklung.

Art der Stelle: Vollzeit

Leistungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Gleitzeit

  • Homeoffice-Möglichkeit

  • Kostenlose Getränke

Sprache:

  • Deutsch, Englisch (verhandlungssicher)

jobs.title: Teknisk leder - Digital gravferdsmelding
jobs.employer: STATSFORVALTEREN I VESTFOLD OG TELEMARK AVD TØNSBERG
jobs.description:
Bli litt bedre kjent med oss

Vi søker en teknisk leder/senior fullstackutvikler i 100 % fast stilling!

Digital gravferdsmelding (DGM) er en nasjonal digital tjeneste som skal gjøre det enklere og tryggere for etterlatte å håndtere gravferd. Tjenesten forvaltes av Statsforvalteren i Vestfold og Telemark på vegne av Barne- og familiedepartementet, i samarbeid med Digitaliseringsdirektoratet, og brukes av både innbyggere og aktører i gravferdssektoren. 

Vi utvikler tjenester for mennesker i en sårbar livssituasjon. Det stiller høye krav til korrekthet, trygghet, personvern og god brukerforståelse. Nå bygger vi opp varig intern kompetanse med fast stilling som skal bidra til å videreutvikle løsningen teknisk og faglig i årene som kommer.

Hos oss vil du få en sentral rolle i et lite og tverrfaglig miljø, der teknologi, regelverk og samfunnsoppdrag henger tett sammen. 

Hva går jobben ut på?

Som teknisk leder / senior fullstackutvikler får du det overordnede tekniske ansvaret for videreutvikling, drift og forvaltning av Digital gravferdsmelding. 

Du vil jobbe tett med produkteierteamet, jurist og øvrige utviklere, og bidra til at DGM utvikles som en robust, sikker og endringsdyktig tjeneste. Rollen passer for deg som både liker å utvikle selv og å sette retning for andre, og som trives med å gjøre tekniske vurderinger i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, fag og regelverk.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Aktuelle arbeidsoppgaver vil blant annet være å: 

  • ha overordnet teknisk ansvar for videreutvikling, drift og forvaltning av DGM 
  • sette teknisk retning og bidra til en robust, sikker og endringsdyktig arkitektur 
  • sikre at løsningen utvikles etter prinsipper for security by design og privacy by design 
  • omsette behov fra produkt, regelverk og sektor til gode tekniske løsninger 
  • koordinere tekniske avhengigheter mot nasjonale felleskomponenter og øvrige integrasjoner 
  • bidra aktivt i utviklingsarbeidet, både backend og frontend ved behov 
  • støtte teamet i tekniske valg, kodekvalitet og utviklingspraksis 
  • prioritere og redusere teknisk gjeld 
  • bidra til at sikkerhetsvurderinger, personvernkonsekvenser og sporbarhet ivaretas i tekniske valg 
Hvilken kompetanse er viktig i denne rollen?

Krav:

  • relevant høyere utdanning innen IT 
  • solid erfaring med systemutvikling og teknisk arkitektur 
  • solid erfaring med backendutvikling, fortrinnsvis i .NET/C# 
  • erfaring med frontendutvikling i React og TypeScript, eller tilsvarende 
  • erfaring med API-design, integrasjoner og moderne arkitekturmønstre 
  • erfaring med CI/CD og moderne utviklingsprosesser 
  • erfaring med løsninger med høye krav til korrekthet, sikkerhet og personvern 
  • du må kunne uttrykke deg godt både skriftlig og muntlig på norsk. Statsforvalteren bruker begge målformer 

Ønskelig:

  • erfaring med Altinn og nasjonale felleskomponenter som Maskinporten, ID-porten eller Ansattporten 
  • erfaring med hendelsesbasert arkitektur, modulær monolitt, DDD og/eller CQRS-lignende mønstre 
  • erfaring med teknisk ledelse og veiledning av utviklere 
  • erfaring med containere, Kubernetes og plattformnære arbeidsformer 
  • erfaring med KI-verktøy i utviklingsarbeid og med å bygge agentbaserte arbeidsflyter 
  • kjennskap til offentlig sektor og forvaltning 
  • kjennskap til personvernvennlig systemdesign og relevante risikovurderinger 
Hva ser vi etter hos deg?

Vi ser etter deg som: 

  • har god vurderingsevne og evne til å se tekniske valg i en større sammenheng 
  • arbeider strukturert og målrettet 
  • evner å kombinere hands-on utvikling med teknisk lederskap 
  • har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner 
  • trives i et lite miljø der man må bidra bredt 
  • er en konstruktiv bidragsyter i et sterkt fagmiljø 

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt. 

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?

Vi kan tilby: 

  • lønn med stillingskode 1346 seniorrådgiver fra kr 950 000 – 1 080 000 per år. For særlig godt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes
  • en nøkkelrolle i et lite, kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø 
  • stor påvirkning på den tekniske retningen for en nasjonal tjeneste 
  • et oppdrag med høy samfunnsverdi og reell kompleksitet 
  • tett samarbeid med nasjonale fagmiljøer 
  • gode muligheter for faglig utvikling 
  • pensjonsordning gjennom Statens pensjonskasse (det blir trukket 2 % pensjonsinnskudd fra lønnen)
  • gode sosiale ordninger med fleksibel arbeidstid, og mulighet for fjernarbeid/hjemmekontor etter avtale med leder
  • moderne kontorlokaler i Tønsberg med to minutts gange fra buss- og jernbanestasjon
Verdt å merke seg før du søker hos oss

Kontorsted for stillingen vil være Tønsberg. Vi tar forbehold om endring av oppgavene til stillingen. Det er 6 måneder prøvetid i stillingen.

Det gjøres oppmerksom på at opplysninger om søkeren kan bli offentliggjort, selv om søkeren har bedt om ikke å bli oppført på offentlig søkerliste. 

Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal speile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte til å søke.

Trenger du mer informasjon om stillingen eller om oss? Da er det bare å ringe prosjektleder Ola Asp på telefon 33 37 11 34/ 91 86 82 49.

Vi ber om at søknad, med referanser, vedlagt vitnemål og relevante attester, sendes elektronisk via jobbnorge.no. 

Søknadsfrist: 15. november 2026.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Statsforvalteren er statens representant i fylket. Gjennom tilsyn, veiledning og dialog følger vi opp Stortingets og regjeringens vedtak, mål og retningslinjer. En sentral oppgave er å ivareta rettsikkerheten til innbyggerne og være klageinstans for kommunale vedtak. Statsforvalteren utfører i tillegg forvaltningsoppgaver for departementene innenfor miljøvern, landbruk, utdanning, helse, beredskap og sosial- og familierett.

Inkludering og mangfold er en styrke, og vi ønsker medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiv for å bidra til enda bedre oppgaveløsning.Statsforvalteren i Vestfold og Telemark har ca. 210 medarbeidere. Vi har kontor i Skien og Tønsberg. Hovedkontoret ligger i Skien. Innen utløpet av 2029 skal embetet ha halvparten av de ansatte ved hvert av kontorstedene.

jobs.title: Social Media & External Communication Manager
jobs.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own how Agent F and its founder show up in the world: on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, on the blog and in the newsletter, in the press, on podcasts and stages, and in the ecosystem around us. You will create and distribute content every day, run the founder’s profiles, manage relationships with journalists and media makers, and keep the network warm.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

You will work closely with the Online Marketing Manager, who owns paid channels and the funnel. You own the organic, owned and earned side: the brand, the voice, the content and the relationships.

What you will build and own

  • The founder’s presence. Positioning, editorial calendar, drafting and publishing, replies and community. The founder reviews; you run it.

  • The company’s channels. LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, blog, newsletter. One voice, one visual identity, a cadence that does not slip.

  • Daily content. Posts, short videos, articles, visuals. Take one idea and make it work across formats and channels.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. You can show us a channel you grew, a piece that worked and one that did not, and a press placement you earned. You are fast, consistent and allergic to empty posts, and you are comfortable approaching journalists and strangers.

Core experience

  • Daily content production across LinkedIn and at least one video platform, with measurable audience growth.

  • Writing in German and English for a professional audience; editing short video; working with design and AI tools.

  • Running a founder’s or an executive’s public profile.

  • Press and media relations: pitching, placing, maintaining relationships.

  • Community and network management in a B2B context.

  • Reading analytics and adjusting content to what works.

Useful additional experience

Experience in fintech, software or Mittelstand communications; newsletter growth; event and speaking logistics; working with PR agencies; podcast production.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set the editorial rhythm for the founder and the company, get daily publishing running, refresh the channels and the brand assets, and place the first press and podcast appearances around our announcements.

We would look for the daily cadence holding, audience growing in the right segments, engagement rising and the first inbound conversations that trace back to content.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in a brand that is consistent and a voice that is credible. Content ships daily, including during launches and travel. Press and public reactions are monitored and answered the same day.

When an announcement, a launch or a public issue needs attention outside normal hours, you are there, you keep the founder informed and you handle it with judgement.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the founder on their presence, with the Online Marketing Manager on content and amplification, and with sales on customer stories. You will use AI tools for drafting, editing and analysis and remain responsible for the voice and the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

Start a conversation

Share a channel you grew and three pieces of content you are proud of (at least one of them for a B2B audience). Tell us what worked, what did not and what you would publish for Agent F in your first week.

jobs.title: Online Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own online marketing at Agent F from the first click to live revenue. Ad spend per channel, the funnels behind it, the landing pages, the email sequences, the tracking: all of it is yours to build, measure and improve. You will produce funnel content yourself, brief agencies and freelancers for the rest, and run experiments until the numbers move.

The idea is simple and unusual for our category: sell business software the way consumer products are sold online. Our buyers are finance and operations leaders at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies, and they search, click, compare and book like everyone else. You will find the channels, messages and paths that bring them to a demo or a sign-up at a cost that works, and you will keep looking for the next growth hack when the last one stops working.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means pipeline and live ARR that trace back to marketing.

What you will build and own

  • Paid acquisition. Budget allocation across channels, campaign setup and optimisation, creative testing. Cut what does not convert; scale what does.

  • Funnels and conversion. Landing pages, sign-up and demo-booking flows, email nurture. Continuous experimentation, measured against one dashboard. Work with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path.

  • Search and discoverability. Organic and AI-search visibility: the content and pages that bring qualified traffic, with the technical basics handled with engineering.

  • Content for the funnel. Ads, landing copy, lead magnets and sequences produced in-house; agencies and freelancers briefed and managed for the rest.

  • Measurement. Attribution from spend to live ARR; cost per lead, cost per qualified opportunity, cost per signed and per live euro of ARR. Weekly reporting to sales and leadership.

  • Lead hand-over. Define what a qualified lead is together with the Head of Sales, hand it over cleanly and close the loop on what became pipeline.

For example, a paid campaign brings traffic but few demo bookings. You would look at the landing page, the audience and the offer, run two or three variants, move the budget to what converts, and report the change in cost per qualified opportunity the following week.

What you bring

You have four or more years in performance or growth marketing for B2B software, with full ownership of a budget and a conversion target. You have run paid channels, built landing pages and funnels, and you can show the numbers.

You can explain an experiment that worked and one that did not, what you measured and what you changed. You are comfortable with analytics tools, spreadsheets and tracking, and you use AI tools for content and analysis every day. You do not need to be loud; you need to be curious, rigorous and fast.

Core experience

  • Paid acquisition across search, social and display for B2B software, with owned budgets.

  • Landing pages, funnels and conversion optimisation, including A/B testing.

  • Search and AI-search visibility: content, structure, technical basics.

  • Email marketing and lead nurturing.

  • Analytics, tracking and attribution; working comfortably in spreadsheets and dashboards.

  • Producing funnel content in German and English with AI tools; briefing agencies and freelancers.

Useful additional experience

Marketing for ERP, accounting or finance software; product-led growth and self-serve funnels; marketing automation and CRM integration; programmatic or data-driven content.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would set up the measurement, take over the existing channels and pages, and run the first experiments on the highest-volume path from ad to demo. You would agree the definition of a qualified lead with sales and start reporting weekly.

We would look for a falling cost per qualified opportunity, more qualified traffic, a funnel that converts better each month and pipeline that sales can confirm.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in numbers that are correct and campaigns that run clean. Campaigns and funnels are monitored daily; broken tracking, failing pages or runaway spend are fixed the same day.

You keep sales informed about what is coming into the funnel and close the loop on what happened to it. When a launch or a campaign needs attention outside normal hours, you are there.

How you will work

You report to the CEO and work closely with the Head of Sales on lead quality, with the Social Media & External Communication Manager on content and amplification, and with the Product Design Engineer on the product’s self-serve path. You will use AI tools for content, analysis and reporting and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. German and English are required.

Share a funnel or campaign you owned end to end. Tell us the budget, the numbers before and after, the experiments you ran and what you would do next. Screenshots of dashboards are welcome.

You will build that chain with the CEO and then own it end to end.

You will sell. Our buyers are CEOs, CFOs and heads of finance at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies: an experienced audience that values clarity, numbers and reliability over charm. You will open those conversations, run them to signature and stay with the account until it is live, paying and expanding. Key accounts are a team effort: the CEO is in the room with you, and the whole company pulls through to go-live.

You will also build the sales organisation. Two Growth & Sales Managers work with you from day one; more will follow. You are their functional lead: you review their pipeline, join their calls, coach them on deals and give them a playbook that works. The foundation you lay is what lets the team scale without losing its direction.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain.

What you will build and own

  • The revenue chain. Define each stage from first conversation to expansion, give it an owner, a conversion rate and a cycle time, and report the whole chain weekly in one view.

  • Your own accounts. Carry a quota. Lead enterprise and corporate accounts together with the CEO; own mid-market deals outright. Stay with every account through go-live and into expansion.

  • The sales playbook. ICP definitions, qualification criteria, demo script, proposal and pricing standards, go-live hand-over, expansion motion. Not a document: the operating system of the sales team.

  • The team. Weekly pipeline and deal reviews, joint customer meetings, ramp plans for new team members. Measure output, coach on it, raise the bar with every hire.

  • Signed to live. Work with the Forward Deployed Engineers so that every signed customer goes live inside the onboarding SLA. No deal is done until the customer is live and paying.

  • Live to expansion. Own the expansion motion: additional modules, seats, usage, further entities. Own net revenue retention.

  • Business development. Partnerships, resellers and implementation partners where they produce live ARR faster than direct sales.

For example, a corporate subsidiary with three entities signs for one of them. You would run the go-live with the Forward Deployed Engineer, make sure the first entity is live and reconciled inside the SLA, and have the expansion to the other two entities agreed before the first invoice is paid.

What you bring

You have ten or more years in B2B software sales, with personal closes at C-level and a track record that includes a phase of extreme growth, for example from a handful of customers to a team of twenty or more, or from near zero to tens of millions in revenue. You have built or materially shaped a playbook that other people then ran successfully.

You can walk us through a deal you closed with an experienced buyer, what the buyer needed to see, how you got to signature, and what happened after. You can also show us a team member who became better because of you.

Core experience

  • Full-cycle B2B software sales to finance, operations or executive buyers, with personal quota attainment.

  • Selling to German-speaking corporate and Mittelstand buyers; fluent German and English.

  • Building a playbook, a pipeline process and a forecast that a team then runs.

  • Coaching and developing sales people; running pipeline and deal reviews.

  • Expansion and retention of existing customers; net revenue retention as an owned number.

  • CRM discipline: stages, next steps, forecast accuracy as a matter of course.

  • Daily use of AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up.

Useful additional experience

ERP, accounting or financial operations software; channel and partner sales; implementation-heavy products where go-live is part of the sale; experience alongside a technical implementation team.

What early progress could look like

In your first months, you would take over the active pipeline, close your first deals with the CEO and alone, and write down the playbook as you go. You would set up the weekly revenue view, run the first pipeline reviews with the Growth & Sales Managers and agree the signed-to-live hand-over with the Forward Deployed Engineers.

We would look for closed deals, customers going live inside the SLA, a forecast that holds, and team members whose numbers are improving. The exact priorities will follow the pipeline you find.

Operational excellence and customer commitments

You take pride in customers who are live, paying and growing. When a signed customer’s go-live is at risk, a live customer threatens to churn or a key deal needs a decision now, you respond the same day, take the lead with the customer and stay on it until it is resolved or explicitly handed over.

Customer commitments shape how we work. You are willing to interrupt planned work, travel to a customer and stay engaged when a go-live, a renewal or a financial deadline is at risk. You keep people informed and see the issue through. Afterwards, you improve the playbook so the same situation becomes less likely.

How you will work

This is a senior role in a small team. You report to the CEO and are the functional lead of the Growth & Sales Managers; line management for everyone stays with the CEO. You will work closely with the Forward Deployed Engineers on go-live and with marketing on top of funnel. You will use AI tools for research, preparation and follow-up and remain responsible for the result.

Everyone shares responsibility for the whole company and the customer outcome. You will pick up the most important work or whatever is on fire, including tasks outside your specialty. You take initiative, bring in the right expertise and stay involved until the problem is resolved. Customer impact and urgency determine where you focus.

The role is full-time and based in Berlin. We work from our offices in Neukölln and Mitte and expect regular presence there. Hybrid arrangements with regular days in the Berlin office are possible in exceptional cases. Travel to customers across the DACH region is part of the role. Fluent German is required.

Share a deal you closed with an experienced buyer and an account you grew afterwards. Tell us what the customer needed to see, how you got to signature, what happened at go-live and how you expanded. If you have built a playbook or a team, show us what it looked like and what it produced.

  • The second brain. Own the internal knowledge and workflow system and its AI agents. Every recurring task is automated or delegated before it gets a second owner.

  • Legal and admin operations. Contract templates and signatures, notary and registry processes, insurance, the compliance register, data-protection documentation. Work with external counsel; own the follow-through.

  • People operations. Assist in onboarding new hires, keep the hiring process running (scheduling, candidate communication, paperwork) and handle contracts and equity documentation.

  • Investor and board operations. Monthly updates, data room, KPI pack, meeting logistics; the numbers are ready on time.

What you bring

You have five or more years in roles that combined operating responsibility with structure: startup operations, finance operations, consulting followed by an operating role, or a founder’s office in a scaling company. You have run a function end to end and can show processes that still work without you.

You can explain how you took a messy, recurring piece of work and made it disappear (through a process, a tool or an automation) and what it freed up. You are comfortable with numbers, contracts and tools, and you use AI tools to build automations as a matter of course.

Core experience

Useful additional experience

jobs.title: Magazijnier Fashion & Lifestyle
jobs.description:
Ben je op zoek naar een afwisselende job waarin je actief bezig bent en graag de handen uit de mouwen steekt? Werk je nauwkeurig, hou je van een dynamische werkomgeving en haal je energie uit samenwerken met collega’s? Dan hebben wij misschien wel de ideale job voor jou!

Voor een groeiend bedrijf in de fashion- en lifestylesector in Grobbendonk zijn we op zoek naar gemotiveerde magazijniers die het team willen versterken. Samen zorgen jullie ervoor dat alles in het magazijn vlot en efficiënt verloopt!

Als magazijnier krijg je een gevarieerd takenpakket en zorg je er samen met je collega’s voor dat alle logistieke processen vlot verlopen. Je taken bestaan onder andere uit:

  • Het nauwkeurig verzamelen van bestellingen (orderpicking).
  • Het verpakken van kleding met verschillende verpakkingsmaterialen.
  • Het klaarmaken van bestellingen voor verzending.
  • Het verwerken en controleren van retourzendingen.
  • Het ontvangen, controleren en verzenden van goederen.
  • De mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar de functie van machinebestuurder.

Je komt terecht in een dynamische en groeiende logistieke omgeving waar geen dag hetzelfde is. Flexibiliteit, nauwkeurigheid en teamwork staan centraal. We zoeken iemand die graag initiatief neemt, actief meedenkt en samen met het team wil bijdragen aan de verdere groei van het bedrijf.

We zijn op zoek naar een gemotiveerde en enthousiaste logistieke medewerker die graag actief bezig is en zich thuis voelt in een dynamische magazijnomgeving.

  • Je steekt graag de handen uit de mouwen, neemt verantwoordelijkheid en ziet zelf waar je kunt helpen.
  • Je bent flexibel en bereid om in twee ploegen te werken: de vroege ploeg van 06u00 tot 14u00 en de late ploeg van 14u00 tot 22u00.
  • Je beschikt over eigen vervoer om je vlot naar het werk te verplaatsen.
  • Je communiceert vlot in het Nederlands of Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
  • Ervaring als magazijnier, orderpicker, logistiek medewerker of warehousemedewerker is een pluspunt, maar geen must.
  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor kwaliteit en functioneert goed in teamverband.
  • Je bent gemotiveerd, leergierig en hebt vooral een positieve ingesteldheid.

Herken je jezelf in dit profiel? Ben je een betrouwbare en enthousiaste collega die graag initiatief neemt en samen met het bedrijf wil groeien? Dan kijken we ernaar uit om jou te leren kennen!

Onze studentenplanning is momenteel volledig ingevuld!
