jobs.title: DIAS Professor in Clinical Translational Psychiatry and Centre Leader for the Elite Centre for Clinical and Translational Psychiatry at Odense University Hospital and the University of Southern Denmark
jobs.description:
The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS), the Department of Clinical Research at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and the Region of Southern Denmark seek an outstanding candidate to fill a fully tenured Professor position in the field of clinical translational psychiatry. The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

The candidate is expected to start by agreement.

We seek an exceptional researcher with demonstrated excellence in their discipline and a proven ability to push boundaries, challenge conventions, and engage in groundbreaking interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in their field while fostering collaboration across disciplines, embracing DIAS’s mission of curiosity-driven research. The ideal candidate will have a strong international research profile, an outstanding record of attracting competitive research funding, and a demonstrated ability to conduct interdisciplinary research. The successful candidate will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research, DIAS, and the Region, and must be prepared to engage in multiple and diverse research environments at SDU and in the Region of Southern Denmark. 

What we offer

  • The opportunity to lead a new elite centre for clinical and translational psychiatry, with five-year funding of DKK 17 million (equivalent to Euro 2.3 million), with the potential for a five-year extension.

  • A strong interdisciplinary research environment through DIAS, comprising leading academics across medicine, science, and the humanities, with the opportunity to collaborate with outstanding researchers across SDU’s five faculties.

  • Access to state-of-the-art research facilities at the newly built Odense University Hospital (OUH), where psychiatry and somatic care are integrated to foster collaboration between these fields.

  • Comprehensive research support services from DIAS and SDU, targeting prestigious funding such as DNRF, ERC, and grants from Danish private foundations.

  • If recruited from abroad or from industry, the candidate will be eligible for a fast-track DKK 11 million  (equivalent to Euro 1.5 million ) Lundbeck Foundation Start-Up grant.

  • Reduced teaching obligations compared to a standard professorship, allowing the candidate to focus on research and leadership within the elite centre.

Who we are looking for 

We are seeking a highly accomplished researcher with expertise in the field of clinical translational psychiatry, who is eager to engage in collaborative activities within the DIAS framework. 

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

  • A commitment to engaging in boundary-crossing interdisciplinary research and dialogue. 

  • A record of internationally competitive research activities at the highest level of ambition. 

  • Publications in high-level peer-reviewed academic journals and leading innovative research programmes in clinical psychiatry. 

  • An ability to attract significant external funding to support independent and collaborative research initiatives.

  • Engagement in the international academic society. 

  • Extensive experience in building and leading multidisciplinary research teams that integrate basic and clinical sciences, with an emphasis on translational research spanning from laboratory findings to clinical trials.

  • A research focus in areas such as child and adolescent psychiatry, clinical psychopharmacology, epidemiology, molecular neurobiology, substance use disorders, or serious mental illness.

  • The ability to develop a translational research programme in one or more of the mentioned fields, with a focus on building cooperative, multidisciplinary teams that bridge basic science and the design and execution of early-phase clinical trials.

  • A demonstrated commitment to mentorship, teaching, and leadership, fostering the next generation of researchers in interdisciplinary research environments.

  • Experience at Full or Associate Professor level within relevant fields.

  • Fluency in English

The Danish Institute for Advanced Study (DIAS)

DIAS at SDU is a hub for interdisciplinary excellence at and beyond the frontier of knowledge, bringing together outstanding researchers from various disciplines to foster groundbreaking interdisciplinary research and bold innovation. DIAS nurtures a collaborative and curiosity-driven environment, encouraging scholars to think outside the box and challenge conventional boundaries. The institute values open-minded exploration and an ambitious yet collegial atmosphere with a strong sense of community. Researchers affiliated with DIAS are expected to contribute actively to DIAS activities, mentor DIAS fellows, and engage in interdisciplinary collaborations across faculties and departments, both nationally and internationally.  

The Department of Clinical Research

The Department of Clinical Research does translational research spanning from basic research to patient care, within both somatics and psychiatry. The interdisciplinary research aims to improve patient treatment, health, and well-being. Researchers at the institute often have joint appointments between clinic, research, and education, ensuring a strong academic foundation for the research at Odense University Hospital (OUH) and in psychiatry. The researchers at the Department of Clinical Research primarily consist of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals with main employment at OUH.

The Centre for Clinical and Translational PsychiatryThe centre will be based at the new Odense University Hospital, which integrates psychiatric and somatic care to promote close collaboration between the fields. The hospital includes a state-of-the-art adult psychiatric department with around 600 employees, 142 single rooms, and specialized sections for joint somatic-psychiatric care, rehabilitation, telepsychiatry, and more. The child and adolescent psychiatric department cover the entire region with about 600 employees, two inpatient wards with a total of 34 beds, and outpatient clinics at four geographical sites.The centre’s aim is to advance novel psychiatric research through innovative approaches that will significantly impact future patient care. This includes translating discoveries from the laboratory to clinical settings, whether within narrow clinical fields or through broader cross-disciplinary collaborations that involve various clinical functions, professions, and institutions.

Additional informationFor further information about being a professor at DIAS, please contact DIAS director Sten Rynning at +45 6550 2193 or via email at director-dias@sdu.dk For further information and questions about the position, please contact the Head of the Department of Clinical Research Rikke Leth-Larsen at +456550 3477 or via email at rllarsen@health.sdu.dk or Medical Director Bjarne Dahler-Eriksen, Odense University Hospital, at +4523284068 or via email at bde@rsyd.dk. You may also contact the Vice Dean for Research and Innovation at the Faculty of Health Sciences, SDU, Uffe Holmskov at +45 6550 3775 or via email at uholmskov@health.sdu.dk regarding the position.

Application, salary, and employment terms

This position will be attached to the Department of Clinical Research in Odense. The successful candidate will be expected to regularly engage in DIAS activities and interdisciplinary cooperation in Odense. 

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). 

For more details on salary and taxation, please refer to the provided links about salary and taxation.

Teaching obligations will be reduced compared to a standard professorship at SDU, allowing more time for research and leadership activities.

Application requirements

Applications must be submitted electronically via the "Apply now" link provided below.

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

The application must include the following:

  • A motivation letter.

  • A detailed Curriculum Vitae (CV), including contacts for possible references.

  • Copies of relevant certificates/diplomas.

  • A teaching portfolio detailing previous teaching experience.

  • A complete list of publications, highlighting those most relevant to the position.

  • Up to ten of the most relevant publications

  • A research and publication plan for the next five years, including a description of synergy with the department's activities and the potential to benefit from DIAS’s interdisciplinary environment.

All application materials must be submitted in English, and only applications written in English will be considered.

Submission guidelines

  • Files must be submitted in PDF format, with each file no larger than 10 MB.

  • If multiple files are needed for a single section, combine them into one PDF file.

  • Zip files, image files (jpg, png, etc.), and password-protected PDF files will not be accepted. All PDF files must be unlocked to allow binding.

  • The application deadline is February 7, 2027, at 23:59 CET. Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

Applications that are incomplete with regards to the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed by the committee. Shortlisting and tests may be used in the recruitment process and references may be obtained.  

We recommend that international applicants take the time to visit the websites of Work in Denmark and the International Staff Office at SDU. Here you will find information and facts about moving to, working, and living in Denmark.

Assessment

Shortlisting may be used as part of the recruitment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material.  

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive the part of the evaluation that concerns themselves.

About SDU

SDU is committed to fostering a diverse staff that reflects society’s diversity. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of personal background.

SDU was founded in 1966 and now has over 27,000 students, nearly 20% of whom are international. SDU employs more than 3,800 staff and offers 115 study programmes across disciplines such as the humanities, social sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, and engineering. While SDU’s main campus is in Odense, it also has campuses in other locations.Equal opportunity employment

The University of Southern Denmark is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, colour, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability, pregnancy, or any other protected status.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes our staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. 

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to several security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

jobs.title: Front End Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About Seamflow

Every plane, medical device, lift, battery and building has to be tested, inspected and certified before it reaches the world. It's the invisible layer that keeps the physical economy safe, and it still runs on Word documents, PDFs, spreadsheets and email. Seamflow is the software layer for that industry. We build AI-powered workflows for certification bodies, notified bodies and inspection companies: scheduling and resource planning, technical review, conformity assessment, field inspection, and document intelligence over messy real-world files.

Where we are:

  • Live in production inside some of the largest enterprises in the industry

  • $4.5M seed, 14x oversubscribed, co-led by Northzone and Initialized Capital, the funds behind Spotify, Klarna, Coinbase and Reddit. Angels include Charlie Songhurst and Mario Götze.

  • Demand is outstripping what we can build. That's the reason this role exists.

The team

Most of our engineers were olympiad medallists in maths, physics or informatics before they were engineers. The team has come to us from Google, Amazon, X, Yandex, McKinsey and Bain, and from founding-engineer seats at startups that went on to multi-billion-dollar valuations. We hire against a very high bar, and this role exists to raise it further.

The role

A Front End Design Engineer thinks in finished interfaces, not mockups or components in isolation. A technical reviewer at a notified body spends their day inside a 400-page technical file, cross-referencing clauses, checking test reports against standards, and deciding whether a medical device is safe to sell. Today they do that in Word, Acrobat and a spreadsheet someone built in 2011. The interface they use decides how fast they work and whether they trust the AI sitting next to them.

You own that interface. Layout, typography, interaction, motion, the design system underneath it, and the React that ships it. You decide how a reviewer sees a finding, how they correct a model that got it wrong, and how a hundred fields of dense regulatory data become something a person can actually read. You sketch it, build it, ship it, then sit next to someone using it and find out what you got wrong. You'll ship to production in your first week.

What we're looking for

We care far more about taste and engineering strength than about matching a list of tools. If you're excellent, we'll hire you whether you've spent the last three years in React, Svelte, Vue or something we haven't heard of. Our stack is learnable in a fortnight. Judgement, craft and speed are not.

What we're actually screening for:

  • You've designed and built an interface that real people used every day. Not a Dribbble shot, not a component library nobody adopted. Something that shipped, got used, and got better.

  • You have taste, and you can defend it. Typography, spacing, motion, hierarchy. You notice when something is a few pixels off and you can explain why it matters.

  • You build the whole thing. Design, frontend, the state and data it sits on. You don't hand the code to someone else once the Figma is done, and you don't hand the design to someone else once the code is.

  • You can design for density. Expert users, complex workflows, hundreds of fields on a screen. Making that clear is much harder than making a landing page beautiful.

  • You go to the source. You'll watch a technical reviewer work through a real file, and you'll design for what they actually do rather than what the process diagram says.

Signals we like, none of them required:

design engineering or front-end roles at somewhere like Linear, Vercel, Notion or Figma, a design system you built and maintained, work on interfaces where people review or correct AI output, founder or ex-founder, founding team experience, EF / YC / Antler, early or stealth-stage startup.

This is probably not for you if

  • You want a strict boundary between work and life. We run one of the most ambitious startup cultures in Europe: fast paced, extremely high ownership, and in person in Shoreditch.

  • You want a well-defined ticket handed to you each morning.

  • You want to specialise narrowly and stay in your lane.

What you get

  • Real equity, and compensation that reflects a high bar

  • Genuine ownership of product surface area from day one, with the founders in the room

  • Relocation support and visa sponsorship, handled properly

  • Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access, and any tool that makes you faster

  • A small team with high standards, high trust, and no politics

If this sounds like your kind of problem, apply. A short note on the hardest thing you've built goes further with us than a polished CV.

jobs.title: Ravintolatilojen siivooja, Ruka
jobs.description:
Osa-aikainen siivooja ravintolatilojen siivoukseen


Etsimme asiakkaallemme luotettavia siivoajia ravintolatilojen siivoukseen. Työnkuvasi on siivota ravintolatiloja ja työvuorot tulevat painottumaan pe-ma välillä aamu-/päiväajalle klo. 06:00-13:00, mutta on myös arkivuoroja. Osan työstä pystymme myös suorittamaan klo. 13:00 jälkeenkin, joten työajat ovat joustavat oman käytettävyytesi mukaan. Työpäivien kesto vaihtelee riippuen siivottavasta kohteesta 4-6h. 

Kanssamme sinulla on mahdollisuus neuvotella työajoistasi, työpäivien määristä viikoittain sekä työajankohdista riippuen mahdollisista muista töistä, joita teet. Työ sopiikin joustavan luonteensa takia erinomaisesti esimerkiksi henkilöille, jotka haluavat osa-aikaisia töitä tai sitten lisätunteja oman työnsä oheen. 

Jotta olisit sopiva työhön, niin täytyy sinun olla valmis siivoamaan välillä hurjaksikin lipeävien juhlien railakkaita jälkiä. Siivoustekniikat, perusperehdytyksen työhön ja uudet ammattimaiset työvälineet tulet saamaan asiakkaaltamme, joten työhön voit hakea vaikka sinulla ei vielä kokemusta siivousalalta olisikaan. Toivomme kuitenkin, että et ole helposti säikähtävää luonnetta, sillä siivoustyön tiimellyksessä voit törmätä tahraan jos toiseenkin 

Tarjolla ei ole erikseen työn puolesta majoitusta, joten ennenkuin haet työtä, niin on sinulla oltava jo majoitus tai asunto lähialueella sekä tietenkin kulkuväline, jos liikut kauempaa kuin Rukan kylältä töihin. 

Palkkaa työtehtävästä maksetaan sopimuksen mukaisesti 12,59-14€/h + lisät kiinteistöpalvelualan työehtosopimusta noudattaen.

Töitä on tarjolla nopeimmille jo syksystä alkaen ja jatkuen ympäri vuoden sesonkeja kuitenkin mukaillen! 

In english;

Looking for someone living in Ruka or nearby to pick up extra hours in restaurant cleaning!

We are looking for reliable cleaners for our client who are interested in earning extra income through part-time cleaning work. Your job will be to clean restaurant spaces, with shifts primarily scheduled between Friday and Monday in the morning or daytime hours from 6:00AM to 1:00PM. Some tasks can also be completed after 1:00PM, making work hours flexible to fit your availability. The duration of each shift varies depending on the cleaning site, ranging from 4 to 6 hours.

With us, you have the opportunity to negotiate your working hours, the number of workdays per week, and the exact scheduling of shifts based on any other jobs or commitments you may have. Thanks to its flexible nature, this job is perfect for those looking for part-time work or extra hours alongside their primary job. 

To be suitable for this role, you should be prepared to clean up after some wild parties at times! You will receive training on cleaning techniques, a basic introduction to the job, and new professional cleaning equipment from our client, so you can apply even if you have no prior experience in the cleaning industry. However, we do hope youre not easily startled—because in this job, youll encounter all kinds of messes!

Accommodation is not provided as part of the job, so before applying, please make sure you already have a place to stay in the area and a means of transportation if youre commuting from outside Ruka village.

The salary for this role is between €12,26 and €14 per hour, plus additional compensation in accordance with the collective agreement for the real estate services industry.

Work is available for the quickest applicants starting from the Autumn, and can continue year-round, adjusting to seasonal demand!

Lisätietoja, some more details you can ask from: 

Julianna Grönberg
julianna.gronberg@wulff.fi

Wulff Works Etelä Oy

Meidän työntekijämme viihtyvät parhaiten asiakkaillamme! 


Wulff Works on se parempi henkilöstövuokrausyritys. Meillä konkarit etsivät sankareita: tunnistamme hyvät työpaikat ja työnantajat, jotka arvostavat tekijöitä. Palvelemme valtakunnallisesti ja tapaat meitä jo kahdeksalla paikkakunnalla Suomessa.

jobs.description: **The opportunity**Are you an organized and proactive professional who enjoys keeping things running smoothly and supporting others to succeed? We are looking for a Site Administrator to join our Nordic Grid Integration organization and support the successful execution of substation projects across Finland, Sweden and Denmark.The position can be based in Finland (Helsinki, Tampere or Vaasa), Sweden (Västerås, Ludvika or Stockholm) or Denmark (Middelfart or Ballerup). Depending on the project phase, the role involves travel to project sites approximately 1–3 days per week in Finland, Sweden or Denmark.In this role, you will be an important part of our project organization, supporting Site Managers as well as Civil and Electrical Engineering teams with a wide range of administrative and coordination activities. From onboarding and reporting to travel arrangements, documentation and day-to-day site administration, your work will help our project teams stay organized and focused on delivering high-quality projects.This is an exciting opportunity to work in an international project environment, collaborate with colleagues across the Nordics and contribute to projects that are enabling the energy transition.**How you'll make an impact**- Coordinate day-to-day site administration, including registers, calendars, contact information and SharePoint content. - Support the onboarding and induction of site personnel and maintain relevant attendance and personnel records. - Coordinate and consolidate reporting inputs from Engineering, HSE, Quality and Project Controls. - Support effective document management by maintaining administrative files and helping project teams locate relevant information and documentation. - Assist with the preparation of documentation and supporting evidence for internal and external audits. - Coordinate practical arrangements such as travel, accommodation, local transportation and office services. - Maintain lessons learned records and support administrative activities during project closeout. - Work closely with Site Managers, project teams and other internal and external stakeholders across the Nordic organization. **Your background**- A relevant qualification in business, project or office administration, or equivalent experience. - Previous experience in a project, construction site or technical office environment would be an advantage. - Strong MS Office skills. - Good organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage several activities and priorities simultaneously. - Experience in meeting coordination, reporting and document management. - A proactive and service-oriented approach, with the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different teams and stakeholders. - Fluent written and spoken skills in local language. Strong skills in English. - Willingness and ability to travel within the Nordic countries according to project need

jobs.title: Pomocníci v kuchyni
jobs.description: Pomocný pracovník/Pomocná pracovníčka v kuchyni vykonáva predprípravné práce pri príprave potravín na varenie a manipuláciu s nimi. Obsluhuje jednoduché kuchynské stroje a zariadenia. Zabezpečuje udržiavanie čistoty vo všetkých priestoroch prevádzky, suchých skladov, mraziacich boxov a šatne. Zabezpečuje pomocné práce v kuchyni: pomoc pri uskladňovaní potravín do kuchyne pod dohľadom kuchára, pomoc pri vyskladňovaní potravín z kuchyne. Rovnako pomáha pri hrubej príprave potravín pod dohľadom kuchára, za podmienok splnenia prísnych hygienických podmienok (čistá a nečistá práca). Zabezpečuje umývanie riadu ručne alebo pomocou umývacích zariadení a jeho následné triedenie a uskladnenie. Spolupracuje s kuchármi a ostatným personálom. Zabezpečuje obsluhu a umývanie chladiacich zariadení, regálov, pracovných a výdajných stolov i veľkokuchynských zariadení. Zároveň zodpovedá za komplexné upratovanie kuchynskej prevádzky, okolitých priestorov, skladov či miestností súvisiacich s kuchynskou prevádzkou. Pomáha pri triedení odpadu, recykláciu obalov a skladovanie použitého oleja. Dbá na bezpečnosť pri práci, dodržiava zásady osobnej hygieny a hygieny na pracovisku. Nadriadeným pomocného pracovníka/pomocnej pracovníčky v kuchyni je zväčša kuchár/kuchárka, v závislosti od tipu a veľkosti výrobného strediska to môže byť šéf kuchár/kuchárka prípadne aj prevádzkar zodpovedný za úsek stravovania, kde títo zamestnanci preberajú kompetencie vyššieho riadiaceho pracovníka.

jobs.title: Pracovníci v oblasti predaja inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
V zime máme pre vás pripravenú pracovnú pozíciu, pri ktorej sa budete stretávať so zákazníkmi, ktorí si prišli aktívne zašportovať a oddýchnuť si na lyžiach, snowboarde alebo sa vybrať na skialp. Vašou úlohou bude poradiť im s výberom výstroje, ktorá je pre nich vhodná, a správne ju nastaviť. Aj v požičovni u nás vládne skvelá nálada, pretože práve tá je naším hlavným meradlom pri výbere správnych kolegov na všetky pozície v rezorte. Ak teda radi pomáhate ľuďom, máte zmysel pre precíznosť a spĺňate parameter „vždy dobrá nálada", berieme vás medzi nás.

Náplň práce:

požičiavanie a servis lyžiarskej výstroje a športových potrieb,

aktívny predaj a komunikácia s klientmi,

práca s peniazmi a registračnou pokladňou,

kontrola kvality a poškodenia výstroje s následným zabezpečením opravy, servisu, prípadne vyradenia.

Ak chcete stráviť zimu na horách, medzi ľuďmi, ktorí majú lyžovanie v krvi, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Kuchári (okrem šéfkuchárov)
jobs.description:
Hľadáme šikovného a spoľahlivého kuchára/kuchárku s vášňou pre gastronómiu, ktorý/á by chcel/a pôsobiť v úspešnom tíme reštaurácie Medvedí brloh. Reštaurácia sa nachádza priamo pod svahom Ski Centra Strachan v Ždiari, v malebnom prostredí pod hrebeňom Belianskych Tatier, v celodrevenej stavbe s prvkami pôvodnej goralskej architektúry a s terasou s výhľadom na okolité končiare. Cez deň je Medvedí brloh obľúbeným miestom na dobré jedlo, večer sa však mení na miesto veľkej zábavy, pravidelne tu organizujeme akcie so známymi DJmi.

Čo u nás budete robiť:

Príprava a výdaj jedál podľa jedálneho lístka, ktorý spája tradičné slovenské špeciality (halušky, pirohy) s modernými jedlami ako domáce burgre či pizza

Príprava sezónnych a regionálnych špecialít z kvalitných surovín

Práca v tíme profesionálnych kuchárov pod vedením skúseného šéfkuchára.

Pracovná doba:

Pracovné zmeny: krátky/dlhý týždeň alebo podľa dohody

Ak vás baví varenie, dobrá atmosféra a chcete byť súčasťou tímu obľúbenej reštaurácie priamo pod svahom, kde sa cez deň varí a večer tancuje, tešíme sa na Vás.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Inštruktori a cvičitelia športových rekreačných aktivít
jobs.description:
Predstavte si, že nastúpite do tímu 30 mladých ľudí a vašou najťažšou pracovnou úlohou bude... nájsť si medzi nimi nových kamarátov a kolegov. Cez deň budete v Ski school Strachan učiť ľudí prvé (alebo posledné pred pádom) oblúky na lyžiach či snowboarde, a večer, keď sa lekcie skončia, sa z vás aj z celého personálu Strachan Resortu stanú hviezdy parketu, teda skôr stola, v Medveďom brlohu.

Inštruktorom lyžovania alebo snowboardingu sa môžete stať aj bez skúseností, po kurze, na ktorý vám finančne prispejeme, pretože veríme, že najlepšia motivácia je zalyžovať si zadarmo na svahoch Ski centra Strachan aj Ski centra Strednica (a nie len teoreticky vedieť, kde je tá modrá zjazdovka). Máte radi voľnosť a flexibilitu? Do práce vás u nás nikto naháňať nebude, k nám sa chodí s nadšením, a to je presne to, čo na vás naši hostia uvidia už na prvom kruhu.

Zamestnanecké výhody a benefity:

práca v tíme mladých ľudí, s ktorými sa dá prežiť aj lyžovačka, aj afterpárty,

nádherné prostredie Belianskych Tatier, kancelária s výhľadom, o akom sa iným môže len snívať,

flexibilný pracovný čas, žiadne nútené vstávanie, len dobrovoľné,

mzda od 8 €/hod. v čistom

zľavy na služby v Strachan Resorte,

možnosť absolvovať inštruktorský kurz s dotáciou a zvýhodnením, takže sa naučíte lyžovať aj zarábať súčasne.

Ak vás táto predstava neodstrašuje, ale naopak láka, poznáte odpoveď. Prihláste sa k nám a staňte sa súčasťou tímu, ktorý cez deň učí a večer tancuje.Výhody:ubytovanie

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti reklamy a marketingu
jobs.description:
☎️ „Dobrý deň, máme problém.“

„Aký?“

„Technický.“

„A čo presne nefunguje?“

„No... ono.“

Výborne. Máme prvú stopu. 

Ak dokážeš z takéhoto rozhovoru dostať použiteľné informácie, možno máme prácu presne pre teba.

Prijímanie technických incidentov – „Môžete mi to stručne opísať?“ Nasleduje audiokniha.

Kontrola monitorovacích systémov – sleduješ, čo funguje, čo nefunguje a čo sa len veľmi presvedčivo tvári, že funguje.

Riešenie jednoduchších technických problémov – keď problém vyriešiš za minútu, zvyšných 59 nemusíš predstierať, že to bolo náročné.

Posúvanie zložitejších prípadov na vyššiu podporu – keď problém potrebuje väčšieho odborníka, pošleš ho ďalej. Nie však s popisom „nejde to, veľa šťastia“.

Komunikácia so zákazníkmi a technickými tímami – vieš zostať slušná/ý aj pri vete „Ale susedovi to funguje“.

Práca s Excelom a evidencia incidentov – keď ti Excel napíše #HODNOTA!, neodpovieš mu niečím, čo by HR muselo cenzurovať.

Sledovanie otvorených požiadaviek – nenecháš incident ležať v systéme tak dlho, až dostane nárok na dôchodok.

Dokumentovanie vyriešených problémov – aby sa rovnaká chyba nemusela vyšetrovať každý pondelok ako nový kriminálny prípad.

Výhody:Pracovný pomer bez dátumu spotreby – nie sme reality šou. Každý piatok nikoho nevyraďujeme.  Zmluva na dobu neurčitú 

Permanentka na dobrovoľné sebatrýznenie – fitko, bazén, sauna... Vyber si, kde sa budeš potiť a ešte za to poďakuješ.  MultiSport karta 

Decembrové úplatky za celoročné dobré správanie – darčeky dostaneš, aj keď si občas zanadávaš na pondelok.  Vianočné balíčky 

Keď je problém, nehráme schovávačku – kolegovia ti pomôžu. Nikto zázračne neodíde na obed na tri dni.  100 percent podpora zo strany firmy 

Kolektív bez povinného firemného úsmevu – môžeš byť normálny človek, nie nadšený komparzista z reklamy na jogurt.  Rodinná atmosféra 

Žiadna výroba zamestnancov cez kopirák – každý máme svoje muchy. Niektorí rovno celé safari.  Individuálny prístup

jobs.description: Náš marketingový tím má pod palcom pestré portfólio rezortov, služieb a samostatných prevádzok. Každý brand má svoju vlastnú špecifickú komunikáciu na verejnosť (sociálne siete, web, promo):Hlavné rezorty & ubytovacie komplexy:Demänová Rezort – náš najväčší rodinný (family-friendly) komplex.Mara Holiday Resort – celoročné apartmány pri Liptovskej Mare.Mara Camping – obľúbený letný produkt.Ayurvia – špecializované ajurvédske centrum (samostatná časť Demänová Rezortu v spolupráci s partnermi).Všetky naše subbrandy a prevádzky:Gastro: Reštaurácie Pinus a SafranZábava & Šport: SKI centrum, FUN Center, Loď Mária na Liptovskej Mare a Mara FUN (vodné športy)Obchody & Služby: Pekáreň a obchodík Kriváň, Wellness centrum a ďalšie doplňujúce prevádzky.Čo bude Tvojou náplňou práce?Čaká Ťa pestrá exekutíva a operatíva naprieč celým naším portfóliom, pri ktorej sa rozhodne nebudeš nudiť:Tvorba & správa obsahu:Komplexná správa sociálnych sietí (FB, IG, LinkedIn, TikTok) pre naše značky.Zachytávanie denného diania – denné stories, novinky, atmosféra, fotenie a točenie videí priamo v rezorte a na prevádzkach.Odosielanie push notifikácií cez našu aplikáciu FunCard.Príprava a odosielanie newsletterov, pravidelného mailingu a tvorba článkov.Web & Dizajn:Správa, tvorba obsahu a aktualizácia webov (WordPress – hlavné rezortné weby aj jednotlivé jednoduché gastro a produktové weby).Výroba a príprava jednoduchej grafiky, tlačovín, reklamných nosičov a interných materiálov.Eventy & Kampane:Marketingové zastrešenie interných eventov – podklady, grafiky, kampane, tvorba FB udalostí a info na web.Spolupráca na marketingových kampaniach od prvého nápadu až po realizáciu.Zamestnanecké výhody, benefityPrečo sa Ti u nás bude páčiť?Super šanca vyprofilovať sa: Keďže ide o všestrannú juniornú pozíciu, časom zistíš, čo Ťa baví najviac, a môžeš sa smerovať tam, kde sa cítiš najlepšie – či už to bude Content, SEO, Grafika, Social Media alebo Výkonnostný marketing.Dynamická práca: Žiadna nudná, monotónna rutina v kancelárii. Žijeme tým, čo sa v našich prevádzkach reálne deje.Krásne prostredie: Pracujeme v rozprávkovom rezorte ako „dedinka v dedine“ s vlastným jazierkom, wellnessom a skvelými reštauráciami.Skvelé benefity: Zvýhodnený prístup ku všetkým službám rezortu a prevádzkam (obedy, wellness, obchodík, atrakcie na Liptovskej Mare).Priateľská kultúra: Nie sme korporát. Sme otvorený tím, kde máš voľnosť v nápadoch a reálny vplyv na značky, ktoré majú dušu.

Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
jobs.description:
Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

  • A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

  • AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

Useful links:

  • iwoca benefits & policies

  • Interview welcome pack

Compensation: £60K – £85K

Sterker nog, iemand die beweert alles te weten over ICT vertrouwen we waarschijnlijk minder dan iemand die weet wat hij nog niet weet.Wie zoeken we?Je hebt ongeveer vier jaar of meer relevante ervaring in ICT beheer, systeembeheer, cloud engineering of een vergelijkbare functie.Je kunt zelfstandig technische problemen analyseren en oplossen.Je hebt goede kennis van Microsoft 365 en moderne Microsoft omgevingen.Je begrijpt netwerken. IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs en routing zijn voor jou geen mysterieuze afkortingen.Je hebt affiniteit met security.Je kunt normaal met klanten communiceren. Ook met mensen die niet begrijpen wat DNS, MFA of een VLAN is.Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor wat je doet.Je durft vragen te stellen en je mening te geven.Je kunt zelfstandig werken zonder dat iemand continu over je schouder meekijkt.En misschien wel het belangrijkste: je bent nieuwsgierig. Want ICT verandert continu en wij dus ook.Wat verwachten we niet?Dat je iedere technologie uit deze vacature uit je hoofd kent.Dat je pakken draagt.Dat je iedere minuut van je dag verantwoordt.Dat je doet alsof je iets weet wanneer je het niet weet.En ook niet dat werken het belangrijkste onderdeel van je leven moet zijn.We willen gewoon goed werk leveren met mensen die hun vak leuk vinden.Geen zin om de hele dag alleen maar tickets weg te klikken?Mooi. Wij zoeken namelijk ook geen klassieke supportmedewerker. Bij RealNetwork zoeken we een ervaren ICTer die het vak leuk vindt en inmiddels genoeg kennis heeft opgebouwd om zelfstandig te werken, maar nog lang niet uitgeleerd is.Iemand die een storing niet alleen oplost, maar zich ook afvraagt waarom die storing überhaupt kon ontstaan. Iemand die met een klant kan praten, een Microsoft 365 omgeving kan verbeteren, een firewall kan configureren en een netwerk kan ontwerpen. Maar die er ook geen probleem van maakt om bij een nieuwe installatie zelf een kabel te trekken of een access point op te hangen.Kortom: iemand die ICT echt leuk vindt.

jobs.title: Distinguished Engineer
jobs.description:
At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The role:

We are looking for a Distinguished Engineer based in our Paris office to lead the technical transformations that are too large, too cross-cutting, or too critical to belong to a single engineering team.

This is a company-wide IC role with direct report to the CTO and explicit authority to drive major technical decisions across Product Engineering, Platform, Infrastructure and Data.

This isn't an advisory role, it's a mandate to change how Brevo Engineering works at a foundational level.

 


What you will do:

You will own a small number of high-impact technical transformations end to end: architecture, implementation strategy, migration, adoption and retirement of legacy systems.

Examples include:

  • rebuilding our CI/CD and deployment architecture across hundreds of services and repositories;
  • replacing fragmented logging and observability patterns with an OpenTelemetry-based platform backed by ClickHouse;
  • redesigning how we use Kafka and introducing stronger platform abstractions around messaging;
  • turning ClickHouse into a first-class internal product rather than a database consumed inconsistently across teams;
  • defining and driving common standards around service communication, reliability, runtime architecture and developer platforms.

    • These initiatives will cross organizational boundaries and require changes to both infrastructure and application code.

    Your responsibility is to own the projects end to end, driving them through every stage and resolving whatever obstacles arise until it is delivered.


    Who you are:
  • You have already operated at Principal, Distinguished, Senior Principal, Fellow, or equivalent level within a significantly larger engineering organization.
  • You have repeatedly led transformations involving
  • hundreds of engineers or large service fleets,
  • distributed systems and production infrastructure,
  • complex migrations where old and new worlds had to coexist,
  • strong technical disagreement across senior teams,
  • and architecture decisions with broad and lasting consequences.
  • You move fluidly between a system design discussion, a code review, a production incident, a migration plan, and an executive-level technical decision.
  • You bring deep expertise in several of the following: Kubernetes, CI/CD, Kafka, ClickHouse, OpenTelemetry, distributed databases, service communication, developer platforms, and large-scale observability.
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

This is a field position. 

About the Position

The Channel Account Manager (CAM) responsibilities include working within the sales team to promote and sell network security products within a geographic territory. The CAM is responsible for supporting assigned WatchGuard partners in the assigned territory and will be responsible for active channel partners. The CAM will be responsible for quoting, training, lead generation and follow-up, event support, and the forecasting and tracking for their assigned partners. The CAM will report to the Country Manager, working closely to assure territory quota attainment, in addition to joining with the sales and field marketing teams in the territory. Success in this position will be measured by meeting successful transaction, growth, and retention goals with the assigned partners. The CAM will keep up-to-date knowledge of the industry and the competitive posture of the company, as well as prepare activity and forecast reports as requested.


Position Responsibilities

· Strive towards the territory quota attainment, retention, and growth/development of active partners

· Maintain regular contact with partners to ensure satisfaction and continued success

· Partner with Territory Channel Account Manager to generate new business and develop current customers through the partner network

· Support partners on standard methodologies and use of WatchGuard, including training, event support, and lead generation

· Create and perform sales presentations to match WatchGuard with audience needs

· Provide ongoing relationship management and training for partners

· Net growth for WatchGuard One Certifications in the territory

· Be knowledgeable of all WatchGuard products, services, and internal sales tools

· Other duties and projects assigned


Skills and Qualifications

· Experience with two-tier/channel sales ecosystem required

· Experience in network/cyber security space preferred

· History of sales experience with partner accounts

· History of consistent plan development and quota achievement

· Strong presentation and written skills

· Ability to self-manage and work remotely

· Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM


Experience

· 2+ years’ experience in direct and indirect sales in related industry

· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent training in business, sales, or marketing.


Why Work for WatchGuard?

WatchGuard is a global leader in network security and intelligence, advanced endpoint protection, multi-factor authentication, and secure Wi-Fi. Our award-winning products and services are trusted worldwide by more than 18,000 security resellers and service providers to protect more than 250,000 customers. Our technology keeps our customers ahead of increasingly sophisticated hackers and has fueled record revenues at WatchGuard.

WatchGuard is headquartered in Seattle, Washington, with team members working remotely and in offices worldwide.

Our company culture places an intense focus on our customers and employees. From the newest employee to our CEO, you'll find that each person at WatchGuard embodies our Core Values:

jobs.title: Senior Projectmanager
jobs.description:
Jouw Missie bij CCS

Geen dag is hetzelfde in deze rol. Samen met je collega’s zorg je ervoor dat wij succesvol onze softwareoplossingen bij klanten implementeren en dat onze klanten een excellente dienstverlening krijgen! Voor deze complexe systeemimplementaties en integratieprojecten zoeken we een zeer ervaren projectmanager. Je leert de verzekeringsbranche kennen en klanten helpen. Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam.

Voordelen voor de sollicitant

Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar).

Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks.

En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch?


Een voorbeeld van je werkdag

Opstarten: Aan het begin van je werkdag heb je een dagstart met zowel collega’s als projectteamleden van de klant. Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen.

Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Je coacht en begeleidt de consultant en helpt deze met een hulpvraag. Vervolgens ga je aan de slag met het opstellen van de voortgangsrapportage. Hiermee zorg je voor proactieve en transparante rapportage over het project aan de klant. De stuurgroep met de klant is volgende week, vandaag spreek je samen met de delivery manager deze stuurgroep voor. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan.

Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant.

Wie jij bent

De ideale kandidaat beschikt over daadkracht, doorzettingsvermogen, enthousiasme en drive om projecten succesvol te leiden en verbeteringen door te voeren om te komen tot nog efficiëntere en klantgerichte projecten. Jij herkent jezelf in de volgende punten:

· Je wordt blij van projectmanagement en blijft kalm bij verschuivende prioriteiten;

· Je hebt bewezen ervaring met het succesvol uitvoeren van productsoftware-implementaties in een complexe, maar klantgerichte omgeving, binnen budget, planning en scope;

· Je hebt ruime ervaring met diverse projectmanagement en delivery methodieken, bij voorkeur een Prince2-, Ipma of PMI of Agile / scrum certificaat;

· Je vindt, net als wij, klanttevredenheid het uitgangspunt. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig;

· Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift;

· Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch;

· Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties;

· Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Naast de genoemde leuke functie binnen een groeiend en innovatief bedrijf bieden wij:

· Salaris: We bieden je een salaris tussen € 5.590 en € 7.958 per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur per week), afhankelijk van je ervaring en kennis;

· Middelen: Leaseauto, laptop, telefoon;

· Werkdagen: Je bent minimaal 4 dagen per week beschikbaar, al heeft 5 dagen onze voorkeur;

· Vergoeding voor thuiswerken: Je kunt gedeeltelijk thuiswerken en krijgt een onkostenvergoeding van € 2,40 per thuiswerkdag. Ook krijg je een budget van € 750,- om thuis een ergonomische werkplek in te richten;

· Workation: Je kunt tot 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar vanuit het buitenland werken;

· Leuke teamactiviteiten: Leer je collega’s beter kennen door deel te nemen aan maandelijkse evenementen georganiseerd door ons energieke Fun-team, zoals een pubquiz, Zomer BBQ, wine & beer tastings en movie night;

· Vakantiedagen: Je krijgt 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid om maximaal 20 extra dagen bij te kopen;

· Groei en ontwikkeling: De mogelijkheid om je vaardigheden en verantwoordelijkheden te ontwikkelen binnen de functie, middels opleidingen en Linkedin learning, of door te stromen naar een van de andere functies binnen CCS;

· Vakantiegeld: Jaarlijks 8,33%;

· Voordelen: Je krijgt een aantrekkelijke pensioenregeling met een lage eigen bijdrage en kunt gebruikmaken van collectieve verzekeringen met korting. Ook is er een bedrijfsfitnessregeling voor een gezonde levensstijl en een fietsregeling voor duurzaam vervoer.

Waarom CCS?

Omdat wij geloven dat werk meer is dan een baan. Het is een plek waar je jezelf kunt zijn, impact kunt maken en kunt groeien. Het is een omgeving waar je wordt geïnspireerd om het beste uit jezelf te halen en samen te werken aan een duurzame toekomst. Kom bij ons en ontdek wat er mogelijk is als je een carrière bouwt vol passie, plezier en betekenis. Jij bent de ontbrekende schakel in ons team. Word onderdeel van ons verhaal. 🚀

Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours.

We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. At Doctrine, we're building Europe's leading legal AI platform.

Our belief? Law shouldn't be slowed down by repetitive tasks. It should be augmented by a specialised AI, designed to understand, analyse and produce legal reasoning at the highest standard.

Our ambition? To help legal professionals work with greater reliability, efficiency and peace of mind, through a single, comprehensive and secure platform.

Today, 27,000 legal professionals across five countries (France, Italy, Germany, Spain and Luxembourg) trust us to do just that.

Our growth is guided by a clear approach: a global vision, grounded in a deep understanding of local specificities.

Behind this ambition, a team of around 250 people, united around one goal: supporting lawyers and legal professionals at every stage of their work, from research to drafting.

And we're just getting started.


We grow fast. Really fast. Organically (new products, new countries) and through acquisitions: 5 companies snapped up in 3 years, including a fresh one in Spain. The result in 2026: close to 30,000 customers across 5 countries. The German market? It just blew out its first birthday candle.

Doctrine is the European leader in legal AI. But a German lawyer doesn't work like a French one, and in-house counsel in Berlin don't have quite the same needs as their Paris counterparts. Every market has its own playbook. That's where you come in: putting Doctrine's growth in Germany into overdrive.

 

The team you're joining

A Growth team of 4: your future manager, one Growth on Italy, two on France. We're hunting for the 5th avenger to complete the squad and take full ownership of the German market. On the other side of the table, a team of full-funnel Account Executives ready to turn the leads you generate into wins.

The starting point (pretty sweet, honestly 👀)

  • A high-growth SaaS model, and a profitable one (yes, both)
  • Rock-solid product-market fit with real momentum: close to 30,000 lawyers and legal professionals already on board
  • A top-tier Go-to-Market team (Marketing, RevenueOps & Sales) to help you uncover new pockets of growth
  • An established spot as the European leader of a category we helped invent: legal AI
  • A cutting-edge tooling stack and a loaded content library to fire on the right levers and shut down objections

Your missions

Inside the Growth team, hand in hand with Sales, PMM and Product, you spend your days sharpening the German funnel, a mix of inbound and outbound. And the best part: everything is open to challenge. Got a better idea? We're all ears.

  • Internationalization: design and roll out local campaigns built for the codes and expectations of the German market (no copy-paste from France).

You're our 5th avenger if you're not afraid to build campaigns day in, day out and copywriting is your thing (better yet, you love it). 

Hard skills

  • A solid grasp of how data flows between tools, to build, challenge and optimize customer and prospect journeys.
  • A real appetite for copywriting and for understanding what makes our audience tick.
  • A drive to build strategies that last, not just quick & dirty wins.
  • Analytical skills (SQL is a nice bonus).

Soft skills

  • Fluency in English is required to communicate with the team. 
  • Fluency in German, it's a plus.
  • Strong communicator who lets the data do the talking when it's time to decide.
  • Creative and curious about user psychology, to design programs that leave a mark.
  • A real team player: you move through cross-functional teams and get everyone's stakes to land the best action plans.

Our stack 🛠️

Salesforce · HubSpot · Outreach · Intercom · Lemlist · Mixpanel · Google Analytics · Metabase · Zapier/Make

🏡 A flexible remote work policy, allowing up to three days of remote work per week (depending on your team).

🌴 A flexible leave policy

🌱 Real internal mobility opportunities

🏄‍♂️ Regular team events

🏋️‍♀️ A Gymlib subscription for sports and wellness activities

🧘 Free access to the Moka.care mental health support platform, including up to 6 individual sessions per year

Our values 🤝

At Doctrine, our 4 values guide us every day as we work to move things forward.

Challenge the status quo: we champion bold ideas that drive change across an entire industry.

Liberty and responsibility: we encourage autonomy, individual impact and ownership.

jobs.title: Product Engineer, Shop
jobs.description:
ABOUT INSIFY

We sell a mix of insurance products to small businesses (SME's) in the Netherlands, Germany and France, and we are in the process of scaling into more markets. 

Insurance infrastructure is brutal to get right. Every carrier has its own spec, every product its own underwriting rules, every country its own regulatory requirements. Most insurers throw people and process at that complexity - one-off integrations, workarounds on workarounds. We're building it differently: our insurance platform is where we consolidate that complexity, so that launching a new product or market becomes a configuration exercise rather than a rebuild.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by more than €40M from investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.


About the role

You would join the Shop team, responsible for everything that happens after a small business buys a policy from us. You would help shape how the platform handles the next product and the next country, on a system already carrying live policies and real customers.

The team owns end-to-end policy lifecycle management (mid-term adjustments, automated renewals, cancellations, and payment flows) alongside the backoffice tooling that gives our operations and support teams full visibility and control. We work closely with the Claims Team, and with the Activation Teams that turn a lead into a paying customer. Product and engineering together are 30+ people.

Every country has its own regulatory quirks, and every insurance product has unique data structures, lifecycle rules, and money flows.

As we expand across Europe, our goal isn't to write custom glue code for every new launch. It's to design elegant, reusable platform abstractions. We're building a system where introducing a new country or product feels like snapping modular building blocks together.

You're joining at an exciting inflection point: we have real traction, proven scale, and you get to directly build the foundational platform that powers our next wave of European growth.


What you'll be doing
  • Owning end-to-end the discovery and delivery of crucial platform features that enable our ability to scale as an insurance business
  • Continuously and relentlessly seeking opportunities to turn new product demands into platform capabilities and features that scale across countries and insurance product lines
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • 3+ years building complex web applications and services, with real production ownership
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your direct stack to get to results, be that data / backend / frontend
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt
  • Strong fundamentals in domain-driven design & service oriented architecture
    • Not all of the above are hard requirements. If you're strong on most of these and eager to grow into the rest, we'd still love to hear from you.

    Nice to have
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Strong observability instincts. You know where things will break, and can help others learn that too

    • Our stack

    TypeScript across the board, running on AWS (IaaC), in a single monorepo. If you have not worked with all of it, that is fine. We care more about how you reason about systems than about which tools you have used before.


    We offer
  • Competitive compensation that reflects responsibility and impact. For this role the range is €65,000 to €85,000.
  • Trust and autonomy. You'll have real ownership, room to make decisions, and space to shape your role as Insify evolves.
  • Hybrid working. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year working from abroad, and 25 holiday days.
  • Pension. We contribute 6% for you.
  • Alleo budget. €50 net a month to spend on whatever you want, from the gym to takeaway. It rolls over if you don't use it.
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs, and coaching to go with them.
  • A central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, whiteboards, and Friday drinks.
  • Hardware & setup. A high-spec MacBook Pro, high-res monitors at the office, and comfortable ergonomic seating.

jobs.title: EnkelBnb søker utleieforvalter i Trysil
jobs.description:
EnkelBnb søker utleieforvalter til vår nyoppstartede avdeling i Trysil! Du følger opp gjester før, under og etter opphold, koordinerer det praktiske rundt utleien og rykker ut ved behov. En fleksibel deltidsjobb der mesteparten av arbeidet gjøres digitalt.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi søker en person som bor i Trysil-området, og som er selvstendig, løsningsorientert og serviceinnstilt.

Førerkort og tilgang til bil anses som en fordel, ettersom deler av stillingen forutsetter fysisk oppmøte.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Stillingen består hovedsakelig av digital forvaltning. Det vil si at du som utleieforvalter har ansvar for kommunikasjon med gjester før, under og etter oppholdet, samt koordinering av det praktiske rundt utleien. Siden arbeidet i all hovedsak er digitalt, kan de fleste arbeidsoppgaver gjennomføres uavhengig av sted, og de fleste henvendelser lar seg løse uten fysisk oppmøte.

Den resterende delen av stillingen innebærer fysisk oppmøte ved behov - eksempelvis bistand til gjester på stedet eller befaring av nye eiendommer som skal inn i porteføljen.

Arbeidsmengden varierer gjennom året, og stillingen egner seg godt som en fleksibel deltidsjobb.

Vi tilbyr

Hos oss kan du forvente varierte arbeidsoppgaver - alt fra digitalt arbeid i form av kommunikasjon med gjester og koordinering av renhold mellom gjesteoppholdene, til fysisk arbeid som befaring av nye eiendommer.

Hos oss kan du også forvente en god mengde fleksibilitet. Mesteparten av arbeidet kan du gjennomføre digitalt, noe som gir deg muligheten til å jobbe fra der det passer deg best.

Du kan også forvente en rettferdig og konkurransedyktig lønn. Vi er opptatt av at alle som jobber hos oss skal trives, føle mestring og få en lønn som gjenspeiler innsatsen de legger ned.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

EnkelBnb er et forvaltningsselskap som bistår eiendomseiere med utleie av deres eiendom gjennom utleie på plattformer som Airbnb, Booking.com, Finn.no.

Vi ivaretar hele utleieprosessen på vegne av eiere som ikke selv har anledning til å håndtere utleien - herunder annonsering, gjestekommunikasjon, inn- og utsjekk, og løpende oppfølging.

Vi har drift i både Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim og Tromsø, og høsten 2026 etablerer vi oss i Trysil. I den forbindelse søker vi lokale utleieforvaltere som kan bistå med driften i Trysil.

Umfang und Verteilung stimmen wir gemeinsam ab.- Vergütung in Anlehnung an TVöD, Entgeltgruppe 15 (EG 15), unter Berücksichtigung deiner Berufserfahrung.- Sechs Wochen bezahlter Erholungsurlaub pro Kalenderjahr.- Hybrides Arbeiten: Eine Kombination aus Präsenztherapie in Wülfrath und Onlinepsychotherapie ist im fachlich und rechtlich zulässigen Rahmen möglich.- Eigenverantwortliches therapeutisches Arbeiten mit Raum für deine fachlichen Interessen und Schwerpunkte.- Kollegialer Austausch, Intervision und fachlicher Rückhalt, ohne deine therapeutische Eigenständigkeit einzuschränken.- Unterstützung bei organisatorischen Aufgaben und eine sorgfältige Einarbeitung.- Wertschätzende Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe, geprägt von Vertrauen, gegenseitigem Respekt und Offenheit für neue Ideen.Deine therapeutische ArbeitDu übernimmst eigenverantwortlich die ambulante psychotherapeutische Behandlung erwachsener Patientinnen und Patienten, einschließlich Diagnostik, Therapieplanung, therapeutischer Fallführung und bei Bedarf Krisenintervention.Eigene fachliche Interessen und Schwerpunkte sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Gemeinsam schauen wir, wie sich diese mit dem Angebot unserer Praxis verbinden lassen.Du arbeitest selbstständig und kannst dich gleichzeitig auf kollegiale Unterstützung und fachlichen Austausch verlassen.Was du mitbringstDu verfügst über eine Approbation als Psychotherapeutin oder Psychotherapeut sowie die erforderliche abgeschlossene Fachqualifikation für die eigenverantwortliche Behandlung Erwachsener.Unsere Praxis arbeitet auf verhaltenstherapeutischer Grundlage (VT). Ich freue mich auch über Bewerbungen aus der tiefenpsychologisch fundierten Psychotherapie (TP) oder Systemischen Therapie (ST), sofern die fachlichen und rechtlichen Voraussetzungen für den vorgesehenen Einsatz erfüllt sind.Die erforderlichen Nachweise, einschließlich Arztregistereintrag beziehungsweise der Voraussetzungen hierfür, klären wir im Rahmen der geplanten Beschäftigung.Du arbeitest gerne eigenverantwortlich, schätzt den fachlichen Austausch und begegnest Menschen mit Offenheit, Respekt und Wertschätzung.Auch frisch approbierte Kolleginnen und Kollegen sind ausdrücklich willkommen. Wenn deine Approbation kurz bevorsteht, kannst du dich ebenfalls gerne schon melden.Ein persönlicher EinblickIch bin Maja Lovric-Preuss und führe seit 2016 eine eigene psychotherapeutische Praxis.Mir liegt eine therapeutische Arbeit am Herzen, die fachlich fundiert ist und die individuelle Situation eines Menschen ernst nimmt. Auch in der Zusammenarbeit wünsche ich mir Offenheit, einen respektvollen Umgang und Platz für unterschiedliche Perspektiven.Ich bin überzeugt, dass gute Psychotherapie nicht nur fachliche Kompetenz und Erfahrung braucht, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem sich Therapeutinnen und Therapeuten selbst wohlfühlen, gesund bleiben und weiterentwickeln können.Vertrauen statt Kontrolle, Zusammenarbeit auf Augenhöhe und gegenseitige Unterstützung sind deshalb wichtige Grundsätze unserer Praxiskultur.Die Rahmenbedingungen der ambulanten Psychotherapie verändern sich. Ich mache diese Arbeit weiterhin sehr gerne und möchte die Praxis mit Zuversicht weiterentwickeln. Dazu gehören für mich eine sorgfältige Planung und klare Absprachen darüber, wie wir miteinander arbeiten.Ich freue mich auf jemanden, der diese Freude an der therapeutischen Arbeit teilt, eigene Gedanken einbringt und Lust hat, unsere Praxis gemeinsam weiterzuentwickeln.Lernen wir uns kennen!Schreib mir für den Anfang einfach ein paar Zeilen über dich, dein therapeutisches Verfahren und deine Vorstellungen zur Zusammenarbeit.Ein ausführliches Anschreiben brauchst du für den ersten Austausch nicht.Ich freue mich darauf, dich kennenzulernen!Maja Lovric-PreussPsychotherapiepraxis Roter FadenUlmenweg 22 · 42489 WülfrathE-Mail: lovric@roterfaden.info (https://mailto:lovric@roterfaden.info)Einblicke in unsere Praxis:https://psychotherapie-roterfaden.de/praxis/ (https://psychotherapie-roterfaden.de/praxis/)Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

jobs.description: MFA gesucht – gestalte unsere moderne Praxis mit!Du bist MFA, arbeitest engagiert, hast ein Lächeln auf den Lippen und Freude daran, neue Wege zu gehen? Ein respektvoller und wertschätzender Umgang mit Patientinnen, Patienten und im Team ist für dich selbstverständlich? jobs.title: Pflegedienstleitung / Verantwortliche Pflegefachkraft (m/w/d) (Pflegedienstleiter/in)
jobs.description: Du willst Pflege nicht nur verwalten, sondern ihre Zukunft aktiv gestalten?Du brennst für moderne Pflegekonzepte, denkst über den Tellerrand hinaus und möchtest Deine fachliche Expertise dort einsetzen, wo sie wirklich etwas bewirken kann?Du suchst keine starren Hierarchien, sondern ein dynamisches Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, strategischer Weitblick und innovative Ideen ausdrücklich erwünscht sind?Dann könnte der Ambulante Pflegedienst Ruhr (APR) genau der richtige nächste Schritt für Dich sein.Zum 01.01.2027 suchen wir eine engagierte und führungsstarke Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernimmt, neue Impulse setzt und die Weiterentwicklung unseres Pflegedienstes maßgeblich mitgestaltet.APR – Modern aufgestellt. Erfolgreich gewachsen. Bereit für den nächsten Schritt.Seit unserer Gründung im Jahr 2022 haben wir uns als moderner und zukunftsorientierter ambulanter Pflegedienst im Bochumer Süden etabliert.Unser Anspruch: Fachliche Exzellenz, menschliche Nähe und zeitgemäßes Management miteinander verbinden.Als Mitglied im Bundesverband privater Anbieter sozialer Dienste (bpa) setzen wir auf hohe Qualitätsstandards, kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und wirtschaftlich nachhaltige Strukturen.Mit unserem Standort im modernen Ärztehaus in Bochum-Weitmar-Mark, digitalen Arbeitsprozessen über MEDIFOX DAN, mobilen iPads und der Anbindung an die Telematikinfrastruktur schaffen wir die Voraussetzungen für eine professionelle und effiziente Pflegeorganisation.Was uns auszeichnet? Wir denken Pflege weiter. Ohne überholte Strukturen, unnötige Bürokratie oder lange Entscheidungswege. Dafür mit klaren Zielen, modernen Konzepten und dem Mut, neue Wege zu gehen.Deine Verantwortung – Strategie, Qualität & TeamführungAls Pflegedienstleitung übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in unserem Unternehmen. Du verantwortest die fachliche Ausrichtung unseres Pflegedienstes und erhältst den Freiraum, eigene Ideen und Konzepte aktiv umzusetzen.- Fachliche Gesamtleitung: Du steuerst und optimierst unsere Pflege- und Betreuungsprozesse unter Berücksichtigung aktueller pflegewissenschaftlicher Erkenntnisse und gesetzlicher Anforderungen nach SGB V und SGB XI.- Qualitätsmanagement & Innovation: Du entwickelst unsere Qualitätsstandards kontinuierlich weiter, erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale und begleitest externe Qualitätsprüfungen souverän.- Teamführung mit Persönlichkeit: Du führst unsere Mitarbeitenden wertschätzend, verbindlich und lösungsorientiert, förderst individuelle Stärken und schaffst klare, professionelle Strukturen.- Organisation & Wirtschaftlichkeit: Du gestaltest effiziente Arbeitsabläufe und eine vorausschauende Dienst- und Tourenplanung unter Berücksichtigung fachlicher, personeller und wirtschaftlicher Anforderungen.- Strategischer Weitblick: Du verfolgst pflegepolitische Entwicklungen und gesetzliche Neuerungen eigenständig und leitest daraus praxisnahe Maßnahmen und innovative Konzepte ab.- Schnittstellenkompetenz: Du repräsentierst APR gegenüber Prüfbehörden, Kostenträgern, Ärzten und Kooperationspartnern und bist kompetente Ansprechperson für Patienten und Angehörige.Was Du mitbringst – Fachwissen & GestaltungswilleWir suchen keine Führungskraft, die ausschließlich bestehende Prozesse verwaltet. Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit mit fachlichem Anspruch, unternehmerischem Verständnis und dem Willen, etwas zu bewegen.Deine Qualifikation:- Abgeschlossene dreijährige Ausbildung in der Pflege sowie eine anerkannte Weiterbildung zur verantwortlichen Pflegefachkraft (mindestens 460 Stunden) oder eine entsprechend anerkannte Qualifikation.- Fundierte Kenntnisse im Qualitätsmanagement, in der ambulanten Pflegeorganisation sowie den relevanten rechtlichen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen.- Führungskompetenz, Organisationsstärke und ein souveränes, professionelles Auftreten.- Eigeninitiative, analytisches Denken und die Fähigkeit, Herausforderungen lösungsorientiert zu begegnen.- Interesse an Digitalisierung, modernen Pflegekonzepten und aktuellen Entwicklungen im Gesundheitswesen.- Führerschein der Klasse B.Was uns besonders wichtig ist: Du übernimmst Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und stehst hinter ihnen. Du hast den Anspruch, Pflegequalität aktiv zu gestalten, statt lediglich Vorgaben abzuarbeiten.Was wir Dir bieten – Verantwortung, die sich auszahltEine anspruchsvolle Führungsposition verdient mehr als ein gutes Gehalt. Deshalb bieten wir Dir ein attraktives Gesamtpaket, das Leistung anerkennt, Entwicklung fördert und Dir echte Perspektiven eröffnet.Attraktive Vergütung & exklusive Zusatzleistungen- Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung: Leistungs- und erfahrungsorientiert, individuell abgestimmt auf Deine Qualifikation und Verantwortung.- Attraktive Sonderzahlungen: Zusätzliche finanzielle Leistungen über Dein reguläres Gehalt hinaus.- Leistungsorientierte Prämien: Finanzielle Anerkennung für das Erreichen gemeinsam definierter Ziele.- Dienstwagen: Auch zur privaten Nutzung im Rahmen der 1-%-Regelung.- Betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung: Mit hochwertigen stationären Wahlleistungen wie Einbettzimmer und Chefarztbehandlung sowie Leistungen zur Zahnprophylaxe.- JobRad-Leasing: Möglichkeit zum Leasing Deines Wunschfahrrads oder E-Bikes.Gestaltungsspielraum & berufliche Perspektiven- Echte Entscheidungsfreiheit: Kurze Entscheidungswege und die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen und Konzepte aktiv umzusetzen.- Langfristige Entwicklungsperspektive: Gestalte die nächsten Wachstumsschritte unseres Unternehmens mit und entwickle Deinen Verantwortungsbereich kontinuierlich weiter.- Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Digitale Prozesse, zeitgemäße IT-Ausstattung und ein repräsentativer Arbeitsplatz im Ärztehaus Bochum-Weitmar-Mark.- Professionelle Unterstützung: Ein eingespieltes Büroteam und etablierte administrative Strukturen schaffen Freiraum für Deine eigentlichen Führungsaufgaben.- Gezielte Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Weiterqualifizierung.- Planbarkeit: Eine unbefristete Vollzeitposition mit planbaren Arbeitszeiten und langfristiger Perspektive.Deine Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen.Wir haben in den vergangenen Jahren ein starkes Fundament geschaffen. Jetzt möchten wir den nächsten Entwicklungsschritt gehen.Dafür suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die nicht nur fachlich überzeugt, sondern auch neue Perspektiven eröffnet, Verantwortung bewusst übernimmt und unsere Vorstellung einer modernen, qualitativ hochwertigen Pflege teilt.Bei APR erhältst Du die Möglichkeit, Deine Erfahrung einzubringen, eigene Schwerpunkte zu setzen und die Zukunft eines wachsenden Unternehmens aktiv mitzugestalten.Nicht irgendwann. Sondern von Anfang an.Bereit für den nächsten Karriereschritt?Dann lass uns kennenlernen – unkompliziert, persönlich und auf Augenhöhe.Sende uns einfach Deinen Lebenslauf oder melde Dich telefonisch für ein unverbindliches Erstgespräch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht erforderlich.Homeoffice:Umfang: Maximal 10%
