jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
  • AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
  • Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
  • AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.

Scope

This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.

Requirements

What you will bring

Must have

  • 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
  • Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
  • Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
  • AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
  • Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
  • Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
  • Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
  • Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
  • Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
  • Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
  • Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.

Nice to have

  • Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
  • Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
  • Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
  • Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
  • Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
  • Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Independent Contractor opportunity
  • Fully remote, globally distributed team

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Director, Benelux
jobs.description:
About us

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor and Clay Bavor. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

What you'll do

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Identify and target potential customers through research, networking, and cold calling. Build new relationships with our enterprise customers and prospects to drive revenue, pipeline, and deployment capacity.

  • Manage relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders with our largest customers. Serve as their primary point of contact and exceed their expectations.

  • Negotiating & closing complex deal cycles: Lead negotiations with existing and prospective customers, addressing objections and closing deals. Navigate contracts and agreements quickly and effectively, working closely with legal and finance stakeholders.

  • Sales strategy & planning: Develop and execute sales strategies to meet or exceed sales targets. Craft tailored sales presentations and proposals that meet our enterprise customers needs. Collaborate with our marketing team to implement effective sales campaigns and presentations.

  • Help define our sales motion: You'll be the first Sales person in region, and your work will directly impact how our GTM function operates and succeeds in the Benelux.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with our broader GTM team, as well as our product, technical and operations orgs to deliver our industry-leading product.

What you'll bring

  • 10+ years of experience in an enterprise customer-facing sales role, identifying and closing large accounts.

  • Strong communication skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication abilities. Professional fluency in Dutch and English.

  • Enterprise experience: Experience managing a $1M+ quota, and running end-to-end complex deals.

  • Analytical mindset: Ability to analyze market trends, identify opportunities, and make data-driven decisions.

  • Prospecting & lead generation: Proven track record of identifying and targeting potential enterprise clients through research, networking, and cold calling.

Even better...

  • Industry knowledge: Familiarity with the AI landscape, key players, and emerging trends.

  • Experience building GTM strategies: Building sales teams and sales motions from scratch, or from early stage growth.

Our values

  • Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

  • Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

  • Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

  • Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

  • Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.

What we offer

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

  • Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

  • Life insurance and disability benefits

  • Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

  • Parental leave

  • Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

  • Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

  • Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

  • Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.

Be you, with us

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world. To do so, it is important to us that the diversity of our employees represents the diversity of our customers. We believe that our work and culture are better when we encourage, support, and respect different skills and experiences represented within our team. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. We strive to evaluate all applicants consistently without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class.

jobs.title: Business Cutover Lead - SAP S/4HANA

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
Bouw aan de software van morgen. Ontwikkel de engineers die het mogelijk maken.

Van medische apparatuur en industriële automatisering tot semicon-oplossingen: achter ieder succesvol high-tech product schuilt sterke software. Ben jij de leider die softwareteams helpt excelleren, nieuwe technologieën zoals AI omarmt en tegelijkertijd bouwt aan de engineers van morgen? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

 

Bij ons speel je een sleutelrol in de verdere ontwikkeling van onze Software Engineering-organisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de groei, kwaliteit en prestaties van een team van circa 45 (embedded) softwareprofessionals en zorgt ervoor dat zij de juiste omgeving, richting en ondersteuning krijgen om complexe technologische uitdagingen succesvol aan te gaan.

 

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van technologie, leiderschap en organisatieontwikkeling. Daarbij richt jij je niet alleen op de resultaten van vandaag, maar bouw je ook aan de softwareorganisatie van morgen. Je creëert een omgeving waarin vakmanschap, kennisdeling, innovatie en continue verbetering centraal staan. Daarnaast volg je technologische ontwikkelingen op de voet en stimuleer je de inzet van moderne technologieën om softwareontwikkeling slimmer, sneller en effectiever te maken.

 

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van ongeveer 45 embedded software engineers en ondersteunt hen in hun professionele en persoonlijke groei.

  • Je geeft richting aan AI-gedreven transformatie binnen het softwareteam én de bredere organisatie, en neemt je team en collega’s mee in nieuwe manieren van werken.

  • Je stimuleert een cultuur van technische excellentie, eigenaarschap en samenwerking.

  • Je zorgt voor de juiste balans tussen projectresultaten, de ontwikkeling van je team en langetermijndoelstellingen.

  • Je werkt samen met architecten, technical leads en projectteams aan de verdere professionalisering van softwareontwikkeling binnen Benchmark.

  • Je bewaakt de benodigde capaciteit, competenties en inzetbaarheid van de afdeling.

  • Je speelt een actieve rol in het aantrekken, ontwikkelen en behouden van softwaretalent.

  • Je versterkt de samenwerking met internationale engineeringteams binnen Benchmark.

  • Je vertegenwoordigt Software Engineering binnen het Competence Management Team en levert een actieve bijdrage aan organisatiebrede besluitvorming.

  • Je stimuleert het gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken en tooling om kwaliteit, productiviteit en innovatie te versterken.

  • Je vertaalt technologische ontwikkelingen naar concrete verbeteringen in processen, werkwijzen en engineering excellence.

 

Samen met de managers van Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering en Test Development Engineering werk je aan een toekomstbestendige engineeringorganisatie. Daarbij zoek je continu naar manieren om samenwerking tussen disciplines te versterken en technologische ontwikkelingen succesvol naar de praktijk te vertalen.

 

Waarom deze functie?

Deze rol biedt een unieke combinatie van people leadership, technologie en strategische impact. Je krijgt de ruimte om onze softwareorganisatie verder vorm te geven, talent te ontwikkelen en invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop complexe high-tech producten worden ontworpen en ontwikkeld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de mogelijkheid om de toepassing van nieuwe technologieën, waaronder AI, binnen de organisatie verder te verkennen en te helpen verankeren.

 

Wat biedt Benchmark?

Bij Benchmark werk je aan producten die ertoe doen! Daarnaast zijn wij bij uitstek een organisatie waar je vrijheid krijgt, waar ondernemerschap wordt beloond en waarin je de ruimte krijgt om je ideeën tot uitvoering te brengen. We bieden je een dynamische omgeving met de ruimte om snel stappen te maken, door te groeien en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je bent onderdeel van een wereldwijd bedrijf waar de nuchtere Twentse cultuur bewaard is gebleven.

 

Bij ons krijg je uitdagend werk, veel vertrouwen en ruimte om jezelf te blijven

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Benelux
jobs.description:
Help fix customer-centricity at scale


Every company wants to become more customer-centric. At TheyDo, we make that ambition real. Our AI-powered journey management platform helps the world’s largest enterprises align around what matters most: their customers. By bringing scattered data and teams together, we empower smarter decisions and better experiences. Since 2019, global leaders across industries — including Ford, Cisco, Johnson & Johnson, Siemens, Home Depot, and Lufthansa — have trusted us to scale journey management and deliver measurable impact.

Backed by $50M from top-tier investors, including Blossom and 20VC, we are building a category-defining company. Our fully remote team of 100+ TheyDoers represents 30+ nationalities across 27 countries, united by a customer-led, people-first culture.

Our mission is clear: Make journey management the most powerful business tool in the world.

If you’re looking for a place where your work shapes the future of how companies operate, join us. Let’s build it together.

The role

Journey management is becoming a must-have for the world's biggest companies, and TheyDo is the platform leading the category. Enterprises like Ford, Cisco, Vodafone and Pfizer already use TheyDo to understand their customers end to end and decide where to act.

Now we're going after the rest of Europes biggest brands, and we want you leading the charge. As a Senior Account Executive, you'll take a greenfield territory of enterprise accounts, open the doors, and land the new logos that define TheyDo's next chapter.

You'll be based in the Benelux, working remotely and reporting to Stephan. You'll join a team of 6 EU AEs, backed by SDR, Enablement and Customer Success colleagues across North America and Europe.

Why this role, now

The timing couldn't be better. Customer experience has moved into the boardroom, and enterprises want a way to turn it into decisions. TheyDo gives them that, and our customers are proving it.

Europe is wide open. Your target list is full of companies that look just like the ones already buying from us, and most of them have never had a TheyDo conversation. We know what wins. Now we need someone to scale it and put their name on the logos that come next.

This is the moment to join: early enough to shape how we win, with the proof that we do.

What you'll do

This is a role built around creating revenue that didn't exist before, not managing revenue that already does.

Build your own pipeline. You'll start from a target list, not a book.

  • Own a named list of Benelux enterprise accounts and decide where to focus, based on signal rather than hope

  • Source most of your pipeline yourself through outbound, account-based plays with BDR and Marketing, events and executive networking

  • Break into accounts with no existing relationship and find the senior person who owns the customer experience problem


Win the first deal. You'll take a cold account all the way to signature.

  • Run complex, multi-stakeholder cycles from first conversation through discovery, business case, procurement and close

  • Sell on value to C-level and VP buyers across CX, Product and Digital: a business case a CFO will sign, not a feature tour

  • Land mid-to-high six-figure first deals, structured to expand, and hand them to Customer Success with the context to grow them

Shape how we win. You'll help write the European playbook.

  • Refine our ICP, messaging and sales motion based on what you see in the field

  • Share buyer insight with Product so they can act on it

  • Forecast accurately and keep the team informed through clear async updates

What this role isn't

We'd rather be clear now than have the wrong person find out six months in.

  • It isn't account management. You won't inherit renewals or an installed base to upsell. If most of your number has come from growing existing customers, this probably isn't your role.

  • It isn't inbound-led. Marketing and SDR will support you, but you'll be expected to create most of your own pipeline.

  • It isn't a finished machine. If you need fully built enablement, years of territory data and a playbook that tells you what to do next, you'll find this frustrating. If you want to help build those things, you'll find it energizing.

What we're looking for

  • 4+ years closing B2B SaaS deals, with most of that in enterprise new-business roles selling into enterprise organizations.

  • A track record of exceeding annual quotas, where the majority of your closed revenue came from net-new logos you sourced yourself. Be ready to walk us through the numbers.

  • Proven ability to land mid-to-high six-figure first deals with enterprises that weren't customers before.

  • Experience selling a platform or new-category product, where you had to create the need rather than respond to an RFP.

  • A value-selling methodology (MEDDPICC, Command of the Message or similar) you actually use, not just know.

  • Confidence engaging C-level buyers, building consensus across stakeholders and navigating enterprise procurement, security and legal

  • You'd rather start with a blank target list than a handed-over book, and you're energized by a scale-up where the product and playbook move fast

Bonus points if you have experience selling to CX, Product, Digital or Design leaders

What we offer our permanent employees:

💰 Competitive compensation and pre-IPO equity - we like to give our team members ownership with our stock package. When TheyDo succeeds, we all succeed!

🌍 Fully remote working with flexible hours - we're staunch advocates for autonomy and flexibility.

🩺 Health Insurance benefit - at TheyDo our team’s health and wellbeing are a priority. We include tailored support for every employee, regardless of location.

🌴 Flexible holiday days – We love what we do and equally love taking a break. You'll have a minimum of 25 days of paid holiday per year (pro rata), in addition to public holidays and an extra three days during our annual company-wide winter shutdown in December.

🧠 Learning and Development budget we encourage everyone to take ownership and invest in their growth and development, providing financial support to benefit you in your role and career.

🧘‍♂️Wellbeing budget - nurture your mind and body. We’ll support you in looking after you, whether it's meditation, mindfulness, or a yoga/gym membership.

👪 Paid parental leave - we'll ensure financial support and time off for you to bond with the newest little members of your family (6 months for the primary carer, and 6 weeks for the secondary carer - fully paid). We provide paid childcare leave when you need to take time out to help your little one recover.

👨‍💻Home office or co-working support - choose your ideal workspace with our home office or co-working budget. Whether you prefer the comfort of your home office or the collaborative atmosphere of a co-working space, we've got you covered.

🗺️ Company events - we regularly connect in-person to strategise, reflect or simply have fun. Our most recent company retreats were held in Spain, Portugal and France.

⚒️ Latest tech & tools - MacBook Air or Pro, we want you to have the equipment that you’re most comfortable with. We use tools such as Gather, Slack, Notion, Loom, G:Suite and naturally TheyDo to work collaboratively and asynchronously.

🚀 Continuous growth of our benefits package as we continue to grow in size

To any recruitment agencies, we appreciate you would like to support us but we do not accept any unsolicited CVs or introductions.

About TheyDo

Our core values are the driving force behind every decision we make.

We ‘Journey together’ along a path of collaboration and synchronization. In everything we do, we ‘Own it’, never shying away from taking action or making decisions. Our ‘Cloaks off’ mentality ensures that transparency and integrity reign supreme. We ‘Simply to accelerate', cutting through complexity to focus on what truly matters and moving forward with clarity and speed Moreover, ‘Customer Fueled’ innovation is at the heart of our work, as we know that the success of our product is directly linked to how we involve our customers in the process.

TheyDo is an equal opportunities employer. Our customers are diverse, and we believe our organisation should be, too. We nurture an inclusive culture where everyone feels equally important, no matter their background or status. We will never discriminate on the grounds of gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education, or race.

Our commitment to building a diverse and inclusive TheyDo includes making reasonable adjustments to the interview process. If you need any adjustments, please reach out to your Talent Partner.

If you are a woman or part of an underrepresented group, we encourage you to apply. Even if you don’t check every box — your skills and perspective could be just what we need to succeed. We value diversity and know you bring something unique to the table!

jobs.title: Medical Operations - Netherlands
jobs.description:
Build something monumental for Healthcare!

At Tandem Health we’re reimagining healthcare by putting clinicians first. Our platform - designed by clinicians, for clinicians - is built on deep insight into real-world pain points, with intuitive medical notes and workflows that truly support patient care.

We’re a fast-scaling health-tech company backed by top investors and expanding globally. We move fast, stay curious, and believe building something that matters starts with an extraordinary team. If you're passionate about impact and innovation, we'd love to meet you!

About the Role

We’re building the clinical co-pilot of the future - empowering clinicians, enhancing care delivery, and scaling impact. As part of our Global Medical Operations team, you’ll play a pivotal role in rolling out Tandem’s AI clinical operating system to some of the most influential healthcare organisations worldwide.

This is a highly visible, global role where you’ll engage directly with executives, medical leaders, and end-users. You’ll bring clinical insight into how our tools are implemented on the ground - from onboarding new organisations and refining workflows to shaping the product through continuous feedback. You’ll be at the forefront of transforming healthcare delivery, ensuring Tandem becomes an indispensable part of daily patient care for clinicians across the globe.

What You Will Do

  • Lead live product demos for prospective clients and support global commercial efforts.

  • Design and adapt workflows and templates for diverse markets and large-scale customers.

  • Partner with product, engineering, and commercial teams to deliver smooth rollouts and seamless workflow integration.

  • Represent Tandem at international conferences, workshops, and customer events.

  • Guide clinicians through onboarding, training, and day-to-day support.

  • Troubleshoot and solve problems to ensure clinicians get maximum value from Tandem.

  • Build templates and prompts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of Tandem’s AI assistant.

  • Manage clinical safety incidents and optimise internal operations for safe scaling.


What You Bring

  • Clinical experience in healthcare (e.g. general practice, hospital, private practice).

  • Exposure to consulting, corporate, or startup environments.

  • A passion for technology, AI, and their potential to transform care.

  • Strong communication skills - equally comfortable with executives, engineers, and frontline clinicians.

  • Organisational strength and a process-driven mindset.

  • Ownership, curiosity, and initiative in a fast-paced environment.

  • Flexibility to travel up to 25% and step in during critical moments.

  • Fluency in Dutch and English

Bonus Points

  • Experience with prompting or large language models (LLMs).

  • Background in healthtech or SaaS.

  • Familiarity with EU clinical safety or digital health regulations.

  • Track record in implementation projects or customer rollouts.

Location

We believe great ideas thrive when we connect in person. This is a full-time hybrid role based in Leiden with occasional travel to meet the core team in Stockholm and clinicians across the country as needed

How to Apply

We adopt a continuous selection process, so please make sure to apply with your CV in English.

Our interview process consists of 4 stages:

  1. Screening interview with Talent Acquisition

  2. First interview with our NL Country Director

  3. Follow up interview with of our NL Medical Operations team lead

  4. Working Day - Join us in the Leiden office for a day to experience our culture firsthand, collaborate with our team, and see how you work in action.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Applied AI Engineer based in Netherlands.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in designing and building the next generation of intelligent, agentic systems.
You will develop the core infrastructure that enables AI agents to manage context, use tools, coordinate tasks, and continuously improve their performance.
Working at the intersection of advanced AI research and practical software engineering, you will transform complex operational workflows into reliable, scalable production solutions.
You will establish robust evaluation, testing, and observability frameworks to ensure AI-powered systems deliver predictable and measurable results.
You will also explore innovative ways to integrate coding agents and specialized subagents into software development processes.
Collaborating closely with product and operational teams, you will identify high-impact automation opportunities and translate them into effective technical solutions.
As an early core member of the engineering team, you will have significant influence over architectural decisions, technical standards, and the long-term AI strategy.


Accountabilities

In this role, you will design and implement the technical foundations of agentic systems while driving the adoption of AI-powered engineering workflows. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design and build essential components of agentic systems, including memory, context management, tool-calling capabilities, orchestration mechanisms, and feedback loops.

  • Develop reusable AI infrastructure that enables new workflows to be introduced quickly, consistently, and with predictable reliability.

  • Build comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, identify failure points, and understand the factors behind successful outcomes.

  • Integrate testing, tracing, debugging, and evaluation into the software engineering lifecycle as fundamental practices.

  • Develop systems and validation processes that allow agentic workflows to be thoroughly assessed before production deployment.

  • Advance the use of large language models (LLMs) in software development by creating sophisticated AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • Build workflows where coding agents and specialized subagents can explore code repositories, implement changes, review architecture, validate conventions, run evaluations, and iterate with minimal human intervention.

  • Actively use agentic engineering tools and workflows in daily development activities.

  • Design architectures that enable specialized AI agents, tools, deterministic software, and human expertise to work together effectively.

  • Determine when to use LLMs, traditional software solutions, human intervention, or coordinated multi-agent approaches to achieve the best outcomes.

  • Collaborate with operational and product teams to understand existing processes, identify high-value automation opportunities, and transform them into reliable production systems.

  • Establish scalable architectural patterns and engineering standards for agentic systems as the organization grows.

  • Take ownership of technical decisions and contribute to the overall direction of the AI engineering function.

    • Requirements

    The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer with hands-on experience building production-ready AI systems and the autonomy to solve complex technical challenges in a rapidly evolving environment. The following qualifications and skills are expected:

    • Strong software engineering background, with proven experience independently delivering complex systems from initial concept through production deployment.

    • Practical experience building and deploying AI or agentic systems that have operated in production environments.

    • Demonstrated understanding of real-world AI engineering challenges, including reliability, latency, context management, failure modes, evaluation, and observability.

    • Strong knowledge of agent architectures, tool use, structured outputs, context management, orchestration, evaluation frameworks, and feedback loops.

    • Advanced practical experience with modern LLMs and the ability to build reliable workflows around probabilistic AI systems.

    • Hands-on experience using coding agents and agentic development workflows as part of everyday software engineering.

    • Ability to break down complex engineering tasks across multiple agents or specialized subagents and implement mechanisms for validating and improving their outputs.

    • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to select the right combination of AI models, deterministic software, and human intervention for different challenges.

    • Experience with TypeScript and Node.js, or strong experience developing AI systems in Python combined with the willingness and ability to work in a TypeScript-first environment.

    • High level of autonomy, ownership, and confidence making technical decisions in ambiguous situations.

    • Strong product mindset and the ability to connect engineering decisions with operational efficiency and business outcomes.

    • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English.

    • Startup mentality, including resilience, adaptability, initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

      • Benefits

About the Role

Account Management is where DataSnipper grows. Our EMEA Accounting AM team manages a book worth tens of millions in ARR across the region's leading audit and accounting firms, and we believe that book can double. The growth won't come from renewals that run themselves. It will come from moving customers onto our AI and Agents platform, defending against cheaper point solutions and free AI tools, and handling firms that keep acquiring each other.

As Senior Manager, Account Management – EMEA, you'll lead a team of 5 Account Managers, report to our EMEA Sales leader, and own retention, expansion and forecast accuracy for the region. This is a player-coach role in spirit. You'll be in the deals and in front of senior partners and executives, not managing from a dashboard.

Why DataSnipper

The best commercial opportunities don't come around every day. Selling technology that's transforming an entire industry is one of them.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals to make those judgements. With Alwin by DataSnipper, our new agentic platform, AI agents now take on end-to-end audit and finance procedures, while every conclusion stays traceable to its source. For our commercial teams, this is where things get exciting.

Alwin has just launched, demand is growing, and we're expanding into new markets and segments. With a product customers already rely on, there's a huge opportunity to make your mark.

If you're commercially driven, ambitious, and excited to build something bigger, this is you chance to help shape the future of audit and finance and accelerate your own career along the way.

You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

jobs.title: Bookkeeper (Boekhouder)
jobs.description:
Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour.

We're a growing team of engineers, operators and technicians from diverse backgrounds, including consumer tech, finance and media, and companies like Dyson, Shopify, Meta and Tesla. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision and company. You might enjoy our YouTube Channel, Based in Europe’s film on how we’re fixing Europe’s housing shortage, or this video by Andreas Klinger of what our office looks like.

About the role

We're looking for a Bookkeeper to bring our day-to-day bookkeeping and month-end close in-house. You'll be our first dedicated bookkeeper, taking over from our external accounting firm and running the books for our growing group: five Dutch BVs today, plus our entities abroad.

Our transaction volume has roughly doubled this year, and 2027 is the first financial year our accounts will be audited. You'll own the reconciliations, records and close process that make our numbers reliable, working closely with our finance lead, purchasing team and external accountants. The external accountants will continue to handle annual accounts and corporate tax, with local advisors handling tax filings abroad.

This is a hands-on bookkeeping role for someone with at least three years of experience running the full cycle through month-end. Our data and processes need cleaning up. If you enjoy turning a messy administration into a tidy one, this is that job. As you settle in, there is room to take on VAT filing and monthly payroll processing.

The role is based at our Amsterdam HQ, on-site five days a week. Salary is up to €50,000 gross a year, including the 8% holiday allowance.

What you'll do

  • Own daily bookkeeping. Code supplier invoices and card spend in Spendesk with the right GL account, VAT code and cost centre, and post them to the general ledger without re-keying. Keep supplier records clean and prepare payment runs. Supplier bank-detail changes are independently verified and approved; payment approval and release sit with the finance lead.

  • Keep accounts reconciled. Reconcile bank accounts, keep payables and receivables current, and investigate outstanding items so every balance is supported or explained.

  • Run the month-end close. Close all entities to a fixed timetable, initially by working day eight and moving towards working day five. Own accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations, collect or prepare foreign entities' figures, agree intercompany balances and reconcile group reporting to the ledgers.

  • Maintain fixed assets and inventory records. Keep the fixed-asset register up to date, including capitalisation and depreciation of our robot fleet under agreed accounting policies, and reconcile inventory accounts to month-end stock values.

  • Prepare Dutch VAT returns. Prepare quarterly btw returns with our external accountants reviewing, and take over filing them over time.

  • Keep the books audit-ready. Maintain supporting schedules and an audit file throughout the year. Be a day-to-day contact for our external accountants and support the audit of our 2027 accounts.

  • Improve how we work. Document the close, fix recurring errors and use spreadsheets, software and AI tools to reduce manual work while checking the results carefully. Depending on your experience, take on payroll processing in Loket over time, with payroll tax filings remaining with our external accountants.

What we're looking for

  • Full-cycle bookkeeping experience. You have at least three years of experience running the books through month-end, at an accounting firm (accountantskantoor) or in-house.

  • Hands-on Dutch VAT experience. You've prepared Dutch btw returns and can work through the supporting records.

  • Strong reconciliation skills. You've handled balance-sheet reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, beyond processing invoices. You investigate differences and follow them through to a resolution.

  • Accuracy and ownership. You keep records organised, meet close deadlines and raise missing information or accounting questions early. You'd rather find the €12 difference than book it to suspense.

  • Fluent English and professional working Dutch. English is our working language, and your manager doesn't speak Dutch. You can independently read and process Dutch invoices, tax correspondence and payroll documents.

  • Comfort with systems and confidential information. You work confidently with spreadsheets, learn new accounting tools and handle financial and employee information carefully.

  • Nice to have: Twinfield, Basecone or Spendesk (Exact, Odoo or similar also counts); multi-entity or multi-country bookkeeping, intercompany and consolidation; fixed-asset or inventory accounting in hardware or manufacturing; statutory audit support; Dutch payroll experience, ideally in Loket; an accounting qualification such as MBO-4/HBO, SPD or Praktijkdiploma Boekhouden; experience automating repetitive work.

Why Monumental?

Joining Monumental means being at the forefront of a movement aimed at making significant strides in the construction industry. Here, your work has the potential to impact not just the company but the future of how we build. If you're driven by innovation, eager to tackle complex challenges, and ready to make a tangible difference, we want to hear from you.

Unfortunately we do not currently support internships.

If you don't meet all the qualifications here but are excited about Monumental and feel you'd still be able to help us tackle complex challenges, do get in touch. We welcome generalists who focus on outcomes and are eager to learn on the job.

jobs.title: Process Safety Lead
jobs.description:
About the role

As SkyNRG grows, we are looking for a Process Safety Lead to build and embed our corporate Process Safety Management framework.

In this role, you will set the standards for how process safety is managed across our projects and future assets, from design and construction through commissioning and operations. Working across Engineering, Projects, Operations and HSE, you will combine technical expertise with functional leadership to strengthen process safety across the organization.

Your key responsibilities include:

  • Develop and implement SkyNRG’s corporate Process Safety Management (PSM) framework as part of the Integrated Management System.

  • Establish and embed process safety standards and procedures across current and future projects, including construction, commissioning, start-up and operations.

  • Ensure compliance with SEVESO III requirements and support the Major Accident Prevention Policy, Safety Reports, regulatory inspections and audits.

  • Govern key process safety activities, including HAZOP, LOPA, QRA and Management of Change (MOC).

  • Develop and monitor process safety KPIs and barrier management to strengthen risk control and performance.

  • Lead process safety audits, incident learning and improvement initiatives across projects and assets.

  • Build process safety capability across the organization through training, guidance and functional leadership for Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance and contractors.

Your profile

As a growing company in a rapidly evolving industry, we are looking for people who embrace change and are motivated to actively contribute to building and scaling our business. You are someone who feels comfortable in an entrepreneurial environment, takes ownership, and thrives when things are still developing.

You combine deep technical expertise with the ability to turn complex regulatory and risk-management requirements into practical standards. Structured and strategic in your approach, you are also willing to work hands-on to move implementation forward. You communicate clearly, make risk-based decisions, and can influence senior stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

You recognize yourself in the following:

  • A master’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Process Safety, or a closely related technical discipline.

  • At least five years of relevant process safety experience within oil and gas, renewable fuels, chemicals, or another major hazard environment.

  • Practical knowledge of SEVESO III requirements and their application within Major Accident Hazard facilities.

  • Demonstrated experience developing or implementing Process Safety Management frameworks, Integrated Management Systems, or corporate process safety standards.

  • Strong technical expertise in HAZOP, LOPA, QRA, Management of Change, Mechanical Integrity, contractor management, and commissioning or start-up activities.

  • Experience assessing, governing, or assuring hazard studies across projects or operational environments.

  • A proven ability to design and deliver process safety training for multidisciplinary audiences.

  • Strong incident investigation skills, with the ability to translate findings into organizational learning and sustainable improvements.

  • The ability to influence stakeholders across Engineering, Projects, Operations, Maintenance, and site leadership.

  • Professional fluency in English.

  • Experience with digital risk-assessment or barrier-management tools would be an advantage. A recognized qualification such as MoSHE, NEBOSH Process Safety, or an equivalent certification is also beneficial. Direct experience engaging with regulators or contributing to SEVESO Safety Reports would make your profile particularly relevant.

About SkyNRG

Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality.

Collaboration is fundamental to achieving our ambition. We nurture genuine relationships with global partners in our drive to make SAF the alternative to fossil jet fuel.

Our in-house team of SAF experts have helped over 60 airlines and corporates reduce their climate impact using the Book & Claim mechanism; the most transparent and traceable way to support aviation sustainability with real emission reductions.

Sustainability is woven into the fabric of our company. We maintain an independent Sustainability Board, which advises the company on feedstocks and provides strategic guidance on wide-ranging sustainability issues. SkyNRG operations are certified against the RSB EU RED, CORSIA, and Book & Claim standards.

At SkyNRG, you’ll find:

  • An innovation-driven culture – where big ideas turn into real impact

  • Growth opportunities – in a fast-scaling, industry-changing company

  • A collaborative team – where your ideas and expertise are valued

  • A mission that matters – leading the change in the energy transition by producing and supplying high-integrity SAF

What we offer

We offer a brand-new office in the heart of Amsterdam, designed for collaboration and creativity. Most importantly, you’ll have the opportunity to contribute to a truly game-changing green initiative, making a real impact on the aviation industry and the planet.

Besides that, we offer:

  • 30 paid holidays + 2 for choosing sustainable travel options for your holidays

  • Contribute to a sustainable organization (B Corp)

  • Attractive bonus scheme

  • €5.000,- dedicated budget every 3 years for professional development

  • Commuting travel reimbursement + Lease a Bike plan

  • An office in the city centre of Amsterdam (Nieuwmarkt)

  • Work where it feels best for you: we offer flexible (hybrid in-office) working arrangements

  • Generous employer pension contribution

  • Paid Volunteering Day

  • Access to our electric company boat (also available for private use), free lunch, and lots of social activities – all part of the deal!

Is this you?

Are you ready to take the next step in your career with SkyNRG? Explore our vacancies and become part of our company of change makers. Together, we can change the future of flying.

For more information about SkyNRG visit www.skynrg.com.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

jobs.title: Customer Success LATAM
VODITELJ/ICA RAČUNOVODSTVA U ŠKOLI 1
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10 -ispr, 90/11,5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 94/13, 136/14 -RUSRH, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 155/23, 156/23), članka 13. Pravilnika o radu te članaka 6. i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Ivana Gorana Kovačića (u daljnjem tekstu: Pravilnik), ravnatelj Osnovne škole Ivana Gorana Kovačića, Mesićeva 35, Zagreb objavljuje: NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa 1. VODITELJ/ICA RAČUNOVODSTVA U ŠKOLI 1 koji/koja obavlja poslove voditelja računovodstva, mjesto rada u sjedištu, po potrebi izvan sjedišta škole (do dovršetka rekonstrukcijske obnove na adresi Kaptol 16, Zagreb). 1 izvršitelj/ica na neodređeno, puno radno vrijeme (40 sati tjedno), uz uvjet probnog rada u trajanju od 3 mjeseca Na natječaj se mogu javiti muške i ženske osobe u skladu sa Zakonom o ravnopravnosti spolova (Narodne novine 82/08 i 69/17). Uvjeti: Opći uvjet za zasnivanje radnog odnosa i posebni uvjeti prema Pravilniku o radu: završen sveučilišni diplomski studij ekonomije odnosno sveučilišni integrirani prijediplomski i diplomski studij ekonomije odnosno stručni diplomski studij ekonomije odnosno sveučilišni prijediplomski studij ekonomije ili stručni prijediplomski studij ekonomije odnosno viša ili visoka stručna sprema ekonomske struke stečena prema ranijim propisima i godina dana radnog iskustva na poslovima proračunskog računovodstva. U radni odnos ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19 i 64/20, 155/23, 156/23). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, kontakt podaci (broj telefona/mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti: životopis diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (kandidat koji je stekao inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužan je priložiti odgovarajuće rješenje o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije) dokaz o državljanstvu uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici. Prije sklapanja ugovora o radu odabrani/a kandidat/kinja dužan/na je sve navedene priloge odnosno isprave dostaviti u izvorniku ili u preslici ovjerenoj od strane javnog bilježnika sukladno Zakonu o javnom bilježništvu (Narodne novine broj 78/93, 29/94, 162/98, 16/07, 75/09, 120/16). Osobe koje se pozivaju na pravo prednosti sukladno članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), članku 48. f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (Narodne novine broj 33/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 2/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03 i 148/13, 98/19), članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine broj 157/13, 152/14, 39/18, 32/20) te članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine broj 121/17, 98/19, 84/21, 156/23), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su priložiti i dokaze propisane člankom 103. stavak 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji. Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Osobe koje ostvaruju pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), uz prijavu na natječaj dužne su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu dostaviti i dokaze iz stavka 1. članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata Poveznica na internetsku stranicu Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja s popisom dokaza potrebnih za ostvarivanja prava prednosti: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat/kinja koji/a je pravodobno dostavo/la potpunu prijavu sa svim prilozima odnosno ispravama i ispunjava uvjete natječaja dužan/a je pristupiti vrednovanju prema odredbama Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Ivana Gorana Kovačića koji je dostupan na sljedećoj poveznici mrežne stranice Osnovne škole Ivana Gorana Kovačića: https://os-igkovacic-zg.skole.hr/dokumenti/skolski-dokumenti/ Kandidat koji je prijavljen na natječaj, o načinu, sadržaju, vremenu i mjestu održavanja vrednovanja bit će obaviješten minimalno 5 dana prije datuma održavanja vrednovanja kandidata i to putem mrežne stranice Škole: https://os-igkovacic-zg.skole.hr/najnovije-vijesti/natjecaji/. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice škole: https://os-igkovacic-zg.skole.hr/najnovije-vijesti/natjecaji/ u roku 8 dana od dana sklapanja ugovora s izabranim kandidatom. Kandidat koji se na natječaj pozivao na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima o rezultatima natječaja izvješćuje se pisanom preporučenom pošiljkom s povratnicom. Kandidat/kinja prijavom na natječaj daje privolu za obradu osobnih podataka navedenih u svim dostavljenim prilozima odnosno ispravama za potrebe provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim propisima o zaštiti osobnih podataka. Rok za podnošenje prijave na natječaj je osam dana od dana objave natječaja. Prijave na natječaj s dokazima o ispunjavanju propisanih uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se neposredno ili poštom na adresu Kaptol 16, 10000 Zagreb s naznakom „za natječaj: naziv radnog mjesta“. Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati.

jobs.employer: DOM ZA STARIJE I NEMOĆNE OSOBE VARAŽDIN
jobs.description:
Uvjeti:
  • završen specijalistički diplomski stručni ili diplomski sveučilišni studij, odnosno integrirani preddiplomski i diplomski sveučilišni studij ekonomije,
  • četiri godine radnog iskustva u struci,
  • vozačka dozvola B kategorije.
Probni rad u trajanju 6 mjeseci. Uz zamolbu kandidati su dužni priložiti:
  • životopis,
  • dokaz o državljanstvu (preslika domovnice),
  • dokaz o stručnoj spremi (preslika diplome),
  • elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje (dokaz o radnom stažu, ne starije od 30 dana),
  • uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak (ne starije od 30 dana),
  • preslika vozačke dozvole.
Svi dokumenti prilažu se u neovjerenim preslikama. Izabrani kandidat dužan je prije sklapanja ugovora o radu predočiti izvornike dokumenata na uvid. Za sve kandidate ne smije postojati zapreka iz članka 261. Zakona o socijalnoj skrbi (NN 18/22, 46/22, 119/22, 71/23, 156/23, 61/25), što provjerava poslodavac. Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima, dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo, odnosno priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju. Pismene prijave na natječaj podnose se u roku od 8 dana od objave u Narodnim novinama, osobno ili poštom na adresu: Dom za starije i nemoćne osobe Varaždin, Zavojna 6, 42000 Varaždin, s naznakom „Natječaj za zapošljavanje – SAVJETNIK/CA (VODITELJ/ICA RAČUNOVODSTVA)“. Potpunom prijavom smatra se ona koja sadrži sve podatke i priloge navedene u natječaju. Nepotpune i nepravodobne prijave neće se razmatrati. Prijavom na natječaj kandidati su izričito suglasni da Dom za starije i nemoćne osobe Varaždin kao voditelj obrade osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. Ustanova pridržava pravo ne izvršiti izbor kandidata po ovom natječaju, bez obrazloženja kao i pravo poništenja natječaja u cijelosti ili jednom njegovom dijelu. O rezultatu izbora kandidati će biti obaviješteni putem internet stranice poslodavca u roku od 30 dana od dana isteka roka za podnošenje prijava. Napomena: Natječaj se objavljuje u Narodnim novinama te rok za prijavu počinje teći sljedećeg dana od objave u Narodnim novinama.

Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (Narodne novine, broj 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14., 07/17, 68/18, 98/19., 64/20., 151/22.,155/23., i 156/23.,) te iz članka 28. Pravilnika o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN broj 6/19 i 75/20). U radni odnos ne može biti primljena osoba za čiji prijam postoje zapreke za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz čl. 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10, 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19 i 64/20, 155/23, 156/23). U prijavi na natječaj navode se osobni podaci podnositelja prijave (osobno ime, adresa stanovanja, kontakt podaci (broj telefona/mobitela, e-mail adresa) i naziv radnog mjesta na koje se prijavljuje. Uz vlastoručno potpisanu prijavu na natječaj potrebno je priložiti: životopis diplomu odnosno dokaz o stečenoj stručnoj spremi (kandidat koji je stekao inozemnu obrazovnu kvalifikaciju dužan je priložiti odgovarajuće rješenje o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije) dokaz o državljanstvu uvjerenje da nije pod istragom i da se protiv kandidata/kinje ne vodi kazneni postupak glede zapreka za zasnivanje radnog odnosa iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi ne starije od dana raspisivanja natječaja elektronički zapis ili potvrdu o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje Navedene isprave odnosno prilozi dostavljaju se u neovjerenoj preslici. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine broj 84/21), dužne su u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu, a imaju prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. jobs.title: DOCENT/DOCENTICA IZ ZNANSTVENOG POLJA ELEKTROTEHNIKA
jobs.description:
Sveučilište u Rijeci TEHNIČKI FAKULTET raspisuje NATJEČAJ za izbor
  • jednog nastavnika na znanstveno-nastavno radno mjesto docent, u radnom odnosu na neodređeno vrijeme s punim radnim vremenom, za znanstveno područje Tehničke znanosti, znanstveno polje Elektrotehnika, za rad na Zavodu za automatiku i elektroniku.
Pisanoj i potpisanoj prijavi na natječaj se prilaže:
  1. životopis,
  2. prikaz znanstvene, nastavne i stručne djelatnosti,
  3. odluke o prethodnom izboru/reizboru na radno mjesto/u naslovni izbor nastavnika (ako pristupnik posjeduje),
  4. dokaz o odgovarajućoj stručnoj spremi (akademski stupanj doktora znanosti u odgovarajućem znanstvenom području i polju),
  5. popis radova i relevantne radove,
  6. dokaze o ispunjavanju kriterija sukladno Nacionalnim sveučilišnim, znanstvenim i umjetničkim kriterijima (NN 42/26.),
  7. važeći dokaz o državljanstvu (hrvatskom ili drugom).
Kandidati na natječaju moraju ispunjavati kriterije za znanstveno-nastavna radna mjesta propisane Zakonom o visokom obrazovanju i znanstvenoj djelatnosti (NN 119/22. i 110/26., članci 39. i 40.) i Nacionalnim sveučilišnim, znanstvenim i umjetničkim kriterijima (NN 42/26.). Probni rad je šest mjeseci. Na natječaj pod jednakim uvjetima mogu se prijaviti osobe obaju spolova. Pojmovi koji imaju rodni značaj koriste se neutralno i odnose se jednako na muški i ženski rod. Kandidati kojima hrvatski jezik nije materinji jezik moraju priložiti dokaz o poznavanju hrvatskog jezika (razina B2) prema Zajedničkom europskom referentnom okviru za jezike. Kandidati koji su stekli obrazovanje izvan Republike Hrvatske, moraju dostaviti obrazloženo mišljenje nadležne agencije o inozemnoj obrazovnoj kvalifikaciji. Kandidati koji se na temelju posebnih propisa - Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17., 98/19., 84/21. i 156/23.), članka 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21.), članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92., 57/92., 77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 02/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01., 103/03., 148/13. i 98/19.), članka 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.), pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, obvezni su u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze koje posebni propisi propisuju za ostvarivanje tog prava. Navedeni kandidati ostvaruju prednost pri zapošljavanju u odnosu na ostale kandidate, samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema Zakonu o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (NN 121/17., 98/19., 84/21, 156/23.), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 103. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (NN 84/21), dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti svu potrebnu dokumentaciju predviđenu člankom 49. predmetnog Zakona, prema popisu na poveznici: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages/dokumenti/Nikola/popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/13., 152/14., 39/18. i 32/20.) u prijavi na natječaj dužni su se pozvati na to pravo te priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Dokazom o invaliditetu smatraju se javne isprave o invaliditetu na temelju kojih se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom koji se vodi pri Hrvatskom zavodu za mirovinsko osiguranje https://mrosp.gov.hr/najcesca-pitanja-i-odgovori-7348/zakon-o-profesionalnoj-rehabilitaciji-izaposljavanju-osoba-s-invaliditetom-7475/pod-kojim-uvjetima-osobe-s-invaliditetom-ostvarujuprednost-pri-zaposljavanju-7477/7477 Prijavom na natječaj, kandidati natječaja su izričito suglasni da Tehnički fakultet, Sveučilišta u Rijeci kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati podatke u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno važećim pozitivnim pravnim propisima. Prijave se podnose najkasnije u roku od 30 dana od raspisivanja natječaja u Narodnim novinama. Prijave na natječaj i traženi prilozi u skeniranom obliku dostavljaju se isključivo putem elektroničke pošte, u PDF formatu na adresu: pisarnica@riteh.uniri.hr Fakultet pridržava pravo provesti testiranje kandidata, a o čemu će kandidati koji su predali pravovremene i potpune prijave, koje udovoljavaju svim formalnim uvjetima natječaja biti naknadno obaviješteni. Kandidati koji se ne odazovu razgovoru pred povjerenstvom i/ili testiranju gube status kandidata i mogućnost sudjelovanja u daljnjem kvalifikacijskom postupku. Fakultet pridržava pravo poništiti natječaj i ne izabrati ni jednog kandidata, bez posebnog obrazloženja. Nepotpune, nepravovremene te prijave koje ne udovoljavaju formalnim uvjetima natječaja neće se razmatrati. Obavijest o ishodu natječajnog postupka će biti objavljena po završetku natječajnog postupka na: https://riteh.uniri.hr/ Opis poslova: 1. svi oblici neposrednog izvođenja prijediplomske, diplomske i poslijediplomske nastave: predavanja, seminari, vježbe, terenska nastava, e-kolegiji 2. priprema za nastavu te nadzor i organizacija rada suradnika na predmetu 3. poslovi koji se smatraju sastavnim dijelom nastavnog opterećenja: (ispiti, kolokviji, konzultacije, seminarski radovi) 4. poslovi mentorstva u samostalnom radu studenata (završni, diplomski radovi, mentorstvo doktorata i slično) 5. ostali poslovi vezani za nastavu kao na primjer:
  • sudjelovanje u raznim stručnim povjerenstvima (obrane i ocjene završnih radova na svim razinama studija), usavršavanje u nastavnim vještinama, izrada vodiča i godišnjaka studija, korekcije programa, pregled programa i dnevnika prakse, dežurstva na ispitima; izrada satnice, pisanje, uređivanje i recenziranje udžbenika i priručnika, skripti zbirke zadataka i slično
6. Poslovi zaposlenika u znanosti i istraživanju u okviru ukupnog godišnjeg fonda radnih sati su:
  • znanstvenoistraživački rad te znanstveno usavršavanje i publiciranje radova kroz rad na kompetitivnim nacionalnim i međunarodnim projektima te rad na znanstveno-istraživačkimprojektima ustanove
  • rad na pripremi projekata
  • uredništvo znanstvenih časopisa u znanstvenom dijelu posla (editorial board), recenziranje znanstvenih radova i projekata
  • stručni rad kao pretpostavka ili posljedica znanstvenog istraživanja uključujući rad na inovacijama (razvoj koncepta, patenti)
7. Znanstveni i stručni rad za tržište 8. Poslovi institucijskog doprinosa - rad u stručnim vijećima i povjerenstvima ustanove, rad u senatu sveučilišta, matičnim povjerenstvima, nacionalnim tijelima, organizacija znanstvenih i stručnih konferencija, uređivanje i izdavanje znanstvenih časopisa, stručni rad, popularizacija znanosti te administrativni poslovi uz nastavu i znanost ulaze u godišnji fond standardnog redovnog radnog vremena. Za svoj je rad neposredno odgovoran predstojniku zavoda te dekanu.

jobs.description: Rad u domu za starije i nemoćne osobe; pomoć korisnicima pri obavljanju higijene, hranjenju i oblačenju, pomoć kod lijeganja i dizanja iz kreveta. jobs.title: RADNIK/RADNICA NA BAZENU/PLAŽI/SPORTU
jobs.description: Opis poslova: nadgledanje sigurnosti na bazenu, plaži i sportskim sadržajima radi sprječavanja nesreća i ozljeda postavljanje ležaljki na bazenu/plaži, podizanje i spuštanje suncobrana donošenje čistih ručnika i odnošenje prljavih pružanje pomoći gostima u korištenju bazenskih i sportskih sadržaja te pružanje informacija o pravilima i uređajima redovito održavanje čistoće i urednosti na bazenu i plaži, uključujući i održavanje higijene prostora za sport organizacija i provedba sportskih aktivnosti i animacija za goste praćenje stanja opreme i sustava na bazenu te održavanje potrebne dokumentacije suradnja s ostalim članovima tima i podrška u organizaciji događanja na bazenu i plaži

jobs.title: WELLNESS KOZMETIČAR/WELLNESS KOZMETIČARKA
jobs.description: Opis poslova: izvodi dnevne tretmane lica, tijela, manikure, pedikure,masaže,depilacije i ostale kozmetičke usluge u skladu s hotelskim standardima i pravilima struke u aplikativnom sustavu uredno evidentira izvršene tretmane i postavljene zadatke održava radni prostor, kabine i korištene uređaje čistima, urednima i funkcionalnima kontrolira ispravnost uređaja, prijavljuje kvarove i evidentira ih u aplikaciji vodi brigu o zalihama potrošnog materijala i kozmetičkih proizvoda potrebnih za rad te pravovremeno prijavljuje potrebe za narudžbom brine o higijeni rublja, ručnika i ostalog tekstila koji se koristi pri tretmanima održava dodijeljeni skladišni i radni prostor čistim i urednim informira i savjetuje goste o uslugama i proizvodima wellness centra te aktivno sudjeluje u prodaji kozmetičkih proizvoda obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu direktno nadređenih

jobs.title: RADNIK/RADNICA U HORTIKULTURI
jobs.description: Opis poslova: rad na otvorenom njeguje i održava hortikulturne biljke unutar i oko objekta priprema gredice za sadnju biljaka, sadi i njeguje biljke, vodi brigu o revitalizaciji i održavanju gredica s biljkama, parkovnih i travnatih površina te oštećenih biljaka rukuje sa sredstvima rada na održavanju i oblikovanju zelenih površina i raslinja, uklanjanju starog drveća i raslinja, sasušenih grana i panjeva te sadnje novog prilikom izvršenja poslova sa povećanom opasnošću ima obve sa povećanom opasnošću ima obvezu korištenja propisanih sredstava zaštite na radu, primjenjuje SZB i gnojiva, uočavanje kvara i osnovni popravak sistema za navodnjavanje, čišćenje i održavanje sredstva za rad, uređaja i opreme te prostora, okoliša i zelenih površina, rad prema SOP i uputama za rad na siguran način, radi i druge poslove u okviru hortikulture po uputama voditelja hortikulture ili direktora hortikulture.

jobs.description: Temeljem čl. 26. Zakona o predškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju, ne starije od mjesec dana od objave natječaja; - potvrdu nadležnog Hrvatskog zavoda za socijalni rad da kandidat nema izrečenu mjeru žurnog izdvajanja djeteta iz obitelji ili mjeru za zaštitu osobnih prava i dobrobiti djeteta u nadležnosti suda sukladno članku 25. st. 10.
