jobs.description: Si pour vous avoir la tête dans les nuages c'est travailler dans le cloud, on est fait pour être ensemble.Vous aimez concevoir des architectures robustes et sécurisées qui font avancer toute une organisation ? Ce qui vous anime, c'est transformer des sujets complexes - multi-cloud, sécurité, industrialisation - en solutions concrètes au service des équipes et des clients ? Alors rejoignez notre équipe cloud pour faire grandir ensemble notre offre de service Kubernetes.Ce que l'on vous propose :Au sein de notre équipe cloud, composée de DevOps, SRE, architectes cloud et experts cybersécurité, vous contribuerez à concevoir et faire évoluer une offre de service Kubernetes multiplateforme, industrialisée, sécurisée et self-service, destinée à nos équipes internes comme à nos clients.Ensemble, nous opérons des solutions multi-provider sur AWS, Azure et GCP, avec l'ambition de construire un socle technique fiable, performant et évolutif. Ce poste vous offre une vision à 360° : architecture, réseau, sécurité, FinOps et run, avec une véritable liberté de conception et de choix d'architecture.Ce que vous ferez au quotidien :Au cœur de l'équipe, vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie de notre plateforme Kubernetes :- Concevoir l'architecture de clusters EKS/GKE, en couvrant la multi-tenancy, le réseau, le stockage et plan de reprise d'activité et observabilité via des SLO.- Piloter la démarche FinOps et définir la vision technique à moyen et long terme (serverless, event-driven, Kubernetes avancé).- Accompagner les clients et les équipes dans leur onboarding, et contribuer au mentoring et à la montée en compétences collective.À propos de vous :- Vous justifiez d'une expérience de 5 à 8 ans et plus en ingénierie cloud, avec une expertise reconnue sur Kubernetes (EKS et/ou GKE) et au moins un provider majeur (AWS, GCP).- Vous disposez d'une solide culture sécurité couvrant les dimensions réseau, applicatif, IAM, supply chain et conformité.- Vous maîtrisez Terraform et les approches d'infrastructure as code, ainsi que les pipelines CI/CD en GitOps.- Vous portez une sensibilité FinOps qui vous permet d'allier performance technique et maîtrise des coûts.- Vous êtes reconnu pour votre leadership technique et votre capacité à embarquer les équipes autour d'une vision commune.- Vous appréciez transmettre votre expertise et accompagner la montée en compétences de vos collègues comme de vos clients.Les prochaines étapes pour nous rejoindre :- Sélection de votre candidature par notre équipe de recrutement.- Deux à trois entretiens maximum avec nos équipes pour mieux vous connaître et vous présenter l'entreprise.- Prise de contact par Chloé, votre interlocutrice dédiée.Pour faire équipe avec nous, postulez dès maintenant ! #OnEstFaitPourEtreEnsemble

jobs.title: Feltsense AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About the company

We raised $5.1M to build agents that operate as fully autonomous founders. Our backers include Matt Schlicht (founder of Moltbook), the founders of Crunchbase and Republic, and VCs including Draper, Precursor, and Liquid2.

We're working at the frontier of autonomous systems, building agents that don't just chat, but run entire businesses.

Our system identifies business opportunities through market signals, validates ideas with live ad tests, builds and launches software products, and brings in human experts wherever agents fall short. That loop already runs end to end: from idea to launched product to first revenue.

Over the next 12 months, our focus is on reliability, throughput, and self-improvement, making every launch better than the last.

About the role

We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to take ownership of the architecture and development of our autonomous agent system.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

You'll be expected to ship production code, make key technical decisions, improve agent behavior in production, and help establish the engineering standards as the company scales.

Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture and make key technical decisions across the platform.

  • Design and build multi-agent systems and orchestration infrastructure that take products from idea to launch.

  • Develop self-improving agent harnesses, including feedback loops, evaluation systems, and memory.

  • Build and maintain AI-powered backend services on top of LLM APIs such as Anthropic, OpenAI, and Gemini.

  • Write production code, particularly around agent runtime and orchestration.

  • Debug and improve AI behavior in production through prompt engineering, structured outputs, retries, and fallbacks.

  • Break down complex technical challenges into actionable milestones and prioritize the engineering roadmap.

  • Establish engineering standards around code reviews, testing, observability, and release processes.

  • Lead and support the engineering team while remaining deeply involved in implementation.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of professional software engineering experience.

  • Previous technical leadership experience at an early-stage company (Founding Engineer, Tech Lead, Head of Engineering, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.

  • Daily hands-on experience with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, or similar tools. You should know how to delegate work to agents, review their output, and verify what they build.

Nice to have

  • Strong TypeScript and Node.js experience.

  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK, Claude Agent SDK, or building custom agent runtimes.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Supabase, and pgvector.

  • Familiarity with background job systems such as Inngest or Pub/Sub.

  • Experience with Zod, Vitest, and GCP Cloud Run.

  • Experience growing or restructuring distributed engineering teams.

  • Interest in AI evaluation, safety, and observability.

jobs.title: Operations Expert with Python for AI Supply Chain Task Design
jobs.description:
Overview

A fast-growing AI data company is hiring supply chain practitioners to design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks for evaluating AI agents. You will turn real planning work into end-to-end challenges, each with files, a working solution and an automated correctness check. The goal is to build a benchmark grounded in real operations work.

***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***

Responsibilities

â¢ Design expert-level Terminal-Bench tasks by turning a real supply chain task from your work into a challenge an AI agent solves end to end.

â¢ Define the files, data exports and systems each task runs on, such as ERP, MES and WMS extracts, so the scenario reflects realistic planning conditions.

â¢ Write a working solution for each task, for example a 5-day production plan, and confirm it can be solved in 60 to 75 minutes.

â¢ Build the automated check that proves the result is correct, using tests or scripts that accept valid answers and catch planning errors objectively.

â¢ Document the written rules, constraints and SOPs that decide each case, along with realistic edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors from your process.

â¢ Iterate on tasks based on reviewer feedback, keeping instructions unambiguous, data consistent and the solution and verification reproducible in a command-line environment.

Skills/Experience

â¢ 3+ years of hands-on supply chain or production planning work (not only studying, selling or managing it), or a PhD with active research in the subfield

â¢ Did the work within the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used

â¢ Personally executed a process where each case is decided by written rules such as SOPs, planning rules or constraints

â¢ Worked inside systems of record (ERP, WMS) and with their exports or reports

â¢ Can describe edge cases, data inconsistencies and common planner errors, and how a mistake would be caught

â¢ Technical fluency in Python or another language and the command line, plus files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases

â¢ Available to start around November 4, 2026

Nice-to-have

â¢ Automated or audited the process with scripts, SQL, RPA or rules engines

â¢ 5+ years in the same process family

â¢ Docker, Git and experience writing tests

â¢ Hands-on experience with SAP or other ERPs and TMS/WMS platforms

â¢ Advanced Excel skills

Process

â¢ Task-based engagement paid per task, with each task taking about 60 to 75 minutes

â¢ Vetting task instead of a live interview

â¢ Tasks are reviewed by the client before approval

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:



Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in German.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €234,000 - €246,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Commercial, CEE
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

 - Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

 - Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

 - Orchestrate the right partners while maintaining ownership. Engage BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists at the right moments, with clear context and asks, while owning opportunity momentum, customer communication, and next steps.

 - Drive customer value and commercial growth after signature. Partner with Outcomes Architects, guide the initial path to value with a clear adoption plan, on onboarding and ongoing multi-workflow adoption, and own expansion strategy and renewal planning. Stay accountable for translating credits sold into credits consumed, and surface risks or expansion opportunities as customer workflows mature.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Commercial ownership and pipeline generation. You can demonstrate how you created or advanced business, influenced customer decisions, and owned measurable outcomes. Relevant experience may come from quota-carrying sales or adjacent customer-facing roles.

 - Technical fluency and builder mindset. You are comfortable building live in software and can demo, co-design, and troubleshoot with a customer without needing a specialist in the room.

 - AI fluency. You are excited about AI, build with new tools, and continually learn new ways of working.

 - Discovery, qualification, and value articulation. You can uncover customer needs, map workflows, qualify business impact and urgency, and translate what you learn into commercial outcomes, adoption plans, and clear success criteria.

 - Agency, urgency, and learning velocity. You set clear goals, take initiative, learn from customer interactions, and apply those learnings to improve outcomes. You bring new ideas and workflows to customers and make complex problems easier to solve.

 - Complex customer engagement. You can lead multi-stakeholder interactions and navigate procurement, legal, and security review cycles.

 - Fluency in Polish or Czech.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Full-cycle B2B software sales experience or solutions engineering experience, with a consistent track record of exceeding quota across new-logo acquisition and expansion motions.
   
   - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models and the ability to structure credit-based commercial proposals.

 - Prior experience selling to mid-market and enterprise accounts in productivity, collaboration, or workflow software.

 - Experience in a shared account ownership model, partnering with a post-sale or Customer Success team as part of an integrated customer motion.
   
   

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role's scope and complexity, and the candidate's experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. The estimated range for total on target earnings (including base salary and on target incentive pay) for this role is €174,000 - €186,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!
jobs.description: Etsimme vahvistusta Factoryn HR-tiimiin!Oletko ihmisläheinen tekijä, joka viihtyy ravintoloiden arjessa, innostuu asioiden järjestämisestä ja uskaltaa tarttua haastaviinkin tilanteisiin? Meillä voisi olla sinulle paikka!Factorylla on 28 ravintolaa Helsingissä, Espoossa, Vantaalla, Salossa, Hämeenlinnassa ja Lahdessaja kasvumme jatkuu!Meillä työskentelee paljon pitkäaikaisia työntekijöitä, joiden osaaminen ja kokemus ovat tärkeä osa Factorya.Nyt etsimme HR-tiimiimme uutta työkaveria tukemaan henkilöstömme ja ravintoloidemme arkea.Meillä henkilöstötyötä tehdään lähellä ihmisiä: ravintoloissa, esihenkilöiden rinnalla ja yhdessä monikulttuurisen työyhteisömme kanssa.Päiviin mahtuu kohtaamisia, käytännön järjestelyjä, uuden ideointia ja yhdessä onnistumisen iloa.Millaista arkea sinulle olisi luvassa?Olet tärkeä tuki ravintoloidemme esihenkilöille niin päivittäisissä kysymyksissä kuin haastavammissakin henkilöstötilanteissa.Työhösi kuuluu:- Esihenkilöiden ja henkilöstön tukemista arjessa: kuuntelemista, neuvomista ja käytännön ravintolatilanteiden ratkomista yhdessä.- Innostavaa rekrytointia, jossa Factoryn työkulttuuri pääsee näkyviin, sekä perehdyttämistä ja uusien työntekijöiden tukemista, jotta he tuntevat itsensä tervetulleiksi ja pääsevät sujuvasti osaksi työyhteisöä.- Toimipistekierroksia ja henkilöstön kohtaamista ravintoloiden arjessa. Hahmotat toiminnan kokonaisuuden, ymmärrät työhön kohdistuvat odotukset ja asiakkaan polun sekä tartut reippaasti havaittuihin kehityskohteisiin yhdessä henkilöstön ja esihenkilöiden kanssa.- Uusien ravintoloiden avausten valmistelua ja avauksissa mukana olemista, henkilöstön perehdyttämistä sekä päivittäisen työohjelman ja arjen toimintatapojen rakentamista. Luoden hyvää työilmapiiriä ja yhteistä Factoryn toimintakulttuuria.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstötarpeiden ennakoinnissa, työntekijöiden koordinoinnissa toimipisteiden välillä sekä lomien ja sijaistusten järjestelyissä.- Työsuhteen eri vaiheisiin liittyvien asioiden hoitamista, työsopimusten huolellista valmistelua sekä henkilöstötietojen tarkkaa ja ajantasaista ylläpitoa eri järjestelmissä.Lisäksi tehtäviin kuuluu työnteko-oikeuden ja oleskelulupien tarkistamista.- Henkilöstöviestintää, aktiivista kommunikointia ja ohjeistusten päivittämistä. Varmistat, että tieto kulkee ja ohjeet ymmärretään huomioimalla ihmisten erilaiset oppimistavat ja tuen tarpeet.- Tiivistä yhteistyötä palkanlaskennan kanssa, palkkoihin liittyvien kysymysten selvittämistä sekä molemminpuolista tukea ja apua arjen työtehtävissä.- Työkyvyn ja työhyvinvoinnin tukemista sekä esihenkilöiden tukemista varhaisen tuen keskusteluissa. Meille välitön välittäminen tarkoittaa huolten huomaamista, kuuntelemista ja tuen tarjoamista ajoissa.- Esihenkilöiden tukemista henkilöstön johtamisessa, nopeaa reagointia arjen tilanteisiin sekä vaikeiden asioiden puheeksi ottamista. Tässä tarvitaan taitoa kuunnella, rohkeutta keskustella ja halua löytää ratkaisuja.- Koulutusten ja harjoittelujen koordinointia sekä henkilöstön osaamisen kehittämistä. Meille on tärkeää, että työntekijämme saavat mahdollisuuksia oppia uutta, kehittyä ja edetä urallaan.- Yhteistyötä kumppaneidemme, kuten oppilaitosten ja työterveyshuollon, kanssa. Huolehdit avoimesta yhteydenpidosta ja sujuvasta yhteistyöstä, jotta asiat etenevät ja tuki tavoittaa oikeat ihmiset.- HR-käytäntöjen ideointia ja kehittämistä, jotta arki pysyy sujuvana ja toimintatapamme kehittyvät yrityksen kasvun mukana.Kaiken keskiössä ovat ihmiset ja arjen sujuminen. Tehtävässä pääset sekä suunnittelemaan että tarttumaan käytännön tekemiseen, oman tiimin tuella.Millainen työkaveri sopisi meidän HR-tiimiin?Toivomme, että olet helposti lähestyttävä, oma-aloitteinen ja luotettava.Pidät monta lankaa käsissäsi ja kohtaat ihmiset lämpimästi myös kiireen keskellä. Innostut uusista asioista ja tuot rohkeasti omia ideoitasi esiin.Teet töitä pilke silmäkulmassa ja tuot huumorillasi hyvää fiilistä arkeen!Kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi, sillä saat tiimiltämme tukea työtehtäviisi.Tehtävässä tarvitset:- Hyviä tietoteknisiä taitoja ja valmiutta oppia käyttämään erilaisia HR- ja rekrytointijärjestelmiä.- Erinomaista suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen taitoa, ilmaiset itseäsi sujuvasti sekä kirjallisesti että suullisesti molemmilla kielillä.- Oman auton ja ajokortin, sillä työ sisältää liikkumista toimipisteidemme välillä.- Valmiutta ja joustavuutta työskennellä pääsääntöisesti pääkaupunkiseudulla sekä tehdä käyntejä ja yrityksen laajentuessa työskennellä myös sen ulkopuolella.- Ravintolan toimintatapojen tuntemusta ja valmiutta perehdyttää työntekijöitä. Ravintola-alan työkokemus on meille ehdoton plussa!- Hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja organisointitaitoja sekä hienotunteisuutta henkilöstöasioiden käsittelyssä.- Aikaisempi kokemus tiimin johtamisesta ja kokonaisuuden hallinnasta.Mitä saat meiltä?- Rempseän työtiimin, jossa saat kysyä, olla oma itsesi ja ratkoa asioita yhdessä.- Kokeneita, pitkään talossa olleita työkavereita sekä perehdytystä ja tukea työtehtäviisi.- Joustavan työajan ja pääsääntöisesti arkiaamuihin painottuvan työn. Mahdollisuuden tehdä satunnaisesti etätöitä.- Monipuolisen tehtävän jatkuvasti kasvavassa ravintolayrityksessä.- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ja ideoida toimintatapojamme sekä edetä urallasi.- Työn, jossa oman tekemisesi vaikutus näkyy ihmisten ja ravintoloiden arjessa.- Toimistomme sijaitsee Helsingin Pitäjänmäellä. Työskentelet sekä toimistolla että ravintoloissamme.Etsimme pitkäaikaista työkaveria ja toivomme, että viihdyt meillä pitkään. Olisitko sinä sopiva meidän HR-tiimiimme?Haluaisimme kuulla sinusta!Lähetä persoonallinen hakemuksesi ja CV palkkatoiveineen.Kerro meille, kuka olet, osaamisesi ja mikä sinua innostaa työssä Factoryn HR-tiimissä.Haku on avoinna toistaiseksi.Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä, joten lähetäthän hakemuksesi pian!

  • Gode, hjælpsomme kolleger og en uformel omgangstone, hvor vi hjælper hinanden i mål.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV hurtigst muligt til kontakt@hafniabad.dk

jobs.title: PA for direktøren på Voksenområdet i Ikast-Brande Kommune
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde helt tæt på topledelsen af de store velfærdsområder i en udviklingsorienteret kommune? Er du god til at skabe overblik og holde styr på detaljerne – også i en travl hverdag? Er du imødekommende og god til at skabe relationer? Så er du måske vores nye medarbejder i Ikast-Brande Kommune.

Direktørområdet består af de tre afdelinger Socialafdelingen, Arbejdsmarked- og Borgerserviceafdelingen samt Sundheds- og Ældreafdelingen. I det daglige vil du skulle arbejde tæt sammen med kolleger i direktørområdets øvrige stabe og områder. Du refererer direkte til direktøren.

Om stillingen

Du får en bred berøringsflade i kommunen og et indgående kendskab til strategisk ledelse og styring på kommunalt toplederniveau. Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet, at:

  • primært understøtte direktørens daglige arbejde med kalenderstyring, mødekoordinering, prioritering af henvendelser og praktisk opfølgning
  • planlægge og koordinere møder, seminarer og andre ledelsesaktiviteter, herunder udarbejdelse af dagsordner, referater og opfølgning på aftaler 
  • betjene chefgruppen med dagsorden og referat til chefmøderne 
  • udarbejde beslutningsgrundlag, notater, præsentationer og kommunikation
  • udarbejde sagsfremstillinger til politiske udvalg samt kommunens direktion
  • koordinere beredskabsplanlægningen på Voksenområdet samt andre koordineringsopgaver

Din profil

Vi søger en kollega, der er nysgerrig, serviceminded og har blik for både detaljer og helheder. Du trives med at arbejde i et krydsfelt mellem administrative- og ledelsesunderstøttende opgaver. Du er proaktiv, god til at følge op og kan håndtere fortrolige oplysninger.

Derudover forventes det, at du

  • kan prioritere og bevare overblikket, når flere opgaver kræver din opmærksomhed.
  • kan kommunikere klart og præcist – både skriftligt og mundtligt.
  • arbejder selvstændigt og tager initiativ til at følge op.
  • har forståelse for arbejdet i en politisk styret organisation.

Din uddannelsesmæssige baggrund er ikke afgørende. Det vigtigste for os er, at du har en relevant uddannelse eller praktisk erfaring, der gør dig i stand til at lykkes i og trives med stillingen. Vi kunne eksempelvis forestille os, at du er kontoruddannet eller har en relevant videregående uddannelse på bachelor- eller kandidatniveau. Men måske er det en helt tredje baggrund, der gør, at du er den helt rette til stillingen. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Varierede opgaver og mange berøringsflader, og dermed en alsidig hverdag.
  • En organisation som møder hinanden med dialog, tillid og ansvarlighed.
  • En arbejdsplads med gode kolleger.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold:

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår efter gældende overenskomst. Nuværende mødetid er som udgangspunkt kl. 07.30 alle ugens dage, og timetallet er 37 timer om ugen. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt eller forhåbentligt den. 1. januar 2027.

Ansættelsesprocessen:

Ansøgningsfristen er torsdag den 12. november.Første ansættelsessamtale afholdes mandag den 16. november 2026.Anden ansættelsessamtale afholdes onsdag den 18. november 2026.

Kandidater, der bliver indkaldt til anden samtale, vil blive bedt om at udfylde en personlighedsprofil.

På grund af høj mødeaktivitet i slutningen af november i direktørens kalender er ansættelsesprocessen kort. Vi håber ikke, at den korte frist vil afholde dig fra at søge stillingen. 

Der vil efter aftale blive indhentet referencer på den kandidat, vi ønsker at tilbyde jobbet. 

Spørgsmål vedrørende stillingen rettes til direktør for Voksenområdet Louise Berg på 21837636. Send gerne en SMS forud, så bliver du ringet op.

jobs.title: Qualified Cosmetician
jobs.description:
Full-Time Position | Copenhagen, Denmark

Employer: BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier

Workplace: Store Kongensgade 96, Copenhagen, Denmark

Employment type: Full-time, permanent

Working hours: 37 hours per week

Gross monthly salary: DKK 37,200

Start date: By agreement

Application deadline: 1st of January

About Us

BBA Copenhagen – The Beauty Atelier is a professional beauty salon located in Copenhagen, Denmark. We offer a wide range of beauty, skincare and personal care treatments, focusing on quality, professionalism and excellent customer service.

We are seeking a qualified and experienced Cosmetician / Beauty Therapist to join our team on a full-time basis.

The ideal candidate is passionate about the beauty industry, has practical experience in professional beauty treatments and is committed to providing high-quality services in a welcoming salon environment.

Key Responsibilities

- Perform professional facial and skincare treatments, including skin analysis and consultations.

- Provide waxing, threading and eyebrow-shaping services.

- Perform eyelash lifting, eyebrow lamination, tinting and other brow and lash treatments.

- Carry out manicures and pedicures according to professional qualifications.

- Assess clients' skincare needs and recommend suitable treatments and products.

- Provide professional consultations and appropriate aftercare advice.

- Maintain high standards of hygiene, sanitation and client safety.

- Prepare and maintain treatment rooms, equipment and beauty products.

- Manage client appointments, bookings and treatment records.

- Assist with inventory management and daily salon operations.

- Deliver excellent customer service and maintain positive client relationships.

- Work independently and collaborate effectively with other team members.

Qualifications and Experience

We are looking for candidates who have:

- A relevant diploma, certificate or professional qualification in cosmetology, beauty therapy or a related field.

- Practical experience working as a cosmetician, beautician or beauty therapist in a professional salon environment.

- Knowledge and practical skills in facial treatments, waxing, threading, eyebrow and eyelash treatments.

- Understanding of skincare products, treatment procedures and professional hygiene standards.

- Good communication and customer service skills.

- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.

- A professional, reliable and client-focused approach.

What We Offer

- A permanent, full-time position of 37 hours per week.

- A gross monthly salary of DKK 37,200.

- A professional, friendly and supportive working environment.

- Opportunities for professional development and further training.

- A varied role involving skincare, beauty treatments and client consultations.

- Employment conditions in accordance with applicable Danish employment standards.

- Other bonuses.

Employment Conditions

The successful candidate will receive a written employment contract specifying salary, working hours, holiday entitlement, notice period and other applicable employment conditions.

The position is based at our salon in Copenhagen and requires physical attendance at the workplace.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit:

- An updated CV.

- Copies of relevant professional qualifications or certificates.

- A short application describing their professional experience and suitability for the position.

Application email: info@bba-cph.com

Applications will be assessed based on relevant qualifications, professional experience and suitability for the position.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager – BMW og MINI reservedele og tilbehør
jobs.description:
Schmiedmann Odense A/S søger en resultatorienteret Key Account Manager

Om jobbet

Vil du være med til at udvikle og styrke samarbejdet med vores vigtigste kunder på det internationale marked for BMW- og MINI-reservedele og tilbehør?

Hos Schmiedmann Odense A/S søger vi en engageret Key Account Manager, der kan skabe langsigtede kunderelationer, identificere nye forretningsmuligheder og sikre fortsat vækst gennem professionel kunderådgivning og aktivt salgsarbejde.

Schmiedmann er en specialiseret virksomhed inden for BMW- og MINI-reservedele, tilbehør og relaterede produkter med kunder i Danmark og resten af verden.

Se en video om jobbet her: Work at Schmiedmann | We’re Hiring in Odense!

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Opbygge, udvikle og vedligeholde relationer til eksisterende nøglekunder og franchises.

  • Identificere og opsøge nye forretningsmuligheder.

  • Udarbejde tilbud og følge op på salgsaktiviteter, kundeforespørgsler og ordrer.

  • Forhandle priser, betingelser og samarbejdsaftaler.

  • Analysere kundernes købsmønstre og identificere potentiale for mersalg.

  • Sikre høj kundetilfredshed og en professionel kundeoplevelse.

  • Samarbejde med salg, produkt- og lagerafdeling om at finde de rette løsninger til kunderne.

  • Bidrage til udviklingen af vores internationale forretning og kundeportefølje.

Din profil

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring med B2B-salg, key account management eller anden relevant salgsfunktion.

  • Er kommercielt orienteret og motiveres af at skabe målbare resultater.

  • Er dygtig til at opbygge relationer og skabe tillid hos kunderne.

  • Arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt og følger dine opgaver helt til dørs.

  • Har gode forhandlingsevner og kan identificere kundernes behov.

  • Har gode IT-kompetencer og erfaring med CRM- og ERP-systemer eller lignende.

  • Behersker dansk og engelsk på et professionelt niveau.

Kendskab til bilbranchen, BMW og MINI samt reservedele og tilbehør vil være en fordel, men er ikke et krav, hvis du har den rette kommercielle profil og lyst til at lære vores produkter at kende.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende stilling i en specialiseret virksomhed med internationale kunder.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores kundeportefølje og salgsresultater.

  • En hverdag med stor kontaktflade på tværs af virksomhedens afdelinger.

  • Et uformelt arbejdsmiljø med engagerede kolleger.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer samt pension og øvrige vilkår efter aftale.

  • Sommerferie i uge 28-29-30, Juleferie, samt lukket 1. Maj, Kristi himmelfarts dag med fredag, grundlovsdag.

  • Fri frokost 2 gange ugentligt + frugtordning.

  • Virksomhedsbetalt arbejdstøj (dresscode).

Arbejdssted

Schmiedmann Odense A/SHerluf Trolles Vej 155220 Odense SØ

Ansøgning

Er du vores nye Key Account Manager?

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til job.odense@schmiedmann.com. og mærk den KAM

Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS
jobs.description:
Vi søger en sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent (SSA) til Enfamilie ApS

Brænder du for høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet, medicinsikkerhed og arbejdet med mennesker, der har brug for særlig støtte og omsorg?

Hos Enfamilie ApS søger vi en engageret og fagligt stærk sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores team.

Stillingen indebærer skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller gerne før.

Om stillingen

Vi søger en medarbejder, der kan være med til at sikre en høj sundhedsfaglig standard i vores daglige arbejde.

Du får en central rolle i arbejdet med medicinhåndtering, sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og implementering samt efterlevelse af sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at vores sundhedsfaglige arbejde udføres systematisk, ansvarligt og i overensstemmelse med gældende lovgivning og retningslinjer fra Styrelsen for Patientsikkerhed.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

  • Sikker og korrekt medicinhåndtering, herunder dispensering, administration, opbevaring og dokumentation.

  • Sikre efterlevelse af gældende sundhedsfaglige instrukser og procedurer.

  • Medvirke til udarbejdelse, implementering og løbende opdatering af lokale sundhedsfaglige instrukser.

  • Arbejde med sundhedsfaglig dokumentation og journalføring i henhold til gældende regler.

  • Bidrage til forebyggelse af medicineringsfejl og håndtering af utilsigtede hændelser.

  • Understøtte kolleger i korrekt udførelse af delegerede sundhedsfaglige opgaver.

  • Samarbejde med læger, øvrige sundhedsfaglige samarbejdspartnere og kolleger.

  • Deltage aktivt i den daglige omsorg, støtte og pleje.

Vi forventer, at du

  • Er uddannet sygeplejerske eller social- og sundhedsassistent med dansk autorisation.

  • Har et solidt kendskab til medicinhåndtering og sundhedsfaglig dokumentation.

  • Har forståelse for gældende sundhedsfaglige krav, instrukser og patientsikkerhed.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og ansvarsbevidst.

  • Kan bevare overblikket og træffe fagligt velbegrundede beslutninger.

  • Har gode samarbejdsevner og bidrager positivt til et tværfagligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Er fleksibel og indstillet på skiftende vagter samt arbejde hver anden weekend.

Vi tilbyder

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor faglighed, omsorg og kvalitet går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for at få indflydelse på udviklingen af vores sundhedsfaglige praksis.

  • Et tæt samarbejde med engagerede kolleger.

  • En hverdag med både ansvar, variation og meningsfulde opgaver.

  • Mulighed for faglig sparring og udvikling.

Ansættelsesvilkår:

Arbejdstid: Skiftende vagter med arbejde hver anden weekend.

Tiltrædelse: 1. januar 2027 eller efter aftale, gerne tidligere.

Arbejdssted: Enfamilie ApS.

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår: Efter aftale og kvalifikationer.

Vil du være en del af Enfamilie ApS?

Vi søger en kollega, der har hjertet på rette sted, og som samtidig brænder for at sikre høj sundhedsfaglig kvalitet og patientsikkerhed.

Send din ansøgning og dit CV til: info@enfamilie.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen? Kontakt Majbritt Jensen direktør, telefonnummer 22 85 98 33

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: PhD Candidate in Machine Learning Approaches to Conservation Condition Needs of Historic Buildings
jobs.description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

For a position as a PhD Candidate, the goal is a completed doctoral education up to an obtained doctoral degree.

We are looking for a PhD candidate for one of 13 PhD positions in Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) CHARM (Conservation of Heritage Architecture, buildings and sites by Resilient Methods: hydro-climate factors) project. The main objective of CHARM MSCA Doctoral Network project is to develop new sustainable conservation and restoration solutions, adapted to the current and future climate conditions, designed in a circular economy philosophy, having a low environmental footprint and high handprint. CHARM also responds to socio-economical requirements of wellbeing and proposes conservation/restoration solutions economically acceptable and respecting the cultural value of buildings.

CHARM proposes a holistic approach including:

  • Site observation and data collection
  • Data preparation to be used by AI, models, etc
  • Methods for understanding and modelling past and future degradation of architectural heritage
  • Sustainable conservation solutions to several observed problems
  • Assessment of the impact of architectural conservation on the environment and of the environment (past, present and future) on architectural heritage
  • Bidirectional interactions with society proposing risk management plans but also taking into account the society wills and needs

The vision of CHARM MSCA project is to educate young and talented scientists towards a combined high-level experimental and data driven approach for the early-stage accurate, precise detection of hydro-climate impact on cultural heritage, to answer to recruitment needs in time of climate change and natural hazards impact about research and innovation in the sector of cultural heritage conservation and restoration. 

CHARM network gathers excellent academic centers that have decennial experience in the field of risk assessment, adaptation and mitigation solutions to the climate change impact, conservation of cultural heritage and restoration, documented by scientific papers published in high impact-factor journals, and by previous EU funded research projects. CHARM puts together researchers from universities and research organisms, national and local organizations in charge of Cultural Heritage conservation, Small and Midsize Enterprises, industrial producer of building materials, and Non-Governmental Organization, from 9 European and 1 South American countries.

Description of DC2 PhD position

Project title: Understanding conservation condition and rehabilitation needs at district scale in time of energy saving and climate change via machine learning driven method

Topic in brief:

The aim is to implement an approach based on artificial intelligence (AI) in the form of CNN to automatically detect cracks and morphological indices in order to manage the large amount of data obtained from photogrammetry and earth observations images.

Objectives:

This doctoral project aims to develop deep learning neural networks to investigate data in available database (e.g., EU building stock observatory and other similar database) to:

  1. classify building stock at district scale more prone to decay based on buildings construction year, location, main constitutive material, exposure, use and
  2. to predict potential maintenance and restoration priority based on (i) and existing energy retrofit directive and/or risk maps 

Expected results:

(i)to build high-quality dataset highlighting the façade that is more prone to decay at district/city level from existing raw database; 

(ii) to apply deep learning neural networks (e.g., convolutional neural network) to perform semi-automatic decay pattern segmentation and associated mapping; 

(iii) to correlate the maintenance of buildings at district/city level with decay patterns/features at district scale to prioritize large scale intervention; and 

(iv) to optimize the maintenance activities by leveraging these correlations learned by machine-learning based approaches. 

Supervisory Committee:

  • Main supervisor: Full prof. Chiara Bertolin, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Co-supervisor: Associate prof. Chao Gao, Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering (MTP) (Academic)
  • Mentor: Dr. Marie Louise Anker, Department Director at Nidaros Cathedral Restoration Works. (Non.Academic)

 

Planned secondments

SECONDMENT 1 - Prof. P. Fafalios (FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas, Crete) M12, duration: 4 weeks, AI and ML algorithms,

SECONDMENT 2 - Prof. Carradò (CY Cergy Paris University) Karima El Ganaoui, ESTI Pau CY Tech, M24, duration: 4 weeks, AI materials

Duties of the position
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education programme
  • Develop a quantitative deep-learning-based framework to detect the micro-cracks and validate the developed framework
  • Define micro-scale indices to evaluate crack morphological characteristics and validate developed the indices
  • Classify the micro-morphologies and damages of undamage and damage materials and/or hazard prone or not buildings and landscape
  • Participate in other relevant research and dissemination activities through our international collaborators
  • Conduct and publish high-level research at peer-reviewed journals and international conferences
  • Carry on condition monitoring campaigns and surveys in situ
  • Write and defend a PhD thesis

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Statistics, Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Engineering or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you maybe considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme
  • Excellent written and oral English
  • Strong background in applying deep learning neural networks on image segmentation associated with materials and the built environment
  • Excellent programming skills in Python and Matlab

PLEASE NOTE: For detailed information about what the application must contain, see paragraph “About the application”.

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience in processing-imaging techniques (e.g. 3D Data Processing, point clouds, geospatial Analysis)
  • Knowledge and technical skills of condition monitoring, analytical damage functions and/or analytical methods/models
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Strong interest and self-motivated attitude to explore scientific questions
  • Think and work independently
  • Team player with cooperative attitude
  • Good communication skills

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • Opportunity to carry our cutting-edge research in the area of applying machine learning technique to detection, classification and prediction of material degradation and get multidisciplinary and multisectoral training by experts and experienced supervisors from academic world
  • Opportunity to publish your research findings in working team and participate the national and international conferences
  • Opportunity to stay at our academic partners at FORTH Foundation for Research and Technology – Hellas in Crete (Greece), and Cergy Paris University in Paris, France.
  • Opportunity to work in an international team and be part of a network of 13 PhD students
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality.

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding from Marie Sklodowska-Curie Action (MSCA) for CHARM project.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Motivation letter justifying your interest and fit for the position
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Chiara Bertolin, e-mail: chiara.bertolin@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR Senior Consultant Hedda Winnberg, e-mail: hedda.winnberg@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 26.11.2026

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. jobs.title: Experienced High Voltage Specialist wanted for Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst
jobs.description: Do you have at least three years of high voltage experience? At Bravida, you will install circuit breakers, disconnectors and switchboards and help build substations. Here, you will put your experience to use on critical electrical infrastructure projects that help secure Denmark's power supply and support the green transition.On behalf of Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst, Career | a JKS Company is recruiting experienced High Voltage Specialists for projects across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.Bravida El-Infrastruktur Øst has secured the framework agreement with Energinet, becoming a regular supplier of high voltage installation work across Zealand and Lolland-Falster. With this agreement and a strong order book, Bravida is expanding the department. You will join the team responsible for building, expanding, refurbishing and maintaining the infrastructure that the power grid of the future relies on.Installation and construction of high voltage installationsYou will work at substations and other high voltage installations, putting your experience into practice. You will take responsibility for your own tasks and work alongside your team to deliver safe, high-quality work.Your responsibilities will include:-Installing and replacing circuit breakers, disconnectors and other substation components-Carrying out cable work and working on earthing systems-Working on switchboards, electrical installations and dismantling tasks-Contributing to the construction, refurbishment and maintenance of high voltage installations-Carrying out quality assurance and maintaining documentationOver time, you will also share your knowledge by helping apprentices and new colleagues get to grips with their tasks.You bring solid high voltage experience and take responsibilityYou are a qualified electrician or have an equivalent electrical qualification, with at least three years of hands-on experience in high voltage work. You are familiar with the tasks described and comfortable working independently. You take initiative, recognise what needs doing and understand that safety is integral to every task.We are looking for someone who:-Works independently and takes a structured approach-Takes responsibility for the safety and quality of their work-Is proactive, well-presented and works well with others-Is physically fit and comfortable with hands-on work outdoors and at height-Holds a category B driving licence and can provide a criminal record certificateYou must be able to communicate clearly in English and have a valid work permit for Denmark.A company vehicle to take home and no on-call dutiesAt Bravida, you will join a team of skilled, dedicated technicians who take pride in their work.You will work daytime hours with no on-call duties, normally five days a week. Start times depend on the project, and the working week can be discussed. The role is paid hourly, with pay based on qualifications, plus pension contributions and a flexible benefits allowance under the Danish "fritvalgsordning" scheme.You will have a company vehicle equipped with the tools and equipment you need, which you can take home. Your exact location is therefore less important, provided you are willing to work at different sites across Zealand and Lolland-Falster.We look forward to hearing from youIf this sounds like the right role for you, please send us your CV. We review applications and invite suitable candidates to interviews on an ongoing basis, and will close the vacancy once the right candidates have been found.If you have any questions about the role that are not covered in this advertisement, please contact Recruitment Specialist Kristine Askjær on +45 3085 1302.Please note that, for GDPR reasons, applications submitted directly by email will not be processed or receive a response.

jobs.title: Norwegian speaking telesales agent
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge and are you fluent in Norwegian and/or Swedish and have a profound understanding for the Norwegian market?- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Norwegian sales department at Nordiccom!Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen and we are still growing. Our Norwegian team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on our sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurance solutions to existing customers in the financial sector. All sales are made over the phone.

We are looking for a characteristic person with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers get a great experience every time. The position is on site from our office in Copenhagen and we only have contact with our customers over the phone.It is not a requirement for you to have experience with insurances prior to applying for this job, but we would prefer it if you have experience with selling over the phone.

Qualities we highly value from you:- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people- A competitive and result-oriented mindset- Fluent in Norwegian (English language skills are also an advantage)- Huge plus if you have experience working with tele sales/telemarketing from a previous job

What you can expect from us:- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction- Helpful and motivated colleagues- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city.- Office located in the heart of Copenhagen

You don't need to have experience with insurances or experience working with the financial sector to apply for this job.It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.

Who are we and what do we do?Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

If this sounds interesting to you, please don't hesitate to send your resumé and an application marked "Norwegian sales agent".

jobs.title: Capacitaire / Référent du projet animalier (H/F)
jobs.description: Le Parc Animalier de Sainte-Croix entre dans une nouvelle étape de son histoire. Après 45 ans d'engagement pour le vivant, le parc a souhaité restructurer en profondeur son pôle animalier afin d'en faire un modèle de transmission, de conservation et de bien-être animal, fruit d'une nouvelle d'organisation. Depuis 2 ans nous restructurons le service avec un nouveau cadre managérial de proximité engagé et compétent, des équipes stables et un projet en construction.   Notre ambition est claire : Reconnecter toutes les générations au vivant, dans le respect des animaux et des écosystèmes, pour transformer le regard de nos visiteurs sur la nature. Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons un capacitaire capable d'accompagner cette transformation, non pas uniquement comme garant réglementaire, mais comme référent structurant d'un projet animalier ambitieux. Le projet :Le pôle animalier de Sainte-Croix a engagé un travail de restructuration autour de plusieurs priorités : - Clarifier les rôles et responsabilités de chacun - Renforcer l'autonomie des responsables de secteur et des équipes - Structurer les procédures, les circuits de décision et les validations - Faire monter les équipes en compétence - Développer une culture forte du bien-être animal - Mieux intégrer les projets d'élevage, de conservation et de réintroduction ; - Accompagner l'évolution des infrastructures et des enclos ; - Donner davantage de sens, de cadre et de fluidité au quotidien animalier. Ce travail s'inscrit dans la continuité de l'accompagnement mené avec Brice Lefaux, qui a permis de poser un diagnostic, d'identifier les axes de progrès et d'engager une nouvelle dynamique collective.  La mission :- être le garant du cadre réglementaire, sécuritaire et animalier du parc. - veiller à ce que les décisions prises soient conformes aux obligations liées à la détention et à la présentation au public d'animaux sauvages, tout en permettant à l'organisation de gagner en maturité et en autonomie.    Sous la responsabilité directe de la Direction du parc, vous rejoindrez le pôle animalier, une équipe pluridisciplinaire d'une trentaine de collaborateurs composée de vétérinaires, d'un chef de service, de managers de proximité et de soigneurs animaliers. Le poste ne comporte pas de missions de gestion administrative ni d'encadrement d'équipe.  Votre rôle est de poser le cadre, sécuriser les décisions importantes, transmettre votre expertise dans des réflexions collectives et accompagner la montée en compétence et responsabilité des équipes. Et notamment : - Faire partie du comité de direction avec votre expertise et un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Participer à la conception du Master Plan. Nous recherchons une personne capable de conjuguer exigence réglementaire, expertise zoologique et intelligence collective. Vous devrez accompagner Sainte-Croix dans la nouvelle étape du pôle animalier : être une équipe exemplaire, structurée, responsable et pleinement alignée avec la raison d'être du parc. Vous devrez également :- être titulaire du Certificat de capacité adapté aux espèces concernées. - justifier d'une solide expérience en parc zoologique. - posséder un bon niveau d'autonomie. - Très bonne connaissance du bien-être animal, de la sécurité et des obligations réglementaires. - Capacité à travailler de manière transverse avec une direction, une responsable zoologique, des responsables de secteur et des équipes terrain. - Goût pour la transmission, la structuration et l'accompagnement du changement. - Capacité à déléguer et à faire grandir les équipes. - Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de conservation, d'éducation et de reconnexion au vivant. Vous ne serez pas seulement le garant d'un cadre, vous serez l'un des artisans d'une nouvelle organisation au service des animaux, des équipes et de la mission du parc.

jobs.title: Communications Student Assistant – Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team
jobs.description:
About ICARS The International Centre for Antimicrobial Resistance Solutions (ICARS) is an independent international organisation established by the Danish Government to support low- and middle-income countries in developing evidence-based and context-appropriate solutions to antimicrobial resistance (AMR). Working across the One Health spectrum, ICARS collaborates with governments, research institutions and global organisations to bridge research, policy and implementation. About the role We are looking for a Student Assistant to join our Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team. This is a great opportunity for a student interested in digital communications, creative media, data management and global health and development. You’ll support our day-to-day activities and help communicate ICARS’ work on AMR in LMICs. We’re looking for someone with strong technical skills who also takes initiative to bring fresh ideas to the team. Alongside delivering assigned tasks, you will be encouraged to suggest improvements and take ownership of agreed activities, with support and feedback from colleagues. Key responsibilities Website management:
  • Maintain and update content on ICARS’ WordPress website, keeping it accurate, accessible and user-friendly.
  • Track website performance using analytics tools and suggest improvements based on the findings.
  • Proactively identify outdated content, gaps and opportunities to better showcase our work.
Graphic design & visual content:
  • Create engaging infographics, social media graphics and report layouts that align with ICARS’ brand.
  • Help develop templates and designs for reports and presentations, bringing fresh ideas for communicating complex information clearly.
  • Video editing & multimedia:
  • Edit videos for ICARS’ social media, presentations and events.
  • Support video production and identify opportunities to turn existing footage into useful, engaging content.
Social media support :
  • Support ICARS’ LinkedIn presence through content creation and community engagement.
  • Keep an eye on relevant conversations, project updates and sector developments, suggesting timely stories and opportunities for ICARS to contribute.
Internal communications support:
  • Maintain our internal SharePoint, including keeping our media library organised and up to date.
  • Support colleagues with designing clear, engaging PowerPoint slides and formatting Word documents.
Press Office and external communications support:
  • Assist with event promotion and Mailchimp newsletter creation.
  • Monitor our communications mailbox, respond to routine enquiries and coordinate with colleagues on requests from stakeholders, including regional and national press.
  • Flag relevant media and communications opportunities for the team to consider.
Data and stakeholder information management:
  • Support the team in entering and maintaining accurate, up-to-date data and contact information in ATLAS, our CRM system.
  • Other tasks related to deliverables of the Partnerships, Advocacy and Communications Team.
Desired profile We are seeking an organised and curious student who enjoys both developing ideas and getting things done in a pro-active and structured manner. You take the initiative to find information, ask useful questions and suggest practical next steps. You can work independently, recognise when to seek guidance and lead tasks through to completion, while keeping colleagues informed. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly, and you bring strong digital fluency, technical skills and the ability to pick up new tools with ease. Required qualifications:
  • Currently studying for a Master’s degree in IT, Media Studies, Marketing, Graphic Design or a related field.
  • Proficiency in WordPress and basic website management.
  • Experience using MS Office, particularly Excel, Word and PowerPoint.
  • Experience with graphic design tools, such as Canva or Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Basic video editing skills, using Premiere Pro, Final Cut or similar software.
  • Strong organisational skills, working in a structured manner and with attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritise and manage multiple tasks.
  • Ability to identify opportunities, propose ideas and take responsibility for delivering agreed tasks.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in perfect and fluent English, including the ability to adapt content for different audiences.
Preferred qualifications:
  • Knowledge of Google Analytics, or a willingness to learn.
  • Experience using CRM platforms (Dynamics 365)
  • Skills and interest in drafting technical and scientific communication material.
What we offer
  • Hands-on experience: Contribute to drafting communications material, external stakeholder management and partnerships, developing your skills through practical work and feedback.
  • Impact: Help communicate solutions to one of the world’s most critical global health and development challenges, with space to contribute your own ideas and see them put into practice.
  • Flexible working hours: Our working hours between 8 am and 5 pm with accommodation of your academic schedule.
  • International environment: Work alongside experts and colleagues from diverse backgrounds in a global organisation.
If you enjoy turning ideas into action and want to use your communications skills to support global health, we would love to hear from you! Terms of employment The position as student assistant will be covered by the terms of the collective agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation of Public Employees (OAO-S-Fællesoverenskomsten) and the organizational agreement between The Danish Finance Ministry and the Organisation for Salaried Employees HK/Stat (Organisationsaftale for kontorfunktionærer, laboranter og it-medarbejdere (HK)), according to chapter 6 in the agreement concerning hourly paid employees. The successful candidate is enrolled at graduate level in a Danish University with at around two years of studies remaining. They will predominantly work from the ICARS HQ office, based at the Statens Serum Institut in Copenhagen, Denmark. Application and recruitment process Press “apply for the position” and submit your CV along with a cover letter outlining your suitability for the role and motivation for applying. We would like to receive your application by 20 November 2026 and expect to conduct interviews 24-27 November 2026. For questions about the role, please contact Communications Officer Chloe Modvig-Cole (checo@icars-global.org) and for other questions about the position you may contact Head of Partnerships and Global Relations Theresa Hogenhaug (tcah@icars-global.org). We are committed to cultivating a fair and healthy environment, where everyone can be themselves and thrive. We are happy to discuss flexible working options for all roles. We work to ensure that our recruitment processes are as inclusive as possible to everyone. This includes adjusting for people who have a disability or long-term condition. We look forward to hearing from you!
