jobs.title: Demonstratør: Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag
jobs.description:
Demonstratører / Demonstratricer søges til hele landet

Et fleksibelt job, der passer ind i din hverdag

Søger du et meningsfuldt og socialt job, der passer ind i netop din hverdag?

Hos IN-STORE søger vi kollegaer til en spændende stilling som demonstratør. Som demonstratør bliver du vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. Du uddeler smagsprøver, fortæller om produkterne og giver kunderne lyst til at prøve noget nyt. Her kommer din livserfaring og evne til at tale med mennesker dig til gode.

Uanset om du er pensionist, der ønsker at supplere din indkomst, selvstændig, der søger et fleksibelt bijob, eller noget helt tredje, kan dette være det perfekte match for dig. Du bliver vores ansigt udadtil og er med til at skabe gode oplevelser for både kunder og butikker. 

Dine opgaver indebærer:

  • Let tilberedning og uddeling af smagsprøver. 

  • Engagerende samtaler og salg af produkterne.

  • Opsætning af en pæn og indbydende stand.

  • Skabe en god relation til de butikker, du besøger.

Vi tilbyder et job, der passer til dig

Vi ved at fleksibilitet og frihed er vigtigt - derfor tilbyder vi: 

  • Frihed til at planlægge: Du bestemmer selv, hvor mange vagter du ønsker om måneden. Vores vagter er 6-8 timer ad gangen og spredt over hele ugen - fredage og lørdage er dog altid vores mest aktive dage. 

  • Social og aktiv arbejdsdag: Du bliver en del af et team af kollegaer, der ligesom dig selv, sætter pris på at holde sig aktiv og social.

  • Udstyr derhjemme: Du opbevarer dit udstyr hjemme og tager det med, når du skal på arbejde.

  • Kørsel i egen bil: Du får skattefri kørselsgodtgørelse efter gældende regler.

 

Hvem er du?

Vi forestiller os, at du er imødekommende, ansvarsfuld og glad for at tale med mennesker. Din livserfaring er en stor fordel, da du er god til at tale med alle slags mennesker og skabe tillid. Erfaring som demonstratør er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at præsentere produkter og give kunderne en god oplevelse.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at:

  • Du er god til at kommunikere og er god til at formidle et budskab.

  • Du er ansvarsfuld og mødestabil.

  • Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Du er fortrolig med IT (smartphone, e-mail) og har bil til rådighed. 

 

Sådan søger du jobbet:

Send os din ansøgning med CV og et vellignende billede af dig selv via vores hjemmeside www.in-store.dk.

Du er velkommen til at kontakte vores HR Koordinator, Emilie Braagaard, på tlf. 52 18 64 09 eller mail embra@in-store.dk, hvis du har spørgsmål til jobbet.

 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Credit Union Member Service Officer (MSO)
jobs.description: The Member Service Officer (MSO) is a key front-line role responsible for delivering a friendly, efficient, and professional service to members. This includes handling financial transactions, supporting lending operations, advising on credit union products, and ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, including those set by the Central Bank of Ireland. Key Responsibilities● Serve as the first point of contact for members across all channels (in-branch, phone, email).● Process daily transactions such as lodgements, withdrawals, loan payments, and direct debits accurately.● Provide members with accurate information about products and services, including savings and loans.● Support members through the loan application process, including documentation gathering and system entry.● Promote credit union products and services to members in line with their financial needs and goals.● Ensure all activity complies with AML, CFT, and GDPR regulations, as well as Central Bank of Ireland guidelines.● Maintain accurate member records and update account information securely and confidentially.● Assist with balancing cash, preparing reports, and performing reconciliations.● Work closely with other departments to resolve member queries and deliver excellent member service.● Participate in training, upskilling, and CPD requirements related to your qualifications. Essential Skills & Qualifications● Minimum of Leaving Certificate or equivalent.● Holds a relevant qualification such as QFA (Qualified Financial Adviser) or APA (Accredited Product Adviser) as per Central Bank of Ireland Minimum Competency Code (MCC) requirements.○ Note: Candidates working towards APA/QFA may be considered depending on experience.● Previous experience in customer service, preferably in financial services, banking, or credit unions.● Strong IT skills, including competence in Microsoft Office and member/accounting systems.● Excellent communication, organisational, and interpersonal skills.● High level of accuracy and attention to detail.● Ability to work on own initiative and as part of a team. Desirable● Experience with loan processing, AML procedures, or GDPR compliance.● Knowledge of the credit union movement and its values.● Understanding of the regulatory environment in Irish financial services. Key Competencies● Member-first mindset● Accuracy and attention to detail● Teamwork and collaboration● Communication and interpersonal skills● Problem-solving ability● Compliance awareness● Initiative and accountability Other Requirements● Flexibility to work additional hours when required.● Commitment to ongoing CPD in line with MCC requirements (if APA/QFA is held).● Willingness to complete further relevant training (e.g., CUCP courses). Apply now: aidan@prorecruitmentireland.ie

jobs.description:
Montør til fordelingstavler i Helsingør

Hos Dansk Tavle Teknik A/S oplever vi stor aktivitet, og derfor søger vi en montør med erfaring inden for opbygning og montage af fordelingstavler i Helsingør.

Har du en stærk mekanisk og el-teknisk forståelse, og motiveres du af at levere kvalitetsløsninger? Trives du i et fagligt stærkt miljø, hvor godt håndværk, samarbejde og høj kvalitet er i fokus? Så er du måske vores nye tavlemontør.

Hvem er du?

Du er faglært mekaniker, smed, elektriker, automatiktekniker eller har en anden relevant mekanisk eller el-teknisk baggrund.

Derudover ser vi gerne, at du:

  • Har erfaring med opbygning og montage af fordelingstavler

  • Kan læse og forstå el-diagrammer og teknisk dokumentation

  • Arbejder struktureret og kvalitetsbevidst

  • Trives med både selvstændige opgaver og teamwork

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, mødestabil og har fokus på at levere et godt resultat

  • Bidrager positivt til fællesskabet og den gode stemning på arbejdspladsen

Du får hos os

  • En alsidig hverdag med spændende faglige udfordringer

  • Mulighed for både faglig og personlig udvikling

  • En arbejdsplads i en dansk, ejerledet virksomhed med korte beslutningsveje

  • Dygtige kolleger og et stærkt fællesskab præget af hjælpsomhed og humor

  • Attraktive ansættelsesvilkår med løn efter kvalifikationer, pension og sundhedsforsikring

Hvorfor vælge Dansk Tavl Teknik?

Hos Dansk Tavle Teknik bliver du en del af et hold, der er stolte af deres faglighed og løsningerne vi leverer. Her får du mulighed for at bringe din faglighed i spil, tage ansvar og være med til at skabe løsninger af høj kvalitet.

Send din ansøgning og CV til Sonni Tønder på st@eltavler.dk

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Painotamme myös erityisesti ruotsin kielen taidon osaamista.Työsuhteeseen valituilta pyydetään satunnaisesti Länsi-Uudenmaan hyvinvointialueen päihdeohjelman mukaista huumausainetodistusta.Arvostamme hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja, kokemusta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon toimintaympäristöstä, hyvinvointialueiden palveluista, hallintomenettelyn perusteiden tuntemusta sekä sujuvia teknisiä valmiuksia uusien tietojärjestelmien ja työtapojen omaksumiseen.Olemme muutoksen tekijöitä. Uudistamme rohkeasti sen, mikä kaipaa parannusta, ja säilytämme sen, mikä toimii. Panostamme jokaisen työntekijämme hyvinvointiin ja haluamme tarjota monipuolisia etuja henkilöstöllemme. Tarjoamme lounasedun ja saat käyttöösi vuodessa 300 €, jonka voit käyttää toiveidesi mukaan kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi-, liikunta- tai matkalippuetuuksiin. Lisäksi pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi Eduhousen ja Oppiportin laajojen verkkokoulutusten avulla.

jobs.title: Swedish speaking telesales agent (insurance sales)
jobs.description:
Do you like to challenge yourself and are you comfortable with some healthy competition?- Then you could be the one we are looking for to join our Sales Representative department at Nordiccom!Nordiccom is a Danish company located in Copenhagen. With offices in both Copenhagen, Malmö and Helsinki, our Swedish team is working hard and would love some new energetic colleagues joining them on their sales team, who’s responsible for selling insurances over the phone. We partner with banks and insurance companies, and we only sell to existing customers of our partners, so there is no cold calling.

We are looking for characteristic people with a flair for working with people over the phone and making sure the customers have a great experience every time.It doesn’t matter if you have knowledge of insurances prior to applying for this job. We will make sure to teach you everything you need to know, to be able to communicate the products.Qualities we highly value from you:

- An energetic personality with a “can do”-attitude, who knows how to smile through the phone

- Confidence and the ability to work as part of a team

- Good communication skills and the ability to connect with all kinds of different people

- A competitive and result-oriented mindset

- Fluent in Swedish (English language skills are also an advantage)

- Experience with telemarketing

It is important to us that our employees deliver the highest quality of service, which is why we provide thorough training, ensuring that you are ready to meet any challenges and deliver good results while feeling comfortable in your new role.

 

What you can expect from us:

- Guaranteed wage combined with attractive bonus & commission agreements and prizes

- A social working place in a comfortable & productive environment

- A multinational working environment with an informal tone and high job satisfaction

- Helpful and motivated colleagues

- Advantageous working hours and traffic connections near Copenhagen city

Who are we and what do we do?

Nordiccom ApS is a growing Nordic company located in the heart of Copenhagen and Helsinki. The companies we represent are major banking and insurance companies in Europe. With the entire Northern Europe market as our workplace, and the phone as our tool, we provide solutions for sales and customer service for a wide range of companies in the financial business. Therefore, we comply with the banks’ standards and code of conduct, so quality is ensured. In Nordiccom you will meet both Danes, Norwegians, Finns and Swedes. Nordiccom consists of about 150 employees divided into different teams. In Nordiccom, we emphasize professionalism, and it is important that we thrive when we are at work. Our goal is that we shape our employees for success. That they become skilled at their work and achieve good results. All training is practiced in your own language.

jobs.title: Substitute Housekeeper for Serviced-living Apartments
jobs.description:
***Must have the right to work in Denmark!***

Are you detail-oriented? Do you have a service mindset? And do you want to make a difference for our members? Maybe you are the one we are looking for in our team!

LifeX is seeking one or more substitute cleaning assistants/housekeepers for our Operations Team. This person will be responsible for the daily cleaning tasks of our co-living apartments in Copenhagen. This means taking replacement shifts when other housekeepers are sick, on vacation, and also during busy periods for us. There might be a possibility of fixed hours later on if performance is high quality.

LifeX is a service-living property manager offering fully-furnished, cleaned, and maintained apartments with the aim of making internationals feel 'at home anywhere in the world'. We operate in Denmark, Germany & Norway.

LifeX is for people who relocate because of work, as well as anyone who wants a flexible lifestyle with time to have fun with others as part of an international environment. This is why we want to provide the highest standard of our cleaning services.

Tasks:

  • General apartment cleaning in rooms, common areas, kitchens, and bathrooms, which includes: all surfaces, floors, window sills, desks, corners, laundry areas, and sinks.

  • Deep cleaning in different locations, including tasks such as descaling shower heads, cleaning ovens, electrical appliances, and unclogging drains in bathrooms.

  • Receive orders from online retailers and be present during technician visits.

  • Check out cleanings making sure that the room is spotless for the next person moving in, and checking for any damages or missing items.

  • General communication with the operations team and members.

We offer you:

  • Working hours on weekdays between 8-16.

  • A good working environment in an international team and vibe.

  • A varied job.

  • Salary by qualification.

Application and contact

Applications are received on an ongoing basis and the starting date is as soon as possible. Due to many applications, only applicants who fit the criterias will be called in for an interview. Feel free to contact the Housekeeping Supervisor, Justyna on justyna@joinlifex.com, for more information on the position.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.title: Dygtig freelance mødebooker
jobs.description:
Freelance mødebooker søges til B2B-mødebooking

Har du solid erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas – og motiveres du af frihed, ansvar og resultater?

Hjælp til salg søger en dygtig og stabil freelance mødebooker til booking af kvalificerede B2B-møder for vores kunder.

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede ved, hvad der skal til for at komme igennem til den rette beslutningstager, skabe en god dialog og booke et relevant møde.

Arbejdet udføres hjemmefra, og du kan derfor befinde dig hvor som helst i Danmark eller resten af verden.

Om arbejdet

Du kommer til at arbejde med udgående telefonisk mødebooking for forskellige danske B2B-virksomheder.

Opgaverne vil typisk bestå af:

  • Telefonisk kontakt til potentielle erhvervskunder

  • Kold kanvas og dialog med relevante beslutningstagere

  • Præsentation af kundens løsning på en professionel og troværdig måde

  • Booking af kvalificerede møder

  • Løbende opfølgning og registrering af aktiviteter

  • Tæt dialog med Hjælp til salg omkring kvalitet, resultater og kundernes ønsker

Vi leder efter dig, der

  • Har dokumenteret erfaring med B2B-mødebooking, telefonsalg eller kold kanvas

  • Har eget CVR-nummer og arbejder som selvstændig freelancer

  • Er stabil, selvkørende og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde struktureret og følge op på dine leads

  • Er god til at skabe tillid og føre en naturlig samtale

  • Taler og forstår dansk

  • Har en professionel telefonstemme og en god forretningsforståelse

  • Kan håndtere afvisninger uden at miste motivationen

  • Har de nødvendige rammer til at arbejde hjemmefra, herunder en stabil internetforbindelse og rolige omgivelser

Erfaring er et krav

Dette er ikke en oplæringsstilling.

Det er et krav, at du allerede har praktisk erfaring med mødebooking, kold kanvas eller opsøgende B2B-telefonsalg. Har du ikke denne erfaring, er stillingen desværre ikke det rette match.

Vi forventer ikke, at du kender alle vores kunder eller brancher på forhånd. Til gengæld forventer vi, at du kender håndværket, kan sætte dig ind i nye løsninger og hurtigt omsætte et manuskript til en troværdig samtale.

Vi tilbyder

  • Fleksibelt freelancearbejde hjemmefra

  • Mulighed for at arbejde fra hele verden

  • Aflønning pr. godkendt og kvalificeret møde

  • Forskellige B2B-kunder og brancher

  • Grundig introduktion til den enkelte kunde og opgave

  • Sparring, feedback og løbende dialog

  • Mulighed for et længerevarende samarbejde for den rette person

  • Frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at strukturere din arbejdsdag

Aflønning

Du aflønnes pr. booket møde, der lever op til den enkelte kundes aftalte kriterier.

Den konkrete pris pr. møde afhænger af opgaven og aftales inden opstart. Som freelancer fakturerer du Hjælp til salg fra dit eget CVR-nummer.

Om Hjælp til salg

Hjælp til salg har siden 2017 hjulpet danske virksomheder med professionel B2B-mødebooking.

Vi har fokus på møder med kvalitet. Derfor handler arbejdet ikke blot om at få en aftale i kalenderen, men om at booke relevante møder med de rette beslutningstagere og skabe et godt grundlag for kundens videre salgsdialog.

Vi lægger stor vægt på kvalitet, ærlighed, stabilitet og et professionelt samarbejde.

Sådan søger du

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du beskriver:

  • Din erfaring med mødebooking og kold kanvas

  • Hvilke typer virksomheder eller brancher du tidligere har arbejdet med

  • Hvilke resultater du tidligere har skabt

  • Hvor mange timer du forventer at kunne arbejde om ugen

  • Hvornår du kan starte

  • Bekræftelse på, at du har eget CVR-nummer

Vedlæg gerne dit CV eller et link til din LinkedIn-profil.

Vi kontakter kun ansøgere, der har relevant erfaring og matcher kravene til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Lead Game Programmer
jobs.description: Do you love designing clean game architecture, building multiplayer systems that run smoothly, and helping a team of programmers make the right technical decisions? Great! Let's talk.Triband is the award-winning studio behind the WHAT THE? comedy game series, played by millions worldwide. From our home in central Copenhagen, more than 60 wonderful humans are united by a simple mission: to make everyone laugh.We're building something unannounced, exciting, thoroughly goofy, and built to be played together online. We're now looking for a Lead Game Programmer to help building the underlying systems that make it all work, from the core architecture to the multiplayer tech that connects our players. You'll stay hands-on in the code and the Unity editor while helping the programming team make good technical decisions, stay aligned, and build systems that support creative experimentation. And just to be very clear: this is a technical leadership role, not a people-management position.Here's what that looks like day to dayIn collaboration with game designers, artists, and other programmers, you'll build new features and systems and continuously iterate on improvements. We all work in Unity with C#, with every team member hands-on in the editorYou'll set and communicate the project's technical direction, turning creative goals and production needs into clear technical prioritiesYou'll help the programming team make architectural decisions, align around shared patterns, and navigate trade-offs between long-term code health and short-term needsYou'll review and improve technical solutions, share best practices, and support other programmers without becoming a gatekeeper or bottleneckYou'll proactively identify technical risks, messy systems, and missing foundations, and take responsibility for addressing them at the right timeOverall, you'll make sure the project is technically healthy and maintain the codebase in a way that makes it easy for others to build onThis includes things like...Designing an architecture that allows for easy gameplay implementation and flexibilityImplementing and maintaining online features such as matchmaking, invites and friendsProfiling and improving network performance, bandwidth and latency, and making sure the game holds up on real-world connectionsBreaking down complex technical challenges, helping decide what to prioritise, and ensuring important decisions are understood by the people they affectStaying close to the actual game: writing production code, debugging difficult problems, and improving systems as the project evolvesYou're a great match ifYou have at least ten years of professional game development experience across multiple shipped games and different stages of development, including significant technical ownership or leadership on a projectYou have experience setting technical direction and helping a programming team make and implement architectural decisions, with strong judgment in balancing flexibility, maintainability, performance and the needs of a creative productionYou're highly proficient in C# and have deep knowledge of the Unity engine and editorYou've shipped at least one online multiplayer game, had real ownership of its networking/online systems, and have hands-on experience with a Unity multiplayer framework (e.g., Coherence)You communicate clearly and can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to programmers and non-programmers alikeNice to havesYou have experience shipping iOS and macOS apps, including hands-on integration of Apple platform services such as GameKit and the Game Controller framework using Xcode and SwiftExperience with backend services, dedicated servers or cloud hosting for online gamesInterest in multiplayer game design and social featuresExperience working with automated build pipelines such as JenkinsExperience building systemic or open-world gamesWhat always matters to us at TribandYou thrive in taking ownership of your area: you spot problems, seek advice when needed, and implement creative solutions that push projects forwardYou're motivated by collaboration, mutual respect, inclusiveness and creativity while actively contributing to sustaining that cultureYou believe games are made by teams, not rockstars and that great ideas can come from anyoneYou bring curiosity, generosity, and jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist, Efla – Porvoo
jobs.description: About the roleEfla Oy, part of the Ensto Group, is an international company based in Porvoo and specialized in airfield lighting solutions. The companys business has grown strongly in recent years, and we are now looking for a Customer Service Specialist to support Eflas increasing order volume, international customers and the smooth handling of orders from start to finish.In this role, you will not be working in traditional inbound or outbound customer service. Instead, you will be responsible especially for order handling, order deliveries, export documentation, invoicing and shipping documents. You will work in an important role between customers, sales, production, logistics and the internal customer service team.The role is well suited for someone with a background in business, logistics, international business or a similar field, who has strong English skills, good ability to work under pressure and a desire to develop in an international order delivery environment. Previous experience in order handling, customer service, export, logistics or ERP systems is considered an advantage, but the most important things are the right attitude, willingness to learn and the ability to take initiative.What we offerEfla offers you the opportunity to become part of an international, growing and hands-on company where you get to see the full order delivery chain as a whole.In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop your skills in areas such as:- international customer service- order handling and order management- export documentation and shipping documents- invoicing and the use of ERP systems- cooperation between production, logistics and sales- working with global customers and different culturesThis is a great opportunity for someone who wants to grow into specialist roles in customer service, supply chain, export, sales support or international business.Work tasksAs a Customer Service Specialist, you will be responsible for the smooth processing of customer orders and the progress of deliveries. In practice, your work begins once sales has agreed on the order with the customer. After that, you ensure that the order proceeds correctly in the systems, production, delivery and documentation.The role includes a lot of email communication with international customers, as well as internal communication with sales, production and logistics partners. Since the customers are international and the orders can vary significantly, the role requires a strong ability to understand the bigger picture, use common sense and solve situations case by case.- processing and managing customer orders from start to finish- monitoring and coordinating order deliveries- communicating with international customers, mainly by email- cooperating with the sales team, production, logistics and customer service team- preparing export documentation and shipping documents- handling invoicing-related tasks- using the ERP system and other internal systems- resolving questions related to deliveries, schedules and customer cases- solving different customer cases and order-related issuesWe are looking for you who hasWe are looking for a person who is interested in international customer service, order handling and supply chain coordination. You may be a recent graduate or at the beginning of your career, or you may already have previous experience in similar tasks.We hope you have:- fluent English skills, as customer communication is mainly in English- readiness to work mainly from the office in Porvoo- previous work experience in customer service, order handling, sales support, logistics, export, invoicing or supply chain-related tasks- ability to understand broader processes and move things forward in a structured way- a proactive and flexible working style- good problem-solving skills and practical thinking- ability to work in a busy and changing environment- good cooperation and communication skillsConsidered an advantage- Finnish language skills, as communication with production and local stakeholders may also take place in Finnish- experience with ERP systems- studies in business, logistics, international business or another relevant fieldTo succeed in this role, you are- proactive and hands-on- accurate and systematic- flexible and able to handle pressure- cooperative and open- curious and willing to learn- ready to ask questions, investigate and get things done- interested in an international working environmentYou do not need to know everything in advance. What matters more is that you want to learn, are willing to take initiative and can work in situations where all answers cannot be found from ready-made templates.Practical informationLocation: PorvooWorking hours: Full-timeEmployment type: Permanent employment through Academic WorkStart: As soon as possibleRemote work: Limited possibility for remote work after the onboarding period. The role requires a high level of presence at the Porvoo office, especially due to onboarding and close teamwork.We will proceed with suitable applicants as soon as they apply, so please submit your application as soon as possible.Our recruitment processThis recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
jobs.description: Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that: Every moment is pedagogical Play is the foundation of learning Learning happens throughout the whole day Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround Childrens interests and questions guide learningYour core responsibilities: Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses Observe and document childrens learning and development Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoorsOur daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027: Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained. At least level B2 in English language Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly. Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028: Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible: Assistance with degree recognition process Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members) Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.Language training and relocation schedule: Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential. Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.Salary and benefits: Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting) Comprehensive private occupational health care Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers Holiday bonus pay Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process: Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!Please note:(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. jobs.title: Servicekoordinator til telte.nu – med ansvar for kvalitet og bemanding
jobs.description:
Kan du skabe overblik, fordele opgaver og sikre, at kvaliteten er i orden? Og trives du med en hverdag, hvor du både koordinerer og selv tager fat? Så er du måske vores nye servicekoordinator hos telte.nu.

Vi søger en struktureret og engageret kollega, der kan tage ansvar for den daglige koordinering i vores serviceafdeling. Du bliver central i at sikre, at medarbejdere, materialer og opgaver hænger sammen, så vi leverer et godt resultat til kunden.

Dine opgaver

Du planlægger dagens arbejde, følger op på opgaverne og hjælper med at få det hele til at fungere i praksis. Dine opgaver omfatter blandt andet:

  • Planlægning og bemanding: Du fordeler medarbejdere og opgaver, så de rette folk er på de rette pladser.

  • Kvalitetskontrol: Du kontrollerer pladser og teltopsætninger og følger op på, at arbejdet lever op til vores standarder.

  • Klargøring og materialer: Du sikrer, at rengøring og kontrol bliver udført grundigt, og at de rigtige materialer bliver leveret.

  • Løbende koordinering: Du tilpasser planen, når behovene ændrer sig, og sørger for, at teamet ved, hvad der skal ske.

  • Praktisk arbejde: Du giver en hånd med på tværs af telte.nu, når der er brug for det.

Hvem er du?

Du sætter en ære i, at udstyret er rent og kontrolleret, at bemandingen er på plads, og at opgaverne bliver fulgt til dørs.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Arbejder struktureret og bevarer overblikket, også når der er travlt.

  • Kommunikerer tydeligt og kan sætte retning for dagens opgaver.

  • Har øje for detaljerne og følger op, når noget skal rettes.

  • Tager ansvar og finder løsninger sammen med dine kolleger.

  • Trives med at kombinere koordinering med praktiske opgaver.

Erfaring med koordinering, drift, logistik eller lignende opgaver er relevant. Vi vil også gerne høre, hvordan du har skabt overblik og sikret kvalitet i andre sammenhænge.

En vigtig rolle i hverdagen

Hos telte.nu får du en rolle tæt på både teamet og den daglige drift. Din indsats har direkte betydning for, at kollegerne kan løse deres opgaver, og at kunderne får en god oplevelse.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Send os din ansøgning og dit CV, og fortæl, hvorfor du vil være servicekoordinator hos telte.nu. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagt
jobs.description:
Er du den rolige nattevagt, der skaber nærvær og tryghed? Botilbuddet Vedstedvej søger en vågen nattevagtHyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

Er du den nattevagt, der kan bringe ro, tryghed og nærvær ind i natten? Brænder du for at skabe de bedste betingelser for trivsel, tryghed og udvikling for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer?

Vi søger en vågen nattevagt til fastansættelse i 7-7 vagtrul til Botilbuddet Vedstedvej. Botilbuddet Vedstedvej er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland, og er et mindre socialpsykiatrisk botilbud, hvor der bor i alt 4 borgere.

Om stillingen:

Stillingen indebærer en helt særlig rolle, hvor du er med til at skabe ro, tryghed, stabilitet og nærvær for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer, når mørket falder på. Borgerne kan til tider have et højt stressniveau, hvor de har behov for at blive rummet og støttet af et roligt nervesystem i en pædagogisk og professionel kontekst.

Du vil indgå i et fast team omkring det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne. Alle medarbejdere indgår på lige fod i dagligdagen, og er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats, hvorfor samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund på bachelorniveau.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til tilbudsleder Mehrdad Zamani, tlf. 40 40 39 24 og mail mez@h-l.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail mez@h-l.dk.

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation.

Om stillingen:

Stillingen indebærer en helt særlig rolle, hvor du er med til at skabe ro, tryghed, stabilitet og nærvær for mennesker med socialpsykiatriske udfordringer, når mørket falder på. Borgerne kan til tider have et højt stressniveau, hvor de har behov for at blive rummet og støttet af et roligt nervesystem i en pædagogisk og professionel kontekst.

Du vil indgå i et fast team omkring det pædagogiske arbejde med borgerne. Alle medarbejdere indgår på lige fod i dagligdagen, og er en vigtig del af den faglige indsats, hvorfor samarbejde, sparring og fælles udvikling vægtes højt.

Vi lægger stor vægt på at skabe en god arbejdsplads, hvor alle føler sig velkomne og værdsatte. Vores kultur er præget af medmenneskelighed, samarbejde og engagement. Vi brænder for at arbejde med mennesker og tror på, at vores fælles indsats og samarbejde er nøglen til vores succes.

Hvem er du?

·       Du er uddannet pædagog eller socialrådgiver - eller anden relevant socialfaglig uddannelsesbaggrund.

·       Du er rolig, ansvarsbevidst og har hjertet på rette sted.

·       Du evner at være til stede, også i de stille stunder, og du forstår, at natten kan være et tidspunkt, hvor behovene er anderledes, men lige så vigtige.

·       Du ser mennesket bag diagnosen og ved, hvor stor betydning dét at “være der” kan have.

·       Du har kendskab til metoden LA2.

Vi tilbyder:

·       En spændende arbejdsplads med mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

·       Et dedikeret og tværfagligt team, hvor samarbejde og refleksion er i fokus.

·       Fast supervision og personalemøder samt gode muligheder for løbende kompetenceudvikling.

·       Temadage og kurser i vores faglige metoder og tilgange.

Løn og ansættelsesforhold:

Du ansættes i en fast stilling i et 7-7 vagtrul, hvor du arbejder 7 vagter efterfulgt af 7 fridage. Tiltrædelse snarest muligt, og samtaler afholdes løbende. Stillingen lønnes efter kvalifikationer og kompetencer.

Yderligere oplysninger om stillingen kan indhentes ved henvendelse til tilbudsleder Per Heinecke på 40 40 64 10 eller mail peh@h-l.dk.

Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og CV på mail peh@h-l.dk.

Om Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland er en del af Hyldgaard & Larsen, som samarbejder tæt med kommuner om fleksible sociale løsninger for nogle af landets mest udsatte borgere. Vi er specialiserede i vedholdende pædagogiske indsatser til mennesker med komplekse psykiske, adfærdsmæssige, sociale og sundhedsmæssige udfordringer. Vores tilgang bygger på ro, relationer, faglighed og respekt for det enkelte menneskes behov, ressourcer og livssituation.

jobs.description:
Servicemedarbejder med håndværksmæssig baggrund

Hyldgaard & Larsen Sjælland ApS

 

Har du lyst til en varieret arbejdsdag med mange forskellige typer opgaver? Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og tage ansvar for det, du går i gang med? Og trives du i en hverdag, hvor tingene ikke altid er ens, men hvor kvaliteten altid er i orden? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

 

Vi søger en servicemedarbejder med stærke håndværksmæssige kompetencer og en håndværksmæssig baggrund, som har lyst til at blive en del af et mindre team med en uformel tone og et stærkt samarbejde.

 

Du får en hverdag, hvor du både arbejder selvstændigt og sammen med dine kolleger og hvor opgaverne løses på tværs af vores afdelinger

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

 

·       Løsning af håndværksmæssige opgaver i hverdagen

·       Mindre og større vedligeholdelsesopgaver inde og ude

·       Småreparationer og ad hoc-opgaver

Vi forestiller os, at du har en håndværksmæssig baggrund eller relevant erfaring, arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver. Du trives i et mindre team, bidrager til det gode samarbejde og kan begå dig i en hverdag med beboere med forskellige udfordringer. Du møder mennesker med ro og respekt, er fleksibel i din tilgang til opgaverne og har en naturlig sans for kvalitet og ordentlighed i det, du laver. Du har kørekort B og kan betjene computere, mails og app’s på brugerniveau.

 

Hos os får du:

·       En alsidig hverdag, hvor ikke to dage er ens

·       Fleksible arbejdsforhold og stor grad af selvstændighed

·       Firmabil til rådighed i arbejdstiden

·       En grundig introduktion, så du kommer godt fra start

·       Der stilles arbejdsbil med værktøj til rådighed

Du vil primært varetage opgaver i vores afdelinger primært på Vestegnen Sjælland, men du kan også forvente at hjælpe i vores øvrige afdelinger, når der er behov.

Så send din ansøgning og CV allerede i dag.

jobs.title: Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Onboarding Enablement Manager, APAC to play a key role in enhancing our sales productivity in our APAC region. This role will design, deliver, and continuously improve sales onboarding for our new hires. You will work closely with sales leadership, enablement, and product marketing to ensure our field salesforce is equipped with the skills, tools, and knowledge needed to achieve revenue targets and drive customer success.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Lead APAC Sales & Success onboarding by facilitating Notion’s Sales Bootcamp for new hires across the region

 - Own the APAC Onboarding Calendar end-to-end, ensuring a consistent, well-sequenced new-hire experience

 - Establish a clear communication cadence with APAC frontline leaders, setting expectations and ensuring visibility into each new hire’s onboarding plan and progress

 - Partner with APAC Sales Leadership, Enablement and Revenue Operations to iterate on and deliver high-impact live sessions with clear objectives and strong SME alignment that is aligned to the global program and tailored for regional nuances (Korea, Japan, and APACx)

Quality Assurance Engineer

About Luxtrust

We are a multicultural and forward-thinking qualiﬁed Trust Services Provider based in Capellen, Luxembourg, with over 140 professionals and actively expanding our business internationally. As a Visionary Scout, we are constantly seeking out new opportunities for growth and innovation, always staying ahead of the curve in our industry.

Join us in our mission to drive innovation and co-create a better future!

We are currently looking for a motivated and driven Quality Assurance Engineer (m/f/x) under a permanent contract.

Summary

In the development of our projects, the Quality Assurance Engineer is the key person who ensures that the service produced is built following the requirements, with a high level of quality. That person is in charge of the quality of the product delivered to customers.
 
Missions of the role

Documentation:

-          Create QA documentation to describe processes
-          Update existing documentation or create new ones to document test findings

Agility:

-          Participate in Agile ceremonies
-          Understand and deliver on the product goals during sprints.
-          May lead Agile ceremonies

 Manual testing:

-          Create and documents manual test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update manual test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Ensure each feature is manually tested
-          Organize and execute testing activities on all environments.
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for manual tests

Automatic testing:

-          Create automatic test scenarios following specific guidelines
-          Continuously update automatic test scenarios to ensure that all features are properly covered whenever a new use case arises
-          Develop test cases using guidelines (framework, languages…)
-          Corner cases testing approach is expected for automatic tests
-          Performance testing (stress tests…)
-          Security testing

Test strategy:

-          Contribute to the test strategy of the product
-          Design and develop:
o   Test plans
o   Test cases & Test data
o   Test execution
-          Maintain application coverage up to KPI standards.
-          Come up with new ideas regarding processes, tools etc. to improve the test strategy of the product

Test reporting & release process:

-          Provide reporting for all automatic tests, all manual tests, all non-regression tests performed on a new version
-          Perform smoke tests post release deployment
-          Provide Go/NoGo release status to the Tech Lead and Product Owner

Bug management:

-          Confirm bugs raised by third parties after thorough tests
-          Help define impacts of bugs with the help of stakeholders (BA, PO…) to classify the urgency of the fix

Product knowledge:

-          Complete knowledge of the solution is expected
-          Can deep-dive into the product and all features of the applications maintained by the affected functional team.

Team interaction & support:

-          Work closely with Customer Success team to confirm issues and provide quick support
-          Daily interaction with functional team (Product Owner, Developers, Business Analysts)
 
Required skills

Qualifications / diploma(s): bachelor's or master's degree in engineering or computer sciences or equivalent experience.

Experience:

-         Experience in Scrum methodology
-         Experience using JIRA / Confluence is an asset
-         Intermediate SQL level
-         Previous experience testing PKI/Banking/Mobile/Web applications
-         Experienced in QA with ISEB/ISTQB certification or similar experience
-         Experience in test design, risk management, defect management with a strong background in security
-         Solid knowledge of manual and automated software testing
-         Experience writing test documentation

Languages: French and English fluent. Any other language is an asset.

Technical / Specific skills:

-         Expected to be able to liaise with developers and assess their test automated scripts
-         Comfortable working in a fast paced Agile environment
-         Analytical mindset
-         Proactive and positive attitude with good Team-spirit
-         Good interpersonal relations and communications skills (written and oral)
-         Good time management and priority setting skills
-         Good at corner cases tests methodology
-          Ability to write or understand Bash, HTML/XML, SQL, JavaScript<>TypeScript, Java
-         Hands-on experience testing on the main software platforms: Web, Windows, Linux, iOS, OSX, Android
-         Familiarity with the following technical stacks used in our Quality Assurance processes: Selenium, Playwright, Postman, Rest Assured and BDD Framework /Page Object Framework
-         Corner case testing mindset
-         Automation expertise

Core competencies at LuxTrust:

-          Performance
-          Client service mindset

Our company is committed to fair recruitment, based on the skills of each candidate, regardless of gender nationality, sexual orientation, religion, or any other discriminatory criterion.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Infrastructure & Security Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT CIVILGRID

CivilGrid is the trusted civil design platform powering affordable infrastructure renewal and growth. We give utilities, civil engineers, and municipalities a single, collaborative source of truth for what's underground so teams can plan, design, and build faster, smarter, and safer.

Our platform consolidates utility records, geotechnical and environmental data, paving moratoriums, and jurisdictional requirements directly from 3,000+ utilities, agencies, and municipalities with full chain-of-custody documentation. Teams at PG&E, Mark Thomas, and dozens of leading engineering firms use CivilGrid to cut research time by up to 88%, reduce project costs, prevent dig-ins, and accelerate delivery on the projects that keep communities running.

We're a venture-backed Series A startup tackling a $4.7T US infrastructure market that has been underserved by software for decades. Founded by industry insiders, each with 10+ years in utilities and civil engineering, we move fast, ship work that matters, and stay close to the customers and field teams we build for.

WHY THIS ROLE

We're looking for a Security & Infrastructure Engineer to own our security posture and assist in supporting our cloud platform and reliability as we scale into large utilities and civil engineering firms. You'll take over and grow our security program, working across engineering, IT, and leadership. The role is on the Systems team that spans DevOps, SRE, and security. Your focus is security but you will contribute across the team.

This role reports to the Head of Engineering. It is a hybrid role with expectations that you are working from our Boston, MA office at least 3 days per week if hired.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Partner with engineering to embed reliability and security into the SDLC and infrastructure decisions

  • Run our security program: SOC 2 readiness and audits, vendor reviews, access controls, endpoint security, and threat modeling

  • Define and enforce policies for identity, secrets, data handling, and production access across the company

  • Lead incident response for both security events, and some reliability events, from detection through resolution and follow-up

  • Harden and monitor our GIS servers (Windows Server) alongside our AWS platform

  • Build and maintain our Trust Center, and lead security reviews with customers

  • Contribute to our AWS environment end to end: VPC architecture, ECS, RDS, secrets management, IAM, networking, and cost optimization

  • Contribute to improving reliability practices: SLOs, observability, alerting, on-call rotation, runbooks, and blameless post-incident reviews

  • The tech:

    • AWS ECS, Postgres on RDS managed with CDK

    • GitHub, Datadog, Slack, Notion, Drata

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • At least 5-8 years of experience across product security, platform security, or security engineering, with hands-on experience with DevOps or SRE of production AWS infrastructure

  • Experience running or supporting a SOC 2 program, including evidence collection, control design, and auditor coordination

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS (VPC, ECS, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, CDK, or equivalent)

  • Experience running vulnerability management, from scanner findings and outside reports to fixes shipped

  • Track record of improving reliability in production: defining SLOs, building observability, running on-call, and leading post-incident reviews

  • Startup ready: autonomous, moves fast, takes initiative without being asked

  • Strong verbal and written communication, able to articulate ideas clearly and collaborate effectively

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience supporting B2B products sold into regulated industries (utilities, energy, public sector)

HOW WE WORK

We're a small, but rapidly growing team that ships. Expect direct feedback, real ownership from day one, and proximity to customers â huge utilities, public agencies, and engineering firms whose work depends on what we build. We default to in-person collaboration where it matters and remote-friendly flexibility otherwise. We hire people who care deeply about their craft and the communities our customers serve.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

The base salary range for this role is $137,318 - $192,960.

Base salary is only one part of your total compensation package at CivilGrid, which also includes meaningful early-stage equity, comprehensive benefits, and the opportunity to shape a category-defining company. The base salary range listed above may encompass various levels and/or geographic locations; final offers are determined based on the candidate's experience, skills, level, and work location.

In addition to base and equity, we offer:

  • Company-funded medical, dental, and vision insurance â including medical plans at no cost to the employee

  • FSA (health and dependent care)

  • Unlimited PTO and a culture that expects you to actually use it

  • 401(k) plan

  • Flexible, remote-friendly work environment

  • A high-trust team, real ownership, and the chance to do the most meaningful work of your career

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

CivilGrid is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Employment decisions at CivilGrid are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, please contact us â we're happy to help.

Notion's Growth Engineers make the everyone part of that happen with a combination of creativity and data to unlock business growth. This team accelerates the value Notion provides to an increasing audience of users. We are owners of the ins and outs of our business, using a blend of data, qualitative research, and product intuition to drive business growth.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Build technical foundations that help the broader team and coding agents experiment, build and ship more.

 - Drive technical and product vision as an engineering leader within the org, building alignment with other eng teams and cross functionally, bringing clarity to the roadmap.

 - Deliver experiments end-to-end, from ideation to analysis, that balance the dimensions of product and the business appropriately.

 - Get to know the Notion customer to understand key points in the customer journey and uncover insights that will drive activation and engagement




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Finding the problems worth solving: You don't wait to be handed a roadmap. You dig into growth data, customer research, and the codebase to find the highest-leverage opportunities, then make the case for them and drive alignment on what to pursue.

 - Data and experimentation as a practice: You have Growth Engineering experience at another company, and you've built experimentation into how a team works: defining success criteria, running A/B tests, and turning results into decisions others follow.

 - Shipping polished user interfaces: You build fast, well-crafted web experiences with React and modern web technologies, and you know what it takes to keep them working as usage grows.

 - Building with AI: You build AI systems that keeps producing after you step away: coding agent workflows that can take on engineering work with the guardrails that let them run effectively. You know how to build systems for agents and treat the system as the deliverable, improving it continuously for accelerated impact.

 - Raising the bar for others: You mentor engineers of all tenures, guide them on and technical designs, and share your expertise so it scales past you. Multiple engineers have grown by working with you.

 - Pragmatism and impact-orientation: You care about business impact and prioritize projects accordingly. You're not just going after cool stuff, you understand the balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

 - Putting users first: You think critically about the implications of what you're building, and how it shapes real people's lives. You understand that reach comes with responsibility for our impact, good and bad.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - 10+ years of experience

 - A history of strong cross-functional collaboration with marketing, sales, and/or other non-technical teams

 - You've heard of computing pioneers like Ada Lovelace, Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, and others, and understand why we're big fans of their work.

jobs.title: Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet i 2027? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027 - Book et kald idag.
jobs.description:
Drømmer du om et sabbatår i udlandet? Vi betaler din flybillet hvis du vil afsted i jan-feb 2027.

Et sabbatår i udlandet er for mange en livsforandrende oplevelse. Du får mulighed for at arbejde i et nyt land, møde mennesker fra hele verden, udvikle dig personligt og styrke dit CV med international erfaring. Men det, som de fleste ikke ved, er hvor tidligt processen faktisk bør starte.

Hvis du drømmer om at rejse ud i januar 2027, så er det allerede nu, du skal tage de første skridt. De bedste jobmuligheder, de mest stabile projekter og de mest attraktive destinationer bliver nemlig fyldt langt før afrejse. Samtidig tager det tid at finde det rette match, gennemføre interviews og få styr på alle praktiske detaljer.

Hvorfor starte processen nu – hvis du vil afsted i januar 2027?

1. Du får adgang til de bedste stillinger

Virksomhederne vi samarbejder med rekrutterer løbende, og mange stillinger bliver besat flere måneder før opstart. Starter du processen nu, øger du chancen for at få præcis den rolle og det land, du ønsker.

2. Du sikrer en glidende overgang efter studiet

Når du starter i god tid, kan du planlægge dit sabbatår uden tidspres. Du får ro til at afslutte dit studie, nyde efteråret og samtidig være klar til at rejse ud i januar — uden at skulle haste gennem interviews og praktiske forberedelser.

3. Vi kan matche dig med den helt rigtige virksomhed

Vi arbejder ikke med “første og bedste” løsning. Vi matcher dig med virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker, dine styrker og dine mål for sabbatåret. Det kræver tid — og det er en klar fordel at starte før alle andre.

4. Du får fuld rådgivning hele vejen

Fra første samtale til du står på flyet, hjælper vi dig med:

  • Jobmuligheder

  • Kontrakt og løn

  • Bolig og økonomi

  • Kultur og hverdagsliv

  • Interviewforberedelse

  • Praktiske forhold som bank, skat og relocation

Jo tidligere du starter, desto mere ro og overblik får du.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du kan se hele oversigten her: https://www.jobhuntworldwide.com/sabbataar-udlandet-gode-tips

Kort sagt får du:

  • Gratis og uforpligtende samtale

  • Hjælp til at finde det rette job i udlandet

  • Professionel interviewforberedelse

  • Rådgivning om bolig, økonomi og kontrakt

  • Relocation‑support (fly, hotel, firmabolig m.m.)

  • Løbende kontakt med relevante virksomheder

  • Tryghed og støtte hele vejen til afrejse

Du kan booke en samtale med os allerede i dag, og så starter vi løbende interviews op med de virksomheder, der passer til dine ønsker og din profil.

Book en samtale her: Book et kald

Eller kontakt os direkte: Rene@jobhuntworldwide.com Cathrine@jobhuntworldwide.com

Du kan møde Cathrine her på TikTok

jobs.title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
jobs.description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. Du behøver ikke have erfaring med rengøring. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring, så du ved, hvad du skal gøre, hvordan du gør det, og hvornår opgaven er løst godt. 

Du får:

  • Ansvar for at køre driften ved Præstehaven selv 

  • Et stille og roligt job, hvor du går for dig selv 

Hvem er du? 

Det vigtigste er, at du: 

  • Møder stabilt og til tiden 

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde 

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og følge en plan 

  • Har sans for, når noget er gjort ordentligt 

  • Tager ansvar for dine opgaver 

Det praktiske 

Arbejdssted: Præstehaven, 8210 Aarhus V 

Opgave: Trappevask af 10 opgange 

Timetal: 7 timer om ugen - mulighed for flere timer hos nogle af vores andre kunder (kontorrengøring) 

Arbejdstid: Eventuelt fordelt på to vagter – aftales nærmere.  Dagtimer i hverdage eller weekender

Opstart: 1. December 

Din indsats kan ses og mærkes 

En ren og velholdt opgang gør en forskel for de beboere, der bruger den hver dag. Hos os får du et praktisk arbejde med tydelige opgaver, frihed under ansvar og et resultat, du kan være stolt af. Du bliver vores faste medarbejder i Præstehaven og får selvstændigt ansvar for den daglige rengøring og drift hos kunden. Du har selvfølgelig en fast kontaktperson, som du altid kan kontakte, hvis du har spørgsmål eller brug for hjælp. 

Om os: 

Hvidbjerg Service ApS er en rengøringsvirksomhed, der arbejder i Aarhus og omegn. Virksomheden tilbyder blandt andet kontor- og erhvervsrengøring, vinduespolering, trappevask og rengøring af fællesområder i boligforeninger.  

Hos Hvidbjerg Service ApS arbejder vi for at skabe rene og velholdte omgivelser, som kunder og beboere kan glæde sig over hver dag. Vi lægger vægt på kvalitet, stabile aftaler og medarbejdere, der tager ansvar og er stolte af deres arbejde.  

Som medarbejder får du grundig oplæring, tydelige opgaver og frihed til at arbejde selvstændigt. Vi tror på, at de bedste resultater skabes, når du har de rette rammer og nem adgang til hjælp og sparring. 

 

Er det dig, vi leder efter? 

Send en kort ansøgning, hvor du fortæller: 

  • Hvem du er

  • Hvornår du kan starte 

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science

Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET

About Claims

AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.

We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.

The team

Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.

  • Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
  • Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
  • Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

You would be the fourth person on the team and our second engineer.

Our culture

We are a fully remote team spread across Europe, Africa and the US West Coast. We have a flat hierarchy and move fast towards clearly defined goals. We think deep, don't shy away from difficult problems or conversations, and we ship relentlessly. The code you will write will run on a live network within your first weeks, and you own real things from day one. We are an AI-native company and expect you to be an AI-native Software Engineer we can trust.

About the role

Position: Software Engineer (Python, full-stack)
Location: Remote. You need to be able to join our team meetings in the afternoon, Central European Time.
Type: Full-time contractor. Start in December 2026 or January 2027.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to help maintain and build Claims and its supporting applications, services, and developer tools. Claims turns scientific research into structured claims and supporting evidence through document processing, AI pipelines, and automated evaluation.

This is a hands-on, backend-focused full-stack role. You'll work across Python services, web dashboards, data pipelines, integrations, and deployment tooling. Your work will combine delivering new features with debugging existing systems, improving reliability, and making the codebase easier to maintain.

You should be comfortable owning well-defined tasks from investigation through implementation, testing, and release, working with the team on larger design decisions and unfamiliar areas.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain Python backend services, APIs, command-line tools, and background processing workflows.
  • Develop and improve web dashboards and internal review tools using TypeScript, React, and modern web frameworks.
  • Maintain pipelines that ingest research papers, process documents, extract structured information, and evaluate results.
  • Integrate external APIs and AI model providers, handling validation, retries, timeouts, rate limits, and usage costs.
  • Work with relational databases and object storage, including schema changes, migrations, queries, and data integrity checks.
  • Investigate bugs and production issues across services, pipelines, and interfaces; address root causes and add useful regression coverage.
  • Help maintain deployment automation, continuous integration, logging, monitoring, and operational documentation.
  • Improve existing code through practical refactoring, dependency maintenance, automated tests, and code review.
  • Collaborate with engineering and research colleagues to turn requirements and experimental workflows into reliable software.

Required skills and experience

  • Typically 1â5 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience delivering and maintaining production software.
  • Strong Python skills, including building maintainable services or data processing applications, managing dependencies, and writing automated tests.
  • Experience designing, consuming, and troubleshooting HTTP APIs, with a sound understanding of JSON, validation, authentication, and error handling.
  • Working knowledge of TypeScript or JavaScript and experience contributing to React applications or a comparable modern frontend framework.
  • Practical SQL and relational database experience, including data modelling, migrations, and debugging queries.
  • Confidence working in Linux environments and using the command line to investigate logs, configuration, processes, and service failures.
  • Experience with Git, pull requests, code review, automated testing, and continuous integration.
  • An understanding of secure engineering practices, including access controls, secrets management, and careful handling of private data.
  • The ability to navigate an existing codebase, trace issues across components, and make focused, well-tested changes.
  • Clear communication, practical problem-solving, and the judgment to work independently while asking for input when requirements or risks are unclear.

Nice to have

  • Experience with FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, or similar tools.
  • Experience integrating LLM APIs, building AI-assisted workflows, or evaluating model outputs for accuracy, reliability, latency, and cost.
  • Familiarity with PDF parsing, OCR, document extraction, scientific datasets, or evidence provenance.
  • Experience with distributed jobs, asynchronous processing, reproducible pipelines, or automated benchmarking.
  • Familiarity with Docker, Ansible, systemd, GitHub Actions, cloud hosting, or infrastructure automation.
  • Experience with Bittensor, decentralized compute networks, or systems for evaluating independently submitted code.
  • Exposure to Rust, native Python extensions, or WebAssembly.
  • An interest in scientific research, open-source software, and tools that make research easier to inspect and reuse.

You don't need experience with every technology listed. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly across the stack matter most.

What success looks like

  • You can independently deliver scoped features and fixes across the backend and supporting web applications.
  • Your changes are understandable, tested, and documented, with appropriate attention to security and compatibility.
  • You help make processing pipelines and production services more reliable and easier to troubleshoot.
  • You contribute constructively to reviews, communicate progress and blockers, and help the team turn research ideas into maintainable software.

What we offer

  • $1500 - $2000 per month, depending on experience.
  • Opportunities for rapid professional growth in a high-impact role: a small team, a live network, and a senior engineer to learn from.
  • Quarterly team retreats in inspiring locations (e.g., Vilnius, Koh Samui).
  • Travel and visa support for business needs.
  • Flexible remote working.


Help us build the data layer that lets AI do science properly.

How to apply


Apply online through the link here: https://airtable.com/appZKkV7FT7eYBhKI/shrjJ3jYfxZjsNckR

It takes about 30 minutes: a few practical questions, four short written answers, links to your code, and your CV or personal website. No cover letter needed.

Applications close on Monday 16 November 2026, 23:59 CET.

We read every application after the deadline and reply to everyone.
